lines: A clerk reproduced the prisoner's mark beside a standard door bolt on the same forearm. A new impression appears larger and carries the same bolt. Compare their proportions to establish whether the whole image was resized or the mark belongs to someone else.

name: Two versions of a town square

gm.title: At the table
lines: A rift brings the past and future to the same square at different hours. A resident from each era asks the party to change the same decision for opposite reasons.

name: Two wizards divided by a wall

gm.title: At the table
lines: Rival spellcasters cast alternating wards that push the same shared wall back and forth. The neighbors can show which side first broke the old agreement.

name: Unlisted riders use the back trough

gm.title: At the table
lines: The caretaker marks a cup with the stable brand of each served rider. Three brands never appear in the guestbook. Help the keeper watch the back trough to find which riders are being admitted after closing.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Set one pre-adventure action in a location the party can visit for a present reason. Let a repair, stain, or changed routine reveal what happened there.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Record when the triggering incident occurred, who benefited, and which NPC acted first afterward. Give each fact a different way to reach the table in case the intended meeting falls through.

gm.title: At the table
lines: An insular bar lets outsiders in when they can name a practical gift the regulars need. A banned patron waits nearby with good advice and an ulterior motive.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A group covers city statues in paint that washes off at noon. Under it, older layers prove the city had changed each dedication before.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A small creature shelters inside a boot left out to dry. The party can follow its retreat to discover where their guide hid the spare boots.

name: Vines label the paths as water rises

gm.title: At the table
lines: Trailing vines cling to trunks horizontally at the previous flood's highest level. Compare the newest leaf growth with the line to decide which ridge remains above water. An older mark shows where the safer-looking ridge used to wash out.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Everyone who drinks sees the same broken bridge from a different angle. Assemble the descriptions to locate it before the wagons take that route.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A creature's mouth moves and its speech emerges from a loose board elsewhere in the room. A whisper into a crack beside the board reaches the creature alone.

name: Voice with the weight of a drum

gm.title: At the table
lines: The drinker's low voice carries through floorboards. A listener below can recognize the speaker even if the words remain unclear.

name: Wall flowers open where air circulates

gm.title: At the table
lines: Pale blooms open by a cracked lintel and stay folded in sealed rooms. Recognizing the difference gives explorers a way to find the only passage where several people can work safely for hours.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Wargs test one gate every night and break off when its bell sounds. The bell ringer has an offer to miss a shift.

name: Warm a building by unwinding one knot

gm.title: At the table
lines: A cloth stores a room's warmth in a row of knots. Unwind one to warm a new room for an hour and chill the corresponding area of the original building. Ask who still needs the old room before using the last knot.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A guard invites one member to answer a routine complaint. A court clerk offers to show the docket to the others while the officer is out.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Thick strands tie a door to its frame from both sides. One creature is inside with something that keeps moving the latch.

name: Who keeps the molds when the furnace cools

gm.title: At the table
lines: The departing tenant is allowed to break the old molds after turning off the furnace. A buyer needs their profiles for a licensed repair. Include the originals in the handoff, copy the profiles before shutoff, or find who still has the original drawings.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Unending twilight ends briefly around a transferred relic. Farmers, navigators, and nocturnal citizens each offer a use for those few minutes.

name: Why the harpies left their island

gm.title: At the table
lines: A flock nesting in harbor blocks safe passage. They will move if the party recovers eggs left on their old island. The harbormaster is willing to move shipping for a day if someone can prove the flock plans to leave.

name: Wild kin on a disputed trail

gm.title: At the table
lines: A band maintains a path outsiders claim was empty for decades. Old repairs in their distinctive style prove regular use.

name: Win the handoff without winning the whole race

gm.title: At the table
lines: Mark three points where different couriers can trade the parcel. A player can skip a segment by committing to a wrong-way risk now, or watch one transfer and use that information for the next.

gm.title: At the table
lines: A jar contains wind that blows in the direction it was bottled. Loose paper twists toward the coast printed on the seller's label.

name: Words of ownership pull at the ground

gm.title: At the table
lines: Saying that you own a parcel of land makes your next step on it heavy. Asking permission from anyone who lives there restores an easy stride until dawn. Try making a claim first with one foot across the boundary.

gm.title: At the table
lines: Describe the factions, debts, or locations that would carry forward under several plausible outcomes. Ask which survivors, obligations, or places the players want to spend another session with.

name: Yesterday's collateral needs to be used today

gm.title: At the table
lines: A pawnbroker has taken a ferry token as collateral and would lend it under supervision. Only the borrower knows how to seat it in the old ferry gate. The party can guarantee its return while the two travel together.

lines: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

lines: When you use your action to set it, this trap forms a saw-­‐‑toothed steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. player.title: Rules
lines: Oil usually comes in a clay flask that holds 1 pint. As an action, you can splash the oil in this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a target creature or object, treating the oil as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target is covered in oil. If the target takes any fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an additional 5 fire damage from the burning oil. You can also pour a flask of oil on the ground to cover a 5-­foot‑square area, provided that the surface is level. If lit, the oil burns for 2 rounds and deals 5 fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn in the area. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Akari suspects a seep lies under the bend in the channel.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find drinkable water for the party at the dry channel.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Water Sense 100 ft. with a Survival check.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +5.
Sure Feet (Ex) treats shallow sand as normal terrain, costing 1 square per square entered, and deep sand as shallow sand, costing 2 squares for a Medium Bhuka.
Glare Resistance (Ex) prevents the dazzled condition from bright sunlight.

+2 racial on Constitution checks or Fortitude saves against harmful heat and dehydration. Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects, heat protection level 1, and comfort through 120°F.
+2 racial on Knowledge (nature), which is always a class skill.
Nature Sense adds +2 on Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Survival) adds +3. Wild empathy +1. The encounter starts with no animal companion present.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Water Sense (Ex) uses Survival to detect drinkable water within 100 ft. The DC depends on depth. Surface DC 10, up to 10 ft. deep DC 12, 11–20 ft. DC 15, 21–40 ft. DC 20, 41–70 ft. DC 25, and 71–100 ft. DC 30. Akari rolls at Survival +12. A drinkable source 30 ft. below her and within range uses DC 20, so she needs an 8 or higher on the die.
Quarterstaff +0 melee with one end for 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2.

Prepared druid spells, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. Create water makes up to 2 gallons. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Akari guides the party along a dry channel to locate a drinkable seep. Use Water Sense at a bend where the source is within range. She uses create water for immediate relief while the party finds a way to the seep.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1 by Table A–43. Sea Hag monster class level 2, 1 HD.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Alda calls from under the quay and offers to trade a stolen locket for the stone.

gm.title: Role
lines: Shore ambusher who scavenges marked stones from wrecks.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get back a ballast stone before the tide takes it inland.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic evil. AC includes +1 natural armor and +1 Dexterity. Touch 11, flat-footed 11. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +3.
Alertness. Breathes air and water. Alda can take 10 on Swim checks and run in a straight line while swimming.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw +4 melee, 1d4+3 slashing. Full attack makes two claws at +4 each.
Horrific Appearance (Su). A creature looking at Alda makes a DC 11 Fortitude save or takes 1 point of Strength damage. Success grants immunity to her Horrific Appearance for 24 hours.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Alda crouches just below the waterline. She shows her face when a scavenger leans over the stones, claws if cornered, and dives when her escape opens.

printings.label: Half-Giant desert pass rescuer, Psychic Warrior 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Anet has the line and can reach the ledge if the party holds the upper anchor.

gm.title: Role
lines: Desert pass rescuer and Psychic Warrior.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a trapped traveler off a narrow ledge before the scree slips.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4, touch 10, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple +7 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Fire Acclimated adds +2 on saves against fire effects.
Alertness and Psychic Warrior bonus Improved Initiative. Naturally Psionic supplies both daily PP. Psychic Warrior 1 and Wisdom 13 contribute 0. Manifester level 1.

With room to grow during Expansion: Large size, 10-ft. space/reach, Str 19, Dex 8, AC 12, touch 8, flat-footed 12, Reflex −1, grapple +12 with Powerful Build. Climb and Jump each +6. The enlarged weapon follows the power and Powerful Build uses the next size category.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large longsword, wielded two-handed: +3 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With Expansion the sword becomes Huge: +3 melee, 3d6+6 slashing, same critical, 10-ft. reach.

Racial Stomp once per day. Standard action, 20-ft. cone-shaped spread, grounded creatures only. Reflex DC 10 negates prone and 1d4 nonlethal damage. No power resistance, manifester level 1, no PP cost.

Expansion: 1 PP, standard action, personal, 1 round at manifester level 1. Enlarge by one size category with the carried gear. The effect ends before her next turn. The expanded attack applies to an attack of opportunity in that window. The longer duration is beyond this build’s manifester-level limit.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mark the stable ledge and keep the party clear while planning the lift. Use Expansion and the remaining move action to get the rescue line within reach before the effect ends. Use Stomp only after the party clears the cone.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2, following the published racial benchmark. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).

lines: Bring two frightened witnesses to the hearing.

lines: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4. Touch 10, flat-footed 14, armor check penalty −2. BAB +2, grapple +4. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +6. Weapon Focus (morningstar) and racial bonus Improved Initiative.
Sheds white light to 5 ft. Immune to negative energy, energy drain, magical death effects, blinding, dazzling, and direct light attacks. Concealment still applies.
Floating Head prevents suffocation, strangulation, and vorpal decapitation. Foes gain no flanking bonus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spell-like abilities, caster level 3. Light and disrupt undead at will. Disrupt undead is a +2 ranged touch attack for 1d6 damage to undead, no save.
Cure light wounds 3/day, 1d8+3 healing. Glitterdust 3/day, DC 13 Will negates blindness only. Both revealed dust and blindness last up to 3 rounds.

gm.title: Tactics

gm.title: Hook
lines: Avarra draws a longsword and points the crew toward the safer door.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep onlookers clear while the forge crew shutters a ruptured flue.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fortitude 12, Reflex 15, Will 12. Bloodied 14. Ten healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor and a longsword in one hand. Swordmage Warding gives +3 AC with the other hand free, +1 with a blade and no free hand. The ward applies while conscious and wielding a blade.
Firesoul grants fire resistance 5 and contributes +1 Reflex. Firepulse uses Strength.
Retributive Shield grants +2 to the next attack against the foe whose attack triggered Aegis of Shielding, through the end of Avarra’s next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +5 vs. AC, 1d8+2 damage.
Greenflame Blade, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC, 1d8+4 fire. On a hit each enemy adjacent to the target takes 2 fire.
Sword Burst, at-will standard. Close burst 1, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 force.
Flame Cyclone, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each creature, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+6 fire.
Frost Backlash, daily immediate interrupt when an adjacent creature hits Avarra. Melee 1, +7 vs. Reflex for 3d8+4 cold, half on a miss.

Aegis of Shielding, at-will minor, close burst 2, marks a creature until another Aegis target or a superseding mark. Attacks that omit Avarra take −2. When such an attack hits and that foe is within 10 squares, immediate interrupt to reduce its damage to one creature by 7.
Firepulse, encounter immediate reaction after an enemy within 1 square hits Avarra with a melee attack. +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+2 fire.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Marks the creature blocking the exit, using her immediate action to shield a worker or answer a melee hit. Keeps the blast pointed away from the crew.

printings.label: Dvati crossroad chorus, Bard 2 twin pair

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 2d6 shared, +4 Constitution per twin
Challenge · Provisional CR 3 for the pair. ECL 3 (2 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Aven and Iven can cover both forks while the party checks the road for late travellers.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get separated travellers back to the right side of a road closure.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. The listed combat stats are per twin. One Hit Die roll per level, using 6 and 4 on d6s. Each twin gets 5 from the dice and 4 from Constitution, for 9 HP each. Track each body’s hit points independently.

Each has studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +3. Armor check penalty −1. Skill Focus (Perform [sing]) adds +3. Bardic knowledge +3.

One shared pool of two bardic music uses, three 0-level spell slots, and one 1st-level slot per day. Bard caster level 2. Both carry components. Both twins normally take the casting actions together, with one providing materials. One twin can cast alone if the other takes no actions during the casting. Even a free action by the other twin ruins the attempt and loses the spell.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Table ruling for these encounters. Roll initiative once for the pair and resolve both turns on that count. Declare shared casting and Echo Attack together.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Each twin has a short sword +1, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, and a shortbow +3, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment. When both flank with swords, each is +4 to hit, or +5 with the Echo Attack bonus to attack.

Inspire courage starts as a standard action and spends one shared music use. +1 morale on attacks, weapon damage, and saves against charm and fear for allies who hear it, while it is heard and for five rounds afterward. Countersong helps listeners within 30 ft. use their Perform result against sonic or language-dependent magical attacks. Fascinate affects one attentive target within 90 ft. outside combat distractions and uses one Perform (sing) check as the Will DC.
Expeditious retreat (1st): standard action, personal, base land speed rises to 60 ft. for 2 minutes. Both twins benefit on the same plane. It spends their one shared 1st-level slot.
Cure light wounds (1st): standard action, touch, restores 1d8+2 HP to one willing living target, including one twin. It uses the same shared 1st-level slot as expeditious retreat.
Cantrips known: detect magic, light, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Aven and Iven are directing travellers along a forked road. If they need to reach both ends quickly, they declare one shared casting of expeditious retreat. If a traveller is hurt, they keep the same slot for cure light wounds instead.

printings.label: Raptoran glider and ropeway rigger, Expert 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Avilli can glide a messenger line down from the upper landing if someone holds the near anchor.

gm.title: Role
lines: Glider and ropeway rigger who carries a light messenger line.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reconnect a ropeway before travellers reach the damaged span.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision and Unerring Direction on the Material Plane

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Skill Focus (Use Rope) adds +3.
Glides 40 ft. with average maneuverability and 20 ft. forward for each 5 ft. down. At 1 Hit Die this build can glide from height only. Maintain a light load, up to 43 lb. at Strength 12.
An unconscious or helpless Raptoran aloft descends in a corkscrew and takes 1d6 falling damage. Jump, Climb and Spot above include the racial bonuses.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger +1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Check the knots and use the upper landing to glide a light messenger line down. Ask the party to secure the near anchor. Keep anyone needing rescue off the glider’s load.

printings.label: Chitine silk rigger, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Awa can reach the damaged silk stays from the ceiling.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the damaged gangway open until everyone reaches the near side.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +3.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.
Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.
Weapon Focus (short sword) adds +1 on attack rolls with that weapon.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One Small short sword +5 melee for 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. As a single attack it is +4 while dazzled.
When crossing the rafters, use Climb +14 and take 10 even while threatened for a result of 24. Keep hands free when using the ceiling route.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Awa checks the silk stays above the broken gangway. He climbs past the damaged section, takes footing on a brace, and draws a short sword if someone threatens the crossing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and fly 20 ft. (average)

gm.title: Hook
lines: Aya can look ahead by air and needs someone to keep the lower footpath open for travelers.

gm.title: Role
lines: Sparrow example. Dispatch runner and lookout.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a warning to the next watch post before a washout cuts off the main road.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision in hybrid and animal forms

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Hengeyokai; sparrow communication in hybrid or animal form

gm.title: Traits
lines: Human scores and skill modifiers listed. Leather armor. Human AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12, initiative +1. Hybrid Dex 15 changes AC to 14, touch to 12, initiative to +2, and Dex-based skills by +1.
Human Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will −1. Hybrid Reflex +4. Base attack bonus +0. Alertness and the Rogue’s 3.0 traps feature. Sneak attack +1d6 on qualifying attacks, ranged within 30 ft.

Animal form: Fine sparrow, AC 24, touch 24, flat-footed 18, initiative +6. Walk 1 ft., fly 50 ft. Str 1, Dex 23, Con 10. Fortitude +0, Reflex +8, Will −1. No natural damage listed. Hide +26 and Disguise +13 in this form. Gear merges.

Use the same 5 maximum HP in all forms. Two supernatural changes per day, each full-round and provoking an attack of opportunity. For hybrid flight carry only a light weapon or object of up to 6 lb and no buckler or shield.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger in human or hybrid form. Melee −1, reach 5 ft. Thrown +1 in human form or +2 in hybrid form, 10-ft. range increment. Hit 1d4−1 piercing (minimum 1), critical 19–20/×2.
Animal form. Observe or move without an attack. In hybrid form, fly while carrying a light dagger or a small dispatch.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Find a clear route past a blocked road. Carry the message in a visible satchel in hybrid form or scout as an animal before returning to collect it. Avoid trading blows for a lost route.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Basalt waits for someone to clear the ramp before he breaks the gate fittings.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a trapped cart off a broken loading ramp.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. No Constitution score. Large −1, natural armor +7, Dexterity +3. Touch 12, flat-footed 16. BAB +2, grapple +11, space and reach 10 ft. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +0.
Spell resistance 15. Construct traits, Rapid Repair 1 HP/hour at 1 HP or more. An assistant with a DC 15 Craft (stonemasonry) check can raise it to 2 HP/hour. No grafts fitted.
Power Attack, Fighter bonus Improved Sunder, and racial bonus Alertness.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large warhammer held in two hands +6 melee, 2d6+7 bludgeoning, ×3. One slam +6 melee, 1d8+7 bludgeoning, ×2.

Pulverize 3/day, standard action, melee touch +6 against attended objects, no attack of opportunity. On contact remove hardness for 1d4 rounds, Fortitude DC 18 negates. Up to a 10-ft. cube of material. Unattended nonmagical objects get no save.

With the warhammer, Improved Sunder prevents provoking and grants +4 on opposed attack rolls. Two-handed use grants a further +4 in that contest. Apply the separate size bonus when Basalt is larger than the defender.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Basalt tests the broken loading ramp before putting weight on it. If the gate jams, he pulverizes its seized fittings and breaks them with the hammer.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bekra can hear the ferry bell through the flood wall. She needs someone in the wheelhouse to tell her when to let go.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the gate open until the last ferry crosses, even though the officials have ordered it closed.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Berren can compare the samples in the covered counting room if the party finds the missing merchant seal.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Identify which shipment carries a counterfeit stamp before the ore lots are mixed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Skill Focus (Appraise) adds +3. The eight listed ranked class skills use 32 skill points, including the four extra at first level. Hide +5 without Camouflage.
Camouflage still works against darkvision. True seeing negates the racial Hide bonus. Ordinary cover or concealment is still needed to attempt a Hide check.
Dazzled in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. While dazzled, Search +4, Spot +3, heavy pick +0 melee, and light crossbow +0 ranged.
The heavy pick counts as simple through Weapon Familiarity and is covered by Expert proficiency.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Heavy pick +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×4, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Compare the disputed ore samples against the original mark in the covered counting room. Ask the party to bring the merchants’ seals before the shipments are mixed.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 6 (3 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Borr waits with his club where the shaft light stops at a bend.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the switchback clear until his companions reach the lower passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral magic-follower. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.

Dyed fur grants +2 circumstance on Hide in shadow. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fighter bonus feat is Weapon Focus (club). The 4th-Hit-Die ability increase went to Strength.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club +10 melee in two hands for 1d6+7 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Without the club, the natural full attack is two claws at +9 for 1d4+5 each and a secondary bite at +4 for 1d4+2.

After taking damage, check next round. On 1 on a d6, Borr drops his club, rages, and uses two claws at +11 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +6 for 1d4+3. AC drops to 13 and grapple rises to +11. Hit points and saves stay the same.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Borr waits beside the switchback where shadows break up his dyed fur. He holds the turn with his club until driven back or forced into rage.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bracken needs someone to hold the survey line while she jumps the washout.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Flag a dry crossing before the supply cart reaches the flooded ford.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather; passive Perception 14. Proficiency +2. Strength save +3, Dexterity save +5. Archery fighting style.
Grove Cervan. Long jump 30 ft. and high jump 15 ft. with or without a running start, spending movement normally. Opportunity attacks against Bracken have disadvantage.
Surge of Vigor once per long rest. An attack dealing more than half current HP immediately triggers healing of 1d12+2, including a hit that drops Bracken to 0 HP.
Favored Enemy beasts and Natural Explorer forest. Speaks Birdfolk and spoken Cervan.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longbow +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+3 piercing. Shortsword +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

Spellcasting. Two 1st-level slots per long rest. Cure wounds restores 1d8+2 HP to a touched creature. Hunter’s mark requires concentration and adds 1d6 damage to weapon hits against the marked target.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Bracken leaps across a gap to secure the line. She leaves melee through the clearest route and uses her bow from across the washout.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 4. ECL 4 (4 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Brak signals from the bridge return when the far end is clear.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the bridge long enough for the last crew to cross.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2, and size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −4. BAB +4, grapple +3. Fortitude +8, Reflex +3, Will +2. Sonic resistance 5.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or daylight, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attacks, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Vulnerability to Poison (Ex). Take −4 on Fortitude saves against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom.

Skinshift (Ex). As a move action, choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and gain damage reduction 5 against that damage type for 3 + Constitution modifier rounds. One use per day, plus one more at 4th level and every four levels thereafter.

Shriek (Ex). Once per day as a standard action, emit a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on the vril or a 30-ft. cone. Creatures in the area take sonic damage. Reflex halves at DC 10 + half character level (round down) + Constitution modifier. Vril barbarians can use Shriek while raging.

Improved Initiative adds +4. Combat Reflexes permits up to three attacks of opportunity per round, including while flat-footed. Weapon Focus (short sword) adds +1 to attacks. Weapon Specialization (short sword) adds +2 damage. Dazing Shriek.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small short sword +9 melee for 1d4+5 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Small javelin +7 ranged for 1d4+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.

Skinshift twice per day lasts 7 rounds per use. Shriek once per day deals 2d6 sonic damage, Reflex DC 16 half. Dazing Shriek makes any creature that takes that damage roll a separate Fortitude DC 16 save or be dazed for 1 round.
Fortitude becomes +4 against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom before any bright-light penalty.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brak shelters the crew behind the bridge return and uses the cone when attackers cross the open span. Brak chooses Skinshift against the damage type already seen and saves the second use for the retreat.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bring the repair crew to higher ground and Bram will lend the key to the old inspection stair.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Close the levee gate before water reaches the roof of the keeper’s hut, with the repair crew still out in the channel.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Space 10 ft. Natural reach 10 ft. Chain shirt +4, natural armor +4, Dexterity +1, size −1. Touch 10, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −2.

Power Attack and Weapon Focus (glaive). The glaive attack includes Weapon Focus. When Bram chooses Power Attack, his melee attacks take −1 until his next turn. The glaive gains +2 damage. The light spiked gauntlet's damage stays the same.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large glaive +6 melee, 2d8+7 slashing, critical ×3. Attacks at 15 or 20 ft.
Large spiked gauntlet +5 melee, 1d6+5 piercing, critical ×2. Covers targets within 10 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Bram closes the levee gate when the height marks disappear underwater. He lends his gate key if the party finds the missing crew first. If defending the platform, he keeps intruders at glaive distance and uses the gauntlet inside that reach.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bramble has a safety rope on the safe side but needs someone to reach the crew from the other bank.

gm.title: Role
lines: Mountain-pass rescuer who can hold an evacuation route

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a stranded repair crew off the pass before dark.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 13. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Add +4 dodge AC against giants while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1. Add +2 on saves against poison and +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects. Add +1 to attacks against goblinoids.
Toughness adds 3 HP. Fast movement adds 10 ft. with light gear. Illiterate as a first-level Barbarian.

Rage once per day, up to 6 rounds. Str 17, Con 17, HP 13, AC 12, Fortitude +5, Will +1. Rage HP go away when it ends. Patient or concentration-dependent tasks such as spellcasting and moving silently are unavailable during rage.
After rage, fatigued for the rest of the encounter: Str 11, Dex 10, AC 13, Reflex +0. Cannot charge or run.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword. Melee +3, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +5, 1d6+3. While fatigued +2, 1d6.
Thrown dagger. Ranged +3, 10-ft. range increment, 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +3, 1d4+3. While fatigued +2, 1d4.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rig a safety line and get travelers off the exposed path. Stand between them and an attacker. Use rage if the evacuation is threatened. Withdraw once the last traveler reaches cover.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 Fighter NPC. Uses 4e character math.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Brann holds the short ramp until he can see every member of the returning crew.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the escape stair clear while the last miners get out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Scale +7 and heavy shield +2. Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 18. Thirteen healing surges at 9 HP including Vitality. Toughness adds 5 HP. The heavy shield gives −2 on physical skill checks.

One-handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to warhammer attacks. Combat Challenge can mark an attacked enemy through the end of Brann’s next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that exclude Brann. If a creature he marked is adjacent and shifts or makes an attack excluding him, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.

Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. When one hits a creature whose movement provoked it, that movement stops. Heedless Charge adds 2 AC against opportunity attacks during a charge.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Warhammer, melee basic, +7 vs. AC for 1d10+4 damage. Opportunity attack is +8 vs. AC.
Sure Strike, at-will standard. +9 vs. AC, 1d10 damage.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard with shield. +7 vs. AC for 1d10+4. Push an eligible enemy 1 square, then optionally shift into its vacated square. At Medium size Brann can push targets up to Large.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. +7 vs. AC, 2d10+4 and an ally adjacent to the target can shift 2 squares.
Comeback Strike, daily standard, reliable. +7 vs. AC, 2d10+4 and Brann can spend a healing surge.
Goring Charge, encounter standard. Charge up to speed 5 under the normal charge rules and use the horn attack instead of the basic. +9 vs. AC with the charge bonus included, 1d6+4 and prone on a hit.
Ferocity, immediate interrupt when reduced to 0 HP or fewer. Make a melee basic attack if an immediate action is available.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brann uses Goring Charge to put a blocker on the ground, then positions his shield to keep the route open. He uses Covering Attack when somebody needs to withdraw.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Brasswake plants their shield in the doorway and calls for the party to move first.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the gate open until the last travelers are through.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Scale +7 and heavy shield +2, with −1 speed and combined −2 armor check penalty. Fortitude 17, Reflex 14, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge, worth 6 HP.

Combat Challenge marks any creature Brasswake attacks until the end of Brasswake’s next turn. A marked creature takes −2 to attacks that exclude Brasswake. When an adjacent enemy marked by Brasswake shifts or attacks without including them, Brasswake can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.

Living Construct gives +2 on saves against ongoing damage. You can rest for 4 hours for an extended rest. You do not need to eat, drink, or breathe. On a death saving throw, you can take 10 if it is better than your roll.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. Wielded in one hand.
Tide of Iron (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. With the shield equipped, on a hit push a target of Large size or smaller 1 square and optionally shift into its old square.
Passing Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. On a hit, may shift 1 square and make a secondary attack at +10 vs. AC for 1d8+5 against a different target.

Villain’s Menace (daily, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5 and gain +2 to attacks and +4 to damage against that target for the encounter. A miss grants +1 to attacks and +2 to damage against that target.
Warforged Resolve (encounter, minor). While bloodied, gain 3 temporary HP.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 6 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Brasswake’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brasswake holds the narrower door. When pressed, they push the nearest foe away with Tide of Iron and use Warforged Resolve while bloodied.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Brasswell knows which door could have been opened from inside.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a set of copied keys before the next public shift.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Dwarvish, Machine Speech, Thieves’ Cant, Gnomish

gm.title: Traits
lines: DEX and INT saves +5 and +3. Wears leather armor. Human-shaped Medium chassis. Disease immunity, poison damage resistance, and advantage on saves against paralysis, petrification, and poison.
Six hours dormant replace sleep. Disadvantage on Perception while dormant. No need for air, food, or drink.
Always Armed. Brasswell’s integrated shortsword retracts into the arm. It counts as held while drawn and is automatically concealed while folded away. Deliberate removal takes an action.

Stone heritage grants construction tool expertise and longsword proficiency. Eye for Quality adds PB when examining stone or metal objects or structures for origin or purpose, or doubles PB already granted by a relevant proficiency.

Criminal background with Investigation and Deception. Touch of Luck grants 2 Luck instead of 1 when gaining Luck for a failed attack or save, and resets 5 Luck to 1d4+1 when the next point would be gained. Rogue expertise applies to Stealth and thieves’ tools.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Integrated shortsword +5, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on Brasswell’s turn with advantage, or if another enemy of the target is within 5 ft., that enemy can act, and Brasswell lacks disadvantage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brasswell closes the service hatch before confronting the intruders. A routine search leaves the retracted blade undiscovered.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 6 (2 class HD, LA +4).
Speed · 20 ft. in armor or under load

gm.title: Hook
lines: Breka marks the route across the seam before walking into the stone.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a foothold at the mouth of a promising seam.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Appraise +7, +9 stone or metal, +11 when the related Craft synergy also applies

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +4.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded. Speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework, including a reactive check within 10 ft. An Urdunnir can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+4 racial bonus on saves against poison and +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.
+4 dodge AC against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC.
Skill Focus (gemcutting) gives +3 to the listed Craft check. Craft modifiers exclude tools.
Breka is from the Oldonnar region and weighs 216 lb. His Stone Walk payload limit is 432 lb.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light mace +2 melee, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Apply +1 against orcs and goblinoids.

Stone Walk (Su) allows passage through stone and earth as though through air. The Urdunnir can bring up to twice their body weight. The Urdunnir and any passengers must hold their breath within the material.

Stone Shape (Sp), at will, caster level 8. Standard action, touch, up to 18 cu. ft. of stone, instantaneous, no save or spell resistance. Makes rough forms. A shape with moving parts has a 30% failure chance.

Shape Metal (Sp), at will once per round, caster level 8. Full-round action, touch, up to 5 cu. ft. of metal, instantaneous, Fortitude negates and spell resistance applies. Fortitude DC 14 where applicable, melee touch +2. Shape Metal can reduce a touched armor’s protection by 1d6 (half for mostly nonmetal armor). Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. Touching an unwilling creature or an item it holds requires a melee touch attack and normally provokes from that defender.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Breka checks the depth and alignment of the stone before crossing. He takes a light bundle through to the known air pocket and reshapes a stone landing on the far side.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bren can walk the party through the manifest, then help Kesra check the warehouse.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the shipment loaded under another family’s seal.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Aura strength corresponds to Incarnate level 1. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +4. Armor check penalty −3.

Incarnate 1 grants one essentia and the Incarnum subtype. Meldshaper level 1. Shapes Dissolving Spittle (throat) and Silvertongue Mask (brow), both unbound. Each can hold one point. Reallocate the point as a swift action.

Both soulmelds stay shaped when the point moves. Racial Knowledge is +2 competence while both are shaped. Silvertongue Mask gives +2 insight to Bluff and Diplomacy or +4 when invested. The default is invested in the mask.
Alertness gives +2 to Listen and Spot.
Racial Aid gives +3 to the roll of another Rilkan when you successfully aid them. Use the ordinary bonus when aiding a creature of another species.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Morningstar +0 melee, 1d8 bludgeoning and piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. +4 to hit if he and Kesra are flanking the same foe.
Detect Opposition at will as the detect chaos spell.
Dissolving Spittle: standard action, +2 ranged touch within 30 ft., 1d6 acid or 2d6 with the point invested. No save. This action provokes attacks of opportunity.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Bren keeps his mask invested while he checks the manifests. If fighting starts, he can shift the point to Dissolving Spittle. If Kesra has a flank, he draws his morningstar and takes the opposite side.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bren reveals blue thread tied to a gate latch and asks the party to follow it after the patrol passes.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Move the summons across the valley without sending the patrol after its bearer.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +4. Touch 15, flat-footed 12. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +4, Small size +1. Dodge gives +1 AC against a designated foe.
DR 10/cold iron and SR 16. Constant greater invisibility, including while attacking. Suppress or resume it as a free action.

Improved Initiative, racial Dodge and Weapon Finesse. Ranks are 4 each in Bluff, Concentration, Knowledge (arcana), and Spellcraft, with 2 cross-class ranks in Hide. No familiar is present in this encounter.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small longbow +5 ranged with ordinary arrows, 1d6−1 piercing (minimum 1), critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment.

Racial SLAs at CL 8, each 1/day. Lesser confusion DC 15, dancing lights, all four alignment detects, detect thoughts DC 16, dispel magic, entangle DC 15, and permanent image DC 20 for visual and auditory effects only.

Sorcerer CL 1, five cantrip and four 1st-level castings per day. Known cantrips are detect magic, ghost sound (DC 14), mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells known are mage armor (+4 armor AC for 1 hour) and obscuring mist (1 minute).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Bren waits above the path, uses an image or sound to draw attention, and crosses while the patrol is watching the decoy.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 Warden NPC. Uses 4e character math.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Briar moves a snapped bough aside and asks which footprints the party followed.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the newly cleared trail open without drawing visitors through a nesting ground.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Hide +3, Earthstrength uses Constitution +3 for AC, and heavy shield +2. Fortitude 14, Reflex 12, Will 14 after Hardy Form adds +1 Will. Bloodied 19. Twelve healing surges at 9 HP. Toughness adds 5 HP. Armor and shield give −3 on physical skill checks.
Fey origin. Aspect of the Hunter is active, chosen after the last extended rest. Font of Life gives one extra save at the start of Briar’s turn against a save-ends effect.

Nature’s Wrath once on each of Briar’s turns marks each adjacent enemy as a free action until the end of Briar’s next turn. A marked foe takes −2 on an attack roll if the attack excludes Briar. Earthstrength adds +3 AC to the usual +2 defenses during second wind, until Briar’s next turn ends.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword, melee basic, +6 vs. AC for 1d8+3 damage.
Earth Shield Strike, at-will standard, melee. +6 vs. AC, 1d8+3 and Briar gains +1 power AC until the end of their next turn.
Weight of Earth, at-will standard, melee. +6 vs. AC, 1d8+3 and slowed until the end of Briar’s next turn.
Hungry Earth, encounter standard, close burst 1 against enemies. +6 vs. Fortitude, 1d8+3. Its area is difficult terrain for enemies through the end of Briar’s next turn.

Form of the Willow Sentinel, daily minor. Until the encounter ends, Briar can negate a pull, push, or slide against them and adjacent allies gain +2 power Fortitude. Once in this form, when an adjacent enemy attacks an ally, interrupt with +6 vs. AC. Hit deals 1d8+3 and −4 to the triggering roll. Miss deals half damage and −2 to that roll.

Warden’s Fury, at-will immediate interrupt against a marked enemy in weapon reach that makes an attack excluding Briar. +6 vs. Fortitude, 1d8+3 and the target grants combat advantage to Briar and allies through the end of Briar’s next turn.
Warden’s Grasp, at-will immediate reaction when a marked enemy within 5 makes an attack excluding Briar. Slide it 1 square, slow it and stop it shifting through the end of its current turn.

Pursuit of the Hunter, encounter immediate reaction when an enemy within 2 squares moves on its turn. Shift 3. Through the end of Briar’s next turn, hits against that enemy deal +1d6 damage and ignore its normal −2 cover or concealment penalty.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Briar marks enemies near the footbridge, then uses Weight of Earth to slow the one nearest the trail. When another foe runs, Briar follows with Pursuit of the Hunter.

printings.label: Hound Archon road warden, 6 racial HD

gm.title: Hook
lines: A hound follows the party to the milepost and then stands upright to ask whom they are looking for.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the missing travelers before night closes over the ford.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +7, all +4 against poison. Touch 11, flat-footed 19. Unarmored with natural armor +9 and Dexterity +1.
DR 10/evil, SR 16, immune to electricity and petrification. His constant CL 6 magic circle against evil gives its situational protection, outside the listed base AC and saves.

Aura of menace activates in a fight or when angry. Hostiles within 20 ft. save at Will DC 17 or take −2 to attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours or until they hit him. A successful save or a hit that ends it prevents repeat exposure for 24 hours.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Improved Initiative, Power Attack, and Track. Creatures with a language can speak with him through tongues.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite +10 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. In a full attack add a secondary slam +5 for 1d4+2 bludgeoning. Greatsword +10/+5 on a full attack, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2.
Use a canine form to follow a trail. Hide and Survival each gain +4 circumstance in canine form, before adjusting for the form's other statistics. The form supplies its own bite.
At will CL 6 aid, continual flame, detect evil, and message. Aid grants +1 morale to attacks and fear saves plus 1d8+6 temporary HP for 6 minutes.
Greater teleport at will, CL 14, carrying only himself and up to 50 lb. of objects.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brindle takes canine form to pick up a trail, then speaks to the group before closing. He opens with aid on the ally who has to hold the ford.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Brott can reach the jammed line through the flooded passage.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Free the harbor gate while the lower line is submerged.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +2. Iron Will adds +2 to Will.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning. +4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 16 gives 64 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 32 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.
Dwarven waraxe counts as martial. Weapon Focus (dwarven waraxe) is the Fighter bonus feat.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dwarven waraxe +5 melee, 1d10+3 slashing one-handed, critical ×3. Shortspear +4 melee for 1d6+3 piercing or +2 thrown above water, range increment 20 ft.

On a successful Swim check move up to 5 ft. as a move action or 10 ft. as a full-round action. Use the shortspear’s piercing attack if he must fight underwater. Apply the normal Swim or firm-footing requirement for an unpenalized underwater attack.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Brott dives to cut a jammed line in the lower harbor passage. He returns to the landing before using his waraxe and braces on firm stone when he has to hold the gate.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Bruni offers a drawing that reveals who has been removing approved reinforcement from shipments.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Close the bridge long enough to replace a failing support.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Cinder knows which passage bypasses the damaged flue.

gm.title: Role
lines: Fire mephling kiln watch and Sorcerer.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the kiln hands from being cut off.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. Unarmored, Dexterity +3, size +1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Matching Fire spells gain +1 caster level. Burning hands is CL 2. Mage armor is CL 1 and adds +4 armor for 1 hour. With mage armor AC is 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of flame (fire), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, five cantrip casts and four first-level casts per day. Cantrips at CL 1 are detect magic, light, mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells are mage armor and burning hands (15-ft. cone, 2d4 fire, Reflex DC 14 half).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Cinder watches an old kiln passage. If warned, she puts up mage armor and uses the bend to avoid catching the kiln hands in either cone. Track her breath and spell uses separately.

printings.label: Grimlock fissure tracker, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Cold Water catches a fresh scent at the foot of the fissure.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a missing climber before the culvert floods.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Track is the chosen racial Hit Die feat. Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Battleaxe +5 melee in two hands for 1d8+4 slashing, critical ×3.
Use Track with scent to follow a fresh trail. Roll Survival +0 against a typical DC of 10. Travel at half speed while tracking unless taking the penalty for moving faster.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Cold Water follows a fresh scent trail up the fissure. At the fork, he uses a move action to determine a nearby scent’s direction. If an overpowering odor spoils the trail, he falls back to familiar ground.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: He asks the party to walk the letter through the main door while he draws attention into the courtyard.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Deliver a sealed reply before the sender has to call off a duel.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Leather armor 11 + Dexterity.
Fey Ancestry. Advantage on saves against charm. Magic cannot put Copperflash to sleep.
Startling Speed, two rounds per day. After moving at least 10 ft. on his turn, attacks against him have disadvantage until the start of his next turn. Incapacitation or restraint prevents its use.
Sneak Attack once per turn adds 1d6 damage to a hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if he has advantage, or an active ally is within 5 ft. of the target and he has no disadvantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Bonus action to Dash, Disengage or Hide.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Copperflash spends his speed protection crossing open floor. If someone closes in, he Disengages before running toward the next exit.

gm.title: Hook
lines: The replacement gear is stamped with who ordered it and can be matched to the seized clock through a service hatch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get her apprentice released by proving a seized clock never left the workshop.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Corren will walk the full night if someone can carry the lamp signal across a stretch of road where the old markers are gone.

gm.title: Role
lines: Night courier escort and signal-lamp keeper.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the courier and sealed testimony across the causeway before the morning hearing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (longsword). Climb and Jump include −3 combined armor and shield check penalty.
2 PP per day from Naturally Psionic. The reserve powers the racial abilities.
Resistance: 1 PP, immediate action, +4 racial bonus to all saves until the start of the next action. Resilience: immediate action, reduce incoming damage by 2 HP per PP spent.
Repletion: 1 PP for 24 hours without food or water. A flat-footed Elan cannot use either immediate defense. All three abilities draw from the same reserve.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Javelin +2 thrown, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. range increment.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Signal the courier through with the hooded lamp. Put the shield between the courier and trouble. If the route is too long to stop for supplies, spend 1 PP on Repletion before leaving and keep the other for a defense.

printings.label: Skarn stone stair marshal, Monk 1 substitution

gm.title: Hook
lines: Corven asks the party to lead the climbers down while he keeps the stair clear.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the last climbers off a cracked landing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and Wisdom +2. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Spine Strike replaces Monk unarmed strike. Monk features such as flurry of blows and Stunning Fist work with his arm spines. The Medium Monk 1 damage die is 1d6. He has no essentia pool.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Arm spine +3 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Flurry of blows as a full attack: two arm spine attacks at +1/+1, each 1d6+3 piercing. The −2 attack penalty also applies to his other attacks until just before his next turn.

Stunning Fist once per day as his Monk bonus feat. Declare before the spine attack roll. On a hit, Fortitude DC 12 or stunned for 1 round. A missed attack or an immune target expends the use. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits cannot be stunned by it.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Corven is clearing the stone stair after a landing has started to give way. If a pursuer catches him in place, he tries to stun it and asks the party to get the last climbers around the crack.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Célan recognizes her scent halfway down the bridge, where the trail abruptly disappears.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the partner who was supposed to meet him at the tollhouse.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Tracking 20 before situational modifiers (Wisdom 14 + 6). Detect Noise 35%. Bonus Blind-fighting.
Short sword as a weapon proficiency.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Infravision 60 feet, keen hearing and smell.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Coat is ordinary clothing. Base AC 10 improved by 1 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Lightly equipped ranger. Hide in Shadows 10% and Move Silently 15% in natural surroundings. Halve these chances in unfamiliar enclosed or urban conditions.

Against his chosen species enemy, gnolls, attack at +4 and take −4 on reactions. Célan can befriend a calm animal. A wild or attack-trained animal must fail a save against rods at −1 for him to shift its reaction by one category.
Recognizes werewolves in any form 99% of the time or another lupin in an unusual form 15% of the time. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.

Recognizes familiar peoples by scent and makes an Intelligence check to identify a known individual by scent. Strong odors impose −1 to −4. Take −2 on saving throws against sound or odor. Swallowed wolfsbane kills on a failed poison save or costs 20 HP on a success. Injected wolfsbane halves ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed poison save.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 piercing against small or medium targets or 1d8 against large targets. Speed factor 3.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Célan tracks from the edge of the road, relays the route quietly, and draws his sword only if the trail leads into a fight.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Dane can keep watch at the opening if the party helps secure the worn latch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the repairers through a warped mill gate before it gives way.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3 or +4 while shifting. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.
Weapon Focus (short sword) is the Fighter bonus feat. Healing Factor is a shifter feat. Its extra round makes this shift last 6 rounds. Heal 1 HP when a shift ends while Dane is alive.
Razorclaw shifts once per day as a free action. Strength rises from 15 to 17 and two claws become available while shifting.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +4 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. While shifting, +5 melee and 1d6+3 piercing if used alone.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
While shifting, one claw as a standard action or both as a full attack. Each claw is +4 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing.
First-printing mixed full attack while shifting. Apply −2 to both attacks. Short sword +3 melee for 1d6+3 and light off-hand claw +2 melee for 1d4+1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Dane asks the party to secure the mill latch while the repairers file through. He uses Razorclaw if something gets through the gap and switches between a single short sword attack and a two-claw full attack when he has the time and room.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: The badgers can tell Dara which branch is blocked.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Evacuate trapped workers from the cutbank without losing the open tunnel.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Dwarven, and communication with badgers as speak with animals.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Scale mail +4, touch 10, flat-footed 14. Armor check penalty −4. The medium armor leaves land speed at 20 ft.
BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +0, Will +1. Alertness and the Fighter bonus feat Weapon Focus (claw).
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Strength-based resistance is +6, or +8 during Fury.

Fury (Ex), 1/day. After taking at least 1 point of damage, the Wildren can activate Fury at the start of its next turn. For one round, it gains +4 Strength and takes −2 AC. It cannot end Fury voluntarily. Fury stacks with barbarian rage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One claw +4 melee as a standard attack, or two claws at +4 each in a full attack. Each deals 1d4+2 piercing and slashing, critical ×2, reach 5 ft.
During Fury, claws attack at +6 each for 1d4+4 and AC drops to 12 for one round.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Dara asks the local badgers which exit is blocked, then guards the open tunnel while the party escorts trapped workers out. She can dig a fresh one-person warren in loose soil if she has an hour.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Daranvar can hold the crossing while the party checks the construct for its maker’s mark.

gm.title: Role
lines: Destroyer aspect. Grove threshold steward and Fighter.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a stray construct out of a seedling grove while a druid finds its control mark.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Destroyer is Daranvar’s active aspect. Weapon Focus (longspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The Killoren Destroyer feat can daze a foe hit by an eligible smite.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longspear +4 melee, 1d8+3 piercing, critical ×3, reach 10 ft., usable against foes beyond adjacent squares. Club +3 melee adjacent, 1d6+2 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×2.

Destroyer smite twice per day, at most once per hour. Smite with longspear +6 for 1d8+4 or club +5 for 1d6+3. Valid targets are aberrations, constructs, humanoids, oozes, outsiders, and undead. An invalid target spends the use.
On a successful smite against an eligible target, Killoren Destroyer requires Will DC 12 or dazes that target for 1 round.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Keep the construct on the path and away from the seedlings while the party looks for its control mark. Hold the crossing with the longspear. Save the smite for a clear hit on the construct.

printings.label: Duskling forest corridor watch, Barbarian 1 substitution

gm.title: Hook
lines: Darevia can lead the party between clearings and hold the corridor long enough for the family to cross.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a delayed family before the forest corridor closes for the night.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Jump +9 at 40 ft., +5 at 30 or 35 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Class illiteracy applies.

One essentia, invested in Incarnum Speed by default. In light gear it gives 40-ft. speed and initiative +7. Without that investment, base speed is 30 ft. and initiative +5 with Improved Initiative. Moving the point to the racial feature instead gives 35-ft. speed and initiative +5.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives a +10-ft. enhancement bonus to base land speed with up to medium armor and a medium load. Each point also gives +2 insight on initiative checks, regardless of armor or load. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Greatclub +3 melee, 1d10+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. While raging, +5 melee and 1d10+6 damage.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. While raging, 1d6+4 damage.

Ordinary rage once per day, at most once per encounter, up to 8 rounds. While raging, HP 15, AC 12, touch 9, flat-footed 11, grapple +5, Fortitude +7, Reflex +1, Will +3. STR 19, CON 20, Climb +7, and Jump +11 at 40 ft. Remove 2 bonus HP at the end. Fatigue lasts through the encounter with −2 Strength and Dexterity and no running or charging.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Darevia wants a party to escort a delayed family through the forest corridor before it closes at dusk. She keeps a point in Incarnum Speed as she moves between clearings and rages to hold the narrow opening if a creature follows.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Daro can reach the platform from the gantry after the lower stairs collapse.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach the winch and bring the deck crew to safety.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.

Gliding. While using its membranes to glide, a Hadozee takes no damage from a fall of any height. It can travel 20 ft. horizontally for each 5 ft. descended, with glide speed 40 ft. and average maneuverability in the p. 41 player rules. Gliding requires descent.
Hadozee have +4 racial bonuses on Balance and Climb. They keep their Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing and can climb with one hand occupied.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortspear +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown shortspear +4 for 1d6+3 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Climb with the shortspear in one hand and keep Dexterity +2 to AC. From the gantry, glide across a clear 20-ft. gap to a platform 5 ft. lower.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Daro gets to the winch platform to lower the rescue line. He uses the spar as cover while waiting for a clear descent to the platform and handles the shortspear once he lands.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Daro plants his shield at the narrowest part of the route and asks for an opening signal.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold a choke point while the caravan gets its animals clear.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Thirteen healing surges, worth 7 each, including Mul Vitality.
Scale armor, heavy shield, and longsword. One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to attacks. Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with heavy blades.
Born of Two Races choice is dwarf. Tireless requires 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours for an extended rest.

Combat Challenge can mark each target Daro attacks through the end of his next turn. A mark penalizes attacks omitting him by −2. If his adjacent marked foe shifts or attacks without targeting him, immediate interrupt for a melee basic attack.
Combat Superiority gives +1 to opportunity attacks. A hit stops the movement that provoked it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC, 1d8+5 damage. As an opportunity attack, +9.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5 and 4 damage to another enemy adjacent to Daro on a hit.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard using a shield. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. Push the target 1 if Large or smaller, then Daro can shift into its former square.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5 and lets an ally adjacent to the target shift 2.

Villain’s Menace, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5, with +2 power bonus to attacks and +4 to damage versus that foe through the encounter. Miss gains +1 to attacks and +2 to damage against it instead.
Incredible Toughness, encounter, no action at turn start. End ongoing damage or a dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses Tide of Iron to regain the choke point. Saves Incredible Toughness for a turn when a condition would keep him from covering the caravan.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 2d10+4, plus 2 HP while attached
Challenge · Provisional CR 3 with crawling gauntlet attached. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Deren taps his chitinous fingers on the hatch and asks the party who sent them.

gm.title: Role
lines: Hatch guard with a crawling gauntlet.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep unscheduled visitors away from the sealed lower gallery.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Chain shirt +4, heavy steel shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16, armor check penalty −4. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus adds +1 to the claw. Power Attack can trade up to 2 attack for the same damage bonus on the claw.
Crawling gauntlet starts attached. AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 13, 4 HP when targeted directly. Attacking the visible gauntlet in place of Deren provokes from Deren.

Attaching or removing the gauntlet deals 1d3 Constitution damage. The listed Constitution assumes recovery from an earlier attachment. The gauntlet communicates telepathically with its host and has Ego 3.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Unbalanced Mind Will DC 10. Will +5 if the gauntlet enters a personality conflict against its Ego DC 3.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Gauntlet claw +6 melee, 1d4+4 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. It is Deren’s sole natural weapon and adds one and a half times his Strength bonus. The shield is on his other arm.
With full Power Attack, claw +4 melee, 1d4+6. The attached gauntlet grants the claw to Deren, who uses his own attack and damage modifiers.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Deren checks who has clearance while holding the hatch behind his shield. He offers to let the party pass if they can identify the person who sent them.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Dessa can call along the route while the party checks the downhill forks for the missing lookout.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the lookout who missed the final drum call in a whiteout.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Space and natural reach 10 ft. Studded leather +3, natural armor +4, size −1. Touch 9, flat-footed 16. Armor check penalty −1.
BAB +1, grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Fast Movement adds 10 ft. before armor and load modifiers. With studded leather and a light load, speed is 40 ft. and the resulting +4 speed bonus is included in Jump.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large greatclub +5 melee, 2d8+7 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 10-ft. reach. While raging, +7 to hit and 2d8+10 damage.
Large javelin +0 ranged, 1d8+5 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. While raging, damage increases to 1d8+7.

Rage once per day and once per encounter for up to 8 rounds. Dessa can enter Rage on her turn without spending an action. While raging, Str 25, Con 20, HP 17, AC 14, touch 7, flat-footed 14, grapple +12, Fortitude +7, Reflex +0, Will +3. When Rage ends, lose the 2 bonus HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter (−2 Str and Dex, no running or charging).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Dessa drums the ridge routes so walkers can count the turns in a whiteout. Her partner missed the last reply. She asks the party to follow the calls downhill and uses rage if the group is trapped on the ridge.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 40 ft. with fast movement; base 30 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Diamond Hand guards the bend that leads to the pack’s water cistern.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Cover the retreat of her hunt-bonded companion.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +7. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +3. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fast Movement and illiteracy.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for twice that amount of damage when wielding the battleaxe in two hands.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Battleaxe +7 melee in two hands for 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. During rage, AC 14, HP 35 at full health, grapple +9, Fortitude +7, Reflex +5, Will +5, and two-handed battleaxe +9 for 1d8+9. When rage ends, lose the 6 HP from increased Constitution and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter.
