If a silence effect takes away hearing, use scent to find the direction of a creature within 30 ft. or pinpoint it within 5 ft. Without blindsight, Blind-Fight allows a reroll of a melee miss chance from concealment when attacking a located creature.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Diamond Hand waits where the passage bends within 40 ft. When a silence spell breaks her blindsight, she backs toward her hunt-bonded companion and uses scent to locate anyone close enough to threaten them.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Doma can show the party where a public bridge used to stand. The landowner who removed it will be there at dusk.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a seasonal crossing both families can use without abandoning either herd.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

printings.label: Derro tunnel guide, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 4 (3 racial HD, LA +1 under Underdark).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Dorr knows where the old road reenters the rock below the exposed ridge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring the group through the covered crossing before the passage closes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1, and natural armor +2. Touch 14, flat-footed 15. BAB +3, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +6, Will +6. Spell resistance 15.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Blind-Fight allows one reroll of a concealment miss chance on a melee attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small light crossbow +7 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Small dagger +5 melee for 1d3+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2.
Ghost sound is Will DC 13 to disbelieve if interacted with. Daze is Will DC 13. Sound burst deals 1d8 sonic damage and has Fortitude DC 15 against its 1-round stun.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Dorr leads the group through a covered passage and uses ghost sound to draw attention away from the crossing. If forced to travel above ground, he tracks time spent in sunlight and seeks a covered route.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 class HD, LA +4).
Speed · 20 ft. in armor or under load

gm.title: Hook
lines: Dorrin asks the party to hold the approach while he crosses to the broken fitting.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach a trapped work crew before its air runs out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Chainmail +5, heavy steel shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −7. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded. Speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework, including a reactive check within 10 ft. An Urdunnir can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+4 racial bonus on saves against poison and +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.
+4 dodge AC against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus adds +1 to dwarven waraxe attacks. Power Attack can trade up to 2 attack for the same damage bonus with a one-handed waraxe.
Dorrin is from the Oldonnar region and weighs 230 lb. His Stone Walk payload limit is 460 lb.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dwarven waraxe +6 melee, 1d10+3 slashing, critical ×3. Apply +1 against orcs and goblinoids.

Stone Walk (Su) allows passage through stone and earth as though through air. The Urdunnir can bring up to twice their body weight. The Urdunnir and any passengers must hold their breath within the material.

Stone Shape (Sp), at will, caster level 8. Standard action, touch, up to 18 cu. ft. of stone, instantaneous, no save or spell resistance. Makes rough forms. A shape with moving parts has a 30% failure chance.

Shape Metal (Sp), at will once per round, caster level 8. Full-round action, touch, up to 5 cu. ft. of metal, instantaneous, Fortitude negates and spell resistance applies. Fortitude DC 15 where applicable, melee touch +5. Shape Metal can reduce a touched armor’s protection by 1d6 (half for mostly nonmetal armor). Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. Touching an unwilling creature or an item it holds requires a melee touch attack and normally provokes from that defender.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Dorrin guards the workers while they clear a collapse. He takes the shorter known route through the stone and uses Shape Metal on a bent fitting with the others holding the approach.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Dovar will backtrack as far as an avalanche scar. He needs another lookout to watch the slope while he follows the tracks.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover the mule that carries the valley's winter letters before a rival guide is blamed for losing them.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Edda asks the bent roots what crossed the path that morning.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find what damaged the orchard path.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Int +2 and Wis +5.
Seedspeech exchanges simple ideas with living plants through speech and touch. Communal gives History +4 for local community and cultural history.
Spellcasting uses Wisdom. Spell save DC 13 and spell attack +5. Cantrips guidance and shillelagh. Two 1st-level slots, with animal friendship, entangle, goodberry, and healing word prepared.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d6 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed.
Shillelagh (bonus action). For 1 minute, the staff is magical and attacks at +5 for 1d8+3 bludgeoning.
Entangle. Creatures in the 20-ft. square make a DC 13 Strength save or become restrained. A restrained creature can spend an action to try a DC 13 Strength check. Concentration up to 1 minute.
Healing word (bonus action). A creature within 60 ft. regains 1d4+3 HP.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Edda asks the roots what was dragged across the orchard path. If a pursuer arrives, she uses entangle to cover the party’s retreat.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Edris can match the stamp to one of three old molds once the party gets access to the sealed warehouse.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find who reused an obsolete guild stamp before the apprentice who discovered it is dismissed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Wizard 3. Proficiency bonus +2. Control and planar escape.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Elian asks the party to stand by his departure point while he checks whether the wayhouse has an Ethereal reflection.

gm.title: Role
lines: Investigates witnesses who vanish between planes.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Identify what is unsettling the boundary beneath an abandoned wayhouse.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. AC 15 with mage armor active. Shield can add +5 AC as a reaction after a hit or when targeted by magic missile.

Portent. After a long rest, roll two d20s and record them. Before a visible creature or Elian makes an attack roll, save, or ability check, replace the roll with one recording. Each can be used once and only one can be used per turn.

Fade Away, once per long rest. Use an action to enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute, cut off from interactions with the Material Plane. Return as a bonus action or when it ends, at the closest free space to the departure point.
Planar Outcast. Self-only feather fall and blur each once per day through the species. Blur requires concentration for up to 1 minute.
Arcane Recovery. Once per day after a short rest, recover expended wizard spell slots totaling up to two levels.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+2 piercing.
Fire bolt. +5 ranged spell attack, range 120 ft., 1d10 fire. Other cantrips are mage hand and prestidigitation.

Wizard spells, DC 13 and +5 spell attack. Four 1st-level slots and two 2nd-level slots. Prepared 1st level spells are mage armor, magic missile, and shield. Prepared 2nd level spells are detect thoughts, invisibility, and misty step.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Elian prefers to preserve a witness and escape with a statement. He uses invisibility to withdraw, or Fade Away to wait out danger near his departure point.

printings.label: Sea Kin tidal lock warden, Fighter 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Emmoran can reach the submerged catch if the party keeps the dry platform clear.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Open the jammed tide gate before the returning boats run out of time.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Swim +10 on hazards and special actions

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.

Constitution 14 gives 112 rounds of held breath, or 56 rounds if he takes a standard or full-round action each round. Each such action spends one extra round. Once the budget runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and increasing by 1 each round. Failure starts drowning.
With a swim speed, he can take 10 on Swim checks for hazards or special actions even when threatened.

Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (trident). Weapon Familiarity makes the net and trident simple weapons. Fighter grants proficiency with them. The two armor penalties total −2, doubled to −4 for Swim.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Trident +4 melee wielded one-handed, 1d8+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. The swim speed permits normal piercing melee attacks underwater.

Net +2 ranged touch when folded (−2 unfolded), maximum 10 ft., used from the dry platform against a Small to Large target. A hit entangles the target, giving −2 on attacks, −4 Dexterity, half speed, and no running or charging. The target needs Concentration DC 15 to cast a spell. Emmoran can hold the trailing rope and win an opposed Strength check to limit movement to the rope’s reach.

Escape the net with Escape Artist DC 20 or burst it with Strength DC 25, either as a full-round action. The net has 5 HP and takes Emmoran 2 rounds to refold. Thrown weapons are ineffective underwater.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Have the party hold the dry platform while checking the lock’s catch below. Keep the trident for underwater defence. Use the net only from the platform against a target above water.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1, ECL 4 from Table A–25.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Fenn offers to lead the party around the crossing if they can keep the other travelers quiet.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Clear a narrow path for the animals crossing the trail at dusk.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Tiny +2, Dexterity +6, natural armor +2. Touch 18, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −10, Fortitude +1, Reflex +8, Will +4. Spell resistance 17. Improved Initiative and bonus Dodge (+1 AC against one designated opponent).
A 2½-ft. face and 0-ft. reach. Entering an enemy’s square to make a melee attack provokes an attack of opportunity.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Attuned fiddle. While Fenn plays, a nonsprite within 30 ft. must make a DC 15 Will save or suffer the effects of Otto’s irresistible dance. It can only dance, takes −4 AC, loses the use of its shield, and can succeed on a Reflex save only by rolling a natural 20. The effect ends when Fenn stops playing.

Change self, entangle, invisibility (self only), pyrotechnics, and ventriloquism each 3/day at caster level 9. Entangle needs plants and hampers movement even if the target succeeds on the DC 14 Reflex save. Pyrotechnics uses DC 15 Will for fireworks or DC 15 Fortitude for the smoke penalties.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Fenn entangles pursuers where the brush is thick and escapes invisibly. He uses the fiddle only when nearby travelers can afford to stop moving.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Flint has found a stretch of loose earth beside the fallen wall.

gm.title: Role
lines: Earth mephling cutwall digger and Druid.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a way to the trapped cellar keeper.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, size +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −2 with the shield. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5.

Nature sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild empathy +1. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. This encounter starts with no animal companion present.
Matching earth spells gain +1 caster level. None of the prepared spells listed have the Earth descriptor.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of rock shards and pebbles (bludgeoning), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 12 half. No attack roll.
Druid spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First level spells are cure light wounds (1d8+1) and entangle (Reflex DC 14, lasts 1 minute and needs vegetation).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Flint digs around a blocked root cellar through loose earth. If an attacker follows outside, he uses entangle where roots and weeds grow, then gives the party room to pass.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Eshara can open the bypass hatch if the party prevents the inspection winch from moving.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Map the bypass gate before the weighmaster orders the chamber flooded.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +0.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.

Aesh and Uur add +2 to Strength and Dexterity checks and related skill checks. Bonuses are already included. With sigils doused, initiative drops to +2 and Climb, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock, and Tumble drop to +7.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.

Final Utterance lasts 2 rounds. Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device checks against magic traps. Evasion negates damage on a successful Reflex save for half while in light or no armor. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Eshara flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Eshara can see and reach and no concealment from her.
Aeshuur gives +2 dodge AC against a creature Eshara damages with a sneak attack or critical hit. The bonus lasts until the start of Eshara’s next turn and requires lit sigils.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Eshara will survey the lock chamber if the party keeps the winch still. She douses her sigils before hiding and relights them to work at the lock. In a fight she flanks an opponent with an ally to trigger Aeshuur.

printings.label: Feral Gargun river salvage guide, Feral Gargun monster class 2

gm.title: Hook
lines: Gorren can climb down to the chest while the party holds the raft at the pier.

gm.title: Role
lines: River salvage guide and Feral Gargun monster class 2.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Retrieve a missing toll chest before the river rises over the ledge.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unarmored. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 11. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +2.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Toughness adds 3 hp. Four ranks each in Climb and Survival. Jump is untrained.
At monster-class level 2, Gorren has one racial Hit Die, 1d4 claws and cold resistance 5. The second racial Hit Die, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws arrive at level 3.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortspear +4 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Thrown +2 ranged, 20-ft. increment and the same damage.
Primary claws +4 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the shortspear in one hand, add the free claw at −1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing and slashing.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Gorren points out the ledge where a toll chest dropped during the ferry crossing. He offers to climb down on the river side if the party holds the raft against the pier.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 20 ft. in half-plate; base 30 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Gorvak is holding the landing below a shuttered light shaft.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the forge passage clear until the smiths reach shelter.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Masterwork half-plate +7 and natural armor +2. Touch 10, flat-footed 19. Armor check penalty −6. BAB +1, grapple +6. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +0.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds an orog for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
+2 racial bonus on Craft (armorsmithing) and Craft (weaponsmithing) checks.
Racial proficiency with the greatsword and throwing axe.
Orc Blood. An orog counts as an orc for racial effects, including the use or creation of magic items with orc-specific powers.
Weapon Focus (greatsword) adds +1 to greatsword attacks. Power Attack can trade 1 point of melee attack bonus for 2 damage with the greatsword.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Masterwork greatsword +8 melee in two hands for 2d6+7 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. With Power Attack, attack at +7 for 2d6+9.
After an abrupt exposure to daylight blinds him for 1 round, sustained bright light reduces the normal greatsword attack to +7, Craft checks to +6, and saves to Fortitude +3, Reflex −1, Will −1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Gorvak holds the passage by the forge in low light. He moves the fight away from the surface opening when a shutter lets daylight through. His resistance reduces the first 5 points of fire or cold damage from an applicable instance.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Grip can hold the lower landing while the party guides the workers out.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the last workers up the steps before the broken grate gives out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Unarmored, natural armor +1, Dexterity +1, Wisdom +2. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +7 with Improved Grapple. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.

Improved Grapple is his Monk bonus feat. Grip can initiate a grapple with a +3 melee touch attack without provoking for the attempt, then makes the opposed grapple check at +7. Winning that check establishes the grapple and deals 1d6+3 unarmed damage.
Natural armor +1, acid resistance 5, and DR 2/piercing or slashing. Either piercing or slashing bypasses the DR. The official errata corrects the first printing’s DR label.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Unarmed strike +3 melee, 1d6+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Unarmed flurry +1/+1, 1d6+3 each. Spike attack separately at +3 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2.

In an existing grapple, use Damage Your Opponent and win the opposed check at +7 to deal 1d6+3 piercing with the spikes in place of unarmed damage. There is no spike damage on unrelated grapple checks.
With the grappling Attack Your Opponent option, attack AC with the light spikes at −1 after the −4 penalty, for 1d6+3 piercing. The Improved Grapple bonus does not add to that attack roll.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Grip leads the last cistern workers past a broken grate. He can hold a foe in a grapple while the party clears the steps. He only uses his spikes to deal damage if the threat persists.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: She offers to inspect a loose waystone if somebody keeps the travelers within reach of her shield.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a party of lost travelers together through a moonless passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. AC 17 from 13 + Dexterity + shield.
Powerful Build. Halla counts as Large when determining carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting capacity.
Cloak of Night. In dim light or darkness, Halla has advantage on Stealth checks and can Hide as a bonus action when able to hide.
Protection fighting style. With shield in hand, use a reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack from someone Halla can see against another target within 5 ft. of her.
Action Surge once per short or long rest gives one extra action on her turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 slashing.
Bite. Melee unarmed attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Second Wind. Bonus action, recover 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Halla positions her shield beside the first traveler to reach the stones. She uses the dark verge for cover when the waystone needs to be inspected.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Hollis asks the party to move away from the bridge mouth, leaving him room to drive a hostile creature back.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the washed-out bridge clear until rope crews can reach the far side.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Scale mail, shield, Defense fighting style. Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. Disadvantage on Stealth.
Pronghorn Cervan. Carry up to 480 lb. Push, drag, or lift up to 960 lb.
Surge of Vigor once per long rest. An attack dealing more than half current HP immediately triggers healing of 1d12+3, including a hit that drops Hollis to 0 HP.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 slashing with shield equipped. Antlers +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.

Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward the opponent, spend a bonus action for an extra 1d6 piercing on the gore. Large or smaller targets must make a DC 13 Strength save or be pushed 10 ft. away into a space Hollis chooses.
Action Surge grants one extra action. Second Wind restores 1d10+2 HP as a bonus action. Each recharges on a short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Hollis leaves a clear rush lane, starts behind the barricade, and uses the antlers to drive a foe away from the rigging crew.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Hushush finds the traders’ tracks beside two fresh trails. One is their own route in reverse, although they swear they never turned around.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring the salt traders back through a pass before their lantern oil runs out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +2 and Dexterity save +4. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity.
Margreve Within. Poison resistance, advantage on saves against poison and 30 minutes of direct sunlight can meet daily food needs. Margreve Without gives Hushush barklike skin.
Favored Enemy (beasts). Advantage on Survival checks to track beasts and Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

Natural Explorer (forest). Double proficiency for proficient Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to forest terrain. After at least an hour of travel, difficult terrain does not slow the group and only magic can get it lost. Hushush remains alert while busy, can travel stealthily at normal pace alone, finds twice the food when foraging, and learns exact count, sizes and elapsed time when tracking.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +2, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 bludgeoning, or 1d8 with two hands.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 piercing.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Hushush leads travelers along routes where they can still turn back. They use their staff to check footing and defend themselves if cornered.

printings.label: River Spirit Folk ferry healer, Adept 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ilen can ask fish which side of the old pier the passenger surfaced on, then dress their wounds once the group gets them ashore.

gm.title: Role
lines: River lineage ferry healer who can guide an underwater rescue

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a missing ferry passenger before the current takes them past the landing.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Swim +7 for hazards or special actions

gm.title: Traits
lines: River lineage. Breathes air and water. No routine swim check. Take 10 under pressure for Swim 17, and run while swimming in a straight line.
Unarmored. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 10. Base attack bonus +0. Fortitude +0, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Add +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects with water in their names, water shugenja spells, and water-related wu jen spells.
Skill Focus (Heal) adds +2 in D&D 3.0. Prepared divine spells CL 1, DC 11 + spell level where applicable. Carries a divine focus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club. Melee −1, reach 5 ft., 1d6−1 bludgeoning (minimum 1), critical ×2.
Prepared cantrips. Cure minor wounds twice per day, touch, restores 1 HP per cast. Create water once per day, creates up to two gallons of clean water.
Prepared 1st-level spells. Cure light wounds once per day, touch, restores 1d8+1 HP. Bless once per day, allies in a 50-ft. burst gain +1 morale to attack rolls and saves against fear for 1 minute.
River lineage. Speak with animals once per day for up to 1 minute, CL 1, fish only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Move injured passengers behind cover, use healing on the worst injury, and use the river route when the landing is unsafe. Cast bless if allies need to hold the crossing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ili asks the party to compare the night's watch fires with the account they were given.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Clear a fellow witness whose night journey was entered on the wrong route sheet.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 3 by the Karsite PC-class formula. ECL 4 (2 class HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ilyra asks for a name before she opens the workshop door.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the apprentices out of a fight over a shield they repaired.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16, armor check penalty −4. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Damage reduction 5/magic. Spell resistance 12. A spell blocked by spell resistance heals Ilyra 2 HP per spell level. Cannot cast arcane or divine spells.
Ability Focus (Magic-Draining Attacks) raises the suppression save DC by 2. Iron Will, Weapon Focus (longsword), and Power Attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +6 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, 19–20/×2. Power Attack can trade up to 2 attack bonus for equal additional damage with the one-handed sword.

After each hit, the target makes a DC 14 Will save or one magical weapon, armor, or shield is suppressed for 1 round. If Ilyra can see a known magical item of the right kind, she chooses it. Otherwise, determine the item randomly.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ilyra stands between intruders and the apprentices. She uses the sword to suppress equipment when fighting a heavily armored rival.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ilyra can fly the dispatch to the next ridge, but asks the party to retrieve the lantern marking her landing site.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Deliver a warning before the mountain winds turn.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Infravision 60 ft. Resolves daytime detail over a mile away.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. HP 8 on 1d10. No armor or shield and −3 Dexterity to AC. Wings are AC 6 and use the species profile’s hit rules.

At 90 lb., flight is class B through 45 lb. of carried gear and C through 90 lb. Make a Constitution check each hour, target 13 before the profile’s load, wind and altitude adjustments. At 4 HP remaining, glide only. At 2 HP remaining, lose gliding.
Resists sleep and charm spells 30% of the time. Her wings and daily Wisdom checks for confinement follow the player profile.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortsword, effective THAC0 19 from the species bonus. Deals 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets and 1d8 vs. Large targets.
Signal with chest light. Turn the light on, off or pulse it at will. Use a rehearsed pulse to identify the next safe landing.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ilyra lands in the open to relay the dispatch and blinks a warning before flying on.

printings.label: Mind Flayer sealed-archive warden, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 8. ECL 15 (8 racial HD, LA +7).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ilyth offers a safe route out if the party returns the ledger intact.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep visitors away from the sealed record chamber.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Aquan, Common, Draconic, Terran, Undercommon

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and natural armor +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +6, grapple +7. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +9. Spell resistance 25.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for tentacle attacks. Weapon Focus (tentacle) adds +1 on those attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One tentacle +10 melee for 1d4+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2. A full attack uses four tentacles at +10 each.
Mind Blast Will DC 18. Charm monster Will DC 18, detect thoughts Will DC 16, and suggestion Will DC 17.
Starting with one attached tentacle, roll grapple +7 to attach the rest. If all four are attached at the start of a later turn, a successful grapple check then permits Extract.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ilyth contacts intruders telepathically from the archive entrance and tries to get them to leave. If a fight starts, Ilyth lines up Mind Blast clear of allies and leaves through the inner door if the archive cannot be held.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Iona can follow a familiar scent across bare stone if the party identifies the right bundle of gear.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Locate a missing pack train before its tracks wash away.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +1.
Alertness and bonus Track. Wild Empathy +0. Favored enemy magical beasts adds +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival against magical beasts.
Wildhunt shifts once per day as a free action for 6 rounds. Constitution rises from 14 to 16. HP rises from 10 to 11 and Fortitude from +4 to +5. Remove the 1 bonus HP when shifting ends.

Wildhunt scent detects a creature at 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Double those ranges for strong odors and triple them for overpowering odors. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., pinpoint the source.

While shifting, a Wildhunt Shifter with Track can follow scent using Survival. A typical fresh trail is DC 10 and adds +2 per hour, with adjustments for odor and group size. Ignore surface and poor-visibility modifiers.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +2 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iona follows a fresh scent once the party identifies which equipment belonged to the missing pack train. She saves Wildhunt for the stretch where the trail crosses bare rock.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
Speed · 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)

gm.title: Hook
lines: Iona needs help clearing the quay before the next ferry arrives.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring the last ferrymen out of the quay passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Material Plane. Scale mail +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.
Aura of good. Detect evil at will as the spell. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to longsword attack rolls.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Smite Evil 1/day with a normal melee attack. With the longsword against an evil target, attack at +8 for 1d8+4. An attempt against a non-evil target has no smite effect and uses the daily use.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for another 60 ft. Lasts 10 minutes and can be dismissed. It applies bright-light penalties without damaging creatures harmed only by actual sunlight. A lightproof cover blocks the effect on a small object. Where it overlaps magical darkness, use the otherwise prevailing light.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iona leads the last ferrymen out of a dark quay passage. She puts daylight on a lantern and gives it to a ferryman so she can defend the group. Save Smite Evil for a confirmed evil foe.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ira needs an independent witness for the passenger list before either estate tries to seize the ferry.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep two feuding estates from bringing their own guards to the landing.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Iri can see a place to land beside the porters if someone opens the shuttered terrace.

gm.title: Role
lines: Pass medic and Cleric of Shaundakul.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 15, armor check penalty −3. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +6.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.

Cleric of Shaundakul. Travel grants freedom of movement against magical impediments for up to 2 rounds/day. Air grants 4 shared uses/day to turn or destroy earth creatures or rebuke or command air creatures.
Combat Casting gives +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Cleric caster level 2. Prepared orisons, 4 slots, DC 13. Detect magic, guidance, light, and cure minor wounds (heals 1 HP).

Prepared 1st level, 3 slots plus 1 domain slot, DC 14 when relevant. Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+2 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain longstrider (+10 ft. to own land speed for 2 hours). Can swap prepared non-domain spells for cure spells.
Turn undead 4/day, Charisma check 1d20+1, turning damage 2d6+3. Air domain uses its own pool and the same check and damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iri starts with bless when there is time. She flies to a clear landing near the injured and treats them on the ground.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Iriavel can cross the broken span and set a guide rope if the party braces the anchor.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Carry a line past the snapped ropeway anchor before the next storm.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Jump +4 or +6 with 1 essentia in landshark boots

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.

Two essentia, one racial and one from Totemist. Capacity 1 per investment. Meldshaper level 1. Shapes two unbound melds, blink shirt and landshark boots. Wild Empathy +1. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Class illiteracy applies.
Default allocation is 1 essentia in racial speed and 1 in blink shirt, giving 35-ft. movement and a 20-ft. teleport.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Blink shirt teleports the Totemist alone at will as a standard action. Range is 10 ft. plus 10 ft. per invested essentia. Take no further actions until the next turn.

Landshark boots give +4 competence on Jump, or +6 with 1 essentia. Moving the point from blink shirt to the boots keeps 35-ft. speed, changes teleport range from 20 to 10 ft., and raises Jump from +4 to +6.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iriavel can take a coil of line across the broken end of a ropeway by jumping or teleporting. He tells the party which span he can cross before asking them to brace the worn anchor.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Irimel can find old warning lines and pinpoint someone calling from the fog if the party keeps the trail open.

gm.title: Role
lines: Hunter aspect. Fog trail ward and Rogue.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Guide the last group of travellers around a flooded stretch before the markers go under.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +0.

Low-light vision, magical sleep immunity, +2 racial saves against enchantments, +2 racial Handle Animal and Survival. The listed weapons use ordinary materials. Apply −2 to attacks using wholly or partly cold-iron weapons, including cold-iron arrows.
Hunter is Irimel’s active aspect for this encounter. Initiative, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, and Spot already include the Hunter +2.
Killoren Hunter feat can pinpoint a living creature within 30 ft. as a move action, with line of effect. An unseen creature keeps total concealment.

Trapfinding permits searching for traps with a DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. The kit includes ordinary thieves’ tools. Sneak Attack +1d6 applies to eligible attacks, with a 30-ft. limit for ranged attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +0 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Shortbow +2 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. range increment.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Search the marked path for old alarms and keep travellers off the flooded stretch. If a living creature moves nearby in the fog, pinpoint it before asking anyone to approach.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 20 ft. even in medium or heavy armor

gm.title: Hook
lines: Irsa points to the tracks across the ice and asks the party to wait while she checks the crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a path that keeps the rescue party away from the unstable shelf.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty 0. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +3, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Land speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework and a reactive check within 10 ft. An Arctic Dwarf can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+2 racial bonus on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Immune to cold. AC 18 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC.

Favored enemy giants gives +2 weapon damage and +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks used against giants. Alertness gives +2 to Listen and Spot, already included in the listed skills.
Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy +0 on a 1d20 check. May use it on magical beasts with Intelligence 1 or 2 at −4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small quarterstaff +6 melee, 1d4+6 bludgeoning when striking with one end in two hands, critical ×2. Small sling +3 ranged, 1d3+4 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 50-ft. range increment. Add +1 to either attack against orcs and goblinoids. Add +2 to damage against giants.
Track using Survival +5, or +7 against giants. Listen +9 and Spot +9 against giants.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Irsa stops at the far end of the ice shelf to identify the tracks before the party follows. She keeps the rope ready when the route crosses cracked ice.

gm.title: Hook
lines: The dispatch pouch contains two seals. Iser asks a character to take the one with their own name scratched into it.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a sealed dispatch to the next courier before the stair is cut off.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Hide armor and a light shield. Fortitude 16, Reflex 14, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge worth 6 HP.

Iser counts as living and undead. Past Life is human for prerequisites. Use death saves for Iser. If dying at 0 HP or lower, Iser can stay dazed instead of falling unconscious. A failed death save makes Iser unconscious.

Combat Challenge marks each target Iser attacks through the end of Iser’s next turn, hit or miss. The marked target takes −2 to attacks that omit Iser. When a target Iser marked shifts or makes an attack that omits Iser while adjacent to Iser, Iser can make a melee basic attack against it as an immediate interrupt.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4.
Tide of Iron (at-will, standard). Longsword and shield, melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit, Iser can push a Large or smaller target 1 square and shift into its former space.
Steel Serpent Strike (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. On a hit, slow the target and prevent it from shifting through the end of Iser’s next turn.
Comeback Strike (daily, standard, reliable). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. On a hit, Iser can spend a healing surge.
Dark Reaping (encounter, free) triggers when a creature within 5 squares drops to 0 HP. One creature Iser hits through the end of Iser’s next turn takes an additional 1d8+3 necrotic damage.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 6 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Iser’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iser blocks the doorway long enough for another courier to take the dispatch. Dark Reaping goes on a hit against whoever tries to follow.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Isette asks the party to hold a line from the dry side while she goes down the steps.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach two workers who failed to return from a sluice inspection.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Unarmored, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Sorcerer caster level 1. Casts spontaneously. Five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Save DC 13 or 14 respectively. Carries a spell component pouch and has no familiar.

Blood Quickening: Bahamut active after one hour of meditation. Up to three times during the next 24 hours, choose one evil creature targeted by or in the area of a spell she casts and add 2d6 damage to that creature.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff +0 melee, 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Magic missile (1st): standard action, one creature within 110 ft., 1d4+1 force, no attack roll or save. Spell resistance applies. With Bahamut active and a use spent on an evil creature, add 2d6 damage.
Mage armor (1st): standard action, touch, 1 hour. On Isette it raises AC to 16 and flat-footed AC to 14. Ordinary touch AC remains 12. The force armor applies against incorporeal touch attacks.

Cantrips known: detect magic (concentration, up to 1 minute, 60-ft. cone), light (object touched, 10 minutes), mage hand (one unattended nonmagical object weighing at most 5 lb. within 25 ft. while concentrating), and read magic.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Isette wants to open an inspection sluice to reach two missing workers. She casts mage armor before entering and asks the party to keep a rope on the dry side. She saves her meditation’s damage for an evil creature blocking the way.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 20 ft.; fly 40 ft. (average, light load or less)

gm.title: Hook
lines: Iskra knows where the shaft opens wide enough for a clean descent.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Light a safe landing for the party below the broken ladder.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Unarmored, with Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4. No familiar is present.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and checks while in bright light.
Luminescence (Ex). As a standard action, set skin light anywhere from off to torch brightness. The setting persists until changed. The glow fades over 10 minutes after death.

Portal Sensitive bonus feat. Find active or inactive portals with a DC 20 Search check. Passing within 5 ft. allows the check without actively searching. Add +2 to caster-level checks to discern portal properties with analyze portal.
+4 racial bonus on Move Silently checks. +2 racial bonus on saves against illusion (shadow) spells and effects and +4 on saves against psionic abilities.
Shadow Spells. Add +1 caster level when casting illusion (shadow) spells.
In bright light the crossbow attack is +3, Search is −1, and the base saves become Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +1. Apply the racial save bonuses when applicable.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small light crossbow +4 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and silent image share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 18 for 1 hour, touch 14, flat-footed 15. Silent image has Will DC 14 on interaction.
Set luminescence to a dim glow before descending. Keep carried equipment within a light load of 19½ lb.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Iskra scouts the broad shaft on the wing, then marks the landing with a steady glow. She keeps room to turn and lands before taking any heavy pack from a climber.

printings.label: Dragonborn of Bahamut ember road warden, Heart Paladin 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Joren can scout the next turn if the party keeps the wagon moving.

gm.title: Role
lines: Ember road warden and Heart Paladin.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get refugees past the dragon’s tribute collectors.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Aura of good. Former human. The rite retains the 30-ft. base speed and human identity for racial effects. The human bonus feat and skill points are gone. Iron Will adds +2 Will.
Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +3. Armor check penalty −4.
Against attacks by Dragon-type creatures, +2 dodge AC (AC 19, touch 13 when eligible for the dodge bonus). Immune to dragons’ frightful presence. Heart is his only aspect.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.
Smite evil once per day. With his longsword, +5 melee and 1d8+3 against an evil target. On another alignment, the normal attack applies and the attempt is still spent.
Heart breath: standard action, supernatural 5-ft. line, 1d8 damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire each use. Reflex DC 13 halves. Roll 1d4 rounds before using it again.
Detect evil at will, as the spell. This Paladin level grants no spells.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Joren guards a wagon carrying people who fled the dragon’s tribute collectors. He checks the next turn in the road for danger and saves his breath for a target he can catch without putting the wagon crew in the line.

printings.label: Fire Caste Dromite caravan outrider, Fighter 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Jori can get the caravan moving if the party finds a clear lane and keeps sudden noises down.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring three spooked pack beetles through a blocked tunnel with their loads intact.

gm.title: Traits
lines: AC 19 includes studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, natural armor +3, Dexterity +1, and size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 18. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1.
Fire resistance 5. Racial Blind-Fight. Improved Initiative and Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (shortspear).
Scent 30 ft. normally, 60 ft. upwind or 15 ft. downwind. Move action to find direction and pinpoint within 5 ft. Strong or overpowering scents extend detection.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point. Racial Energy Ray has its own use and consumes none of that point.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small shortspear +4 melee, reach 5 ft., or +4 thrown, 20-ft. range increment. Hit 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×2.
Fire Energy Ray once per day. Standard action, +3 ranged touch at up to 25 ft., 1d6+1 fire, no save, power resistance applies, manifester level 1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Get the loaded beetles behind a stone bend and stand between the animals and the hazard. Keep the shortspear ready and save the ray for a target outside spear reach.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kareth has a route over the gap if someone trusts her to get them to the other side.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach the far bank without losing sight of the party.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Chainmail +6 with −1 speed and −1 armor check penalty. Fortitude 15, Reflex 14, Will 14. Bloodied 11. One healing surge, worth 5 HP.
Gain +2 on saves against charm effects. Danger Sense +2 and Combat Leader +2 are included in initiative. Allies within 10 squares who see and hear Kareth gain +2 power bonus to initiative.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Wielded in one hand.
Wolf Pack Tactics (at-will, standard). Before attacking, one ally adjacent to Kareth or the target can shift 1 square as a free action. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4.

Guarding Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. One ally adjacent to Kareth or the target gains +2 power bonus to AC against the target’s attacks until the end of Kareth’s next turn.

Bastion of Defense (daily, standard). Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 3d8+4 on a hit. On a hit, allies within 5 squares gain +1 power bonus to all defenses for the encounter. Hit or miss, allies within 5 squares gain 6 temporary HP.
Inspiring Word (minor, close burst 5). Self or one ally can spend a healing surge and regain an additional 1d6 HP. Twice per encounter and once per round.
Telekinetic Leap is an encounter move action at range 10. You or one ally can fly up to 5 squares. If you choose an ally, they must stay in your line of sight throughout the flight.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 5 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Kareth’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kareth uses the leap on an ally who can see the far bank, then keeps that ally in sight throughout the crossing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Keel can hold the gate below the waterline while the party leads the crew to the landing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the flooded drain gate open long enough to get the maintenance crew out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Adamantine Body +8 armor, heavy steel shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −7 combined. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +0.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.

At 0 HP, a Warforged is disabled and gets one move or standard action per round without losing HP for strenuous actions. At −1 through −9 HP it is inert, unconscious and helpless, and loses HP only if damaged again.
Adamantine Body gives DR 2/adamantine, heavy armor, maximum Dexterity bonus +1, and 35% arcane spell failure from the plating. Weapon Focus (warhammer) is the Fighter bonus feat.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Primary slam +3 melee with a free arm, 1d4+3 bludgeoning, 5-ft. reach. The slam is the only natural weapon and uses 1½ times the Strength bonus.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Keel stands at the drain gate while the crew clears the waterlogged passage. Keel can stay submerged without breathing while holding the gate open. If threatened, Keel uses the shield to hold the landing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kel needs someone to guide the last animals while he guards the crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the flock and its handlers over the ford before reopening the road.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +3 (+5 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save). Iron Will adds +2 to Will saves.
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action that does not provoke. It returns at the start of the Bariaur’s next turn unless kept down.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +8. Light load up to 150 lb. with Strength 18. Weapon Focus (greatsword) is the Fighter bonus feat.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Greatsword +6 melee, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. A greatsword charge is +8 for the same damage.
Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +7 for 2d6+6 bludgeoning. With either charge, AC drops to 12 until the start of his next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kel holds the stone ford while livestock cross. A hostile spellcaster can test his spell resistance or target the crossing instead. Kel can voluntarily lower his resistance so an allied spell gets through if he has time to plan for it.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kerrin knows which passage has a strong current and where the rope can be secured.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a line to the far gate and bring the crew through.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2, touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water without a time limit.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.

Water Spell Power (Ex) grants +1 effective caster level for spells with the [Water] descriptor. The trait provides no spells or spell slots. A spell’s name or presence in a domain list does not supply the descriptor.
Human Blood means an Aventi counts as human for race-related effects, including human-only magic items. The Aventi traits do not grant the standard human bonus feat or extra skill points.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortspear +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown shortspear above water +4 for 1d6+3 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Use the piercing melee attack underwater. The normal underwater penalties for slashing and bludgeoning weapons do not apply to the shortspear thrust.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kerrin swims a rope through the flooded sluice and secures it at the exit. He holds position in the current while the party uses the line. If a foe follows, he fights with the shortspear in melee.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 20 ft.; fly 40 ft. (average, light load or less)

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kes can search for the portal while following the gallery wall in darkness.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a disused portal before the occupants of the lower hall return.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4, and size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +0. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Trapfinding.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and checks while in bright light.
Luminescence (Ex). As a standard action, set skin light anywhere from off to torch brightness. The setting persists until changed. The glow fades over 10 minutes after death.

Portal Sensitive bonus feat. Find active or inactive portals with a DC 20 Search check. Passing within 5 ft. allows the check without actively searching. Add +2 to caster-level checks to discern portal properties with analyze portal.
+4 racial bonus on Move Silently checks. +2 racial bonus on saves against illusion (shadow) spells and effects and +4 on saves against psionic abilities.
Shadow Spells. Add +1 caster level when casting illusion (shadow) spells.
Search is +6 in dim light and +5 in sustained bright light after the round of blindness. Keep gear within a light load of 24¾ lb. to fly.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small short sword +1 melee for 1d4 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Small shortbow +5 ranged for 1d4 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 precision damage if the target is flanked in melee or denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.

When passing within 5 ft. of a portal, roll Search against DC 20 even without actively searching. Kes finds it on a 14 or higher in dim light or a 15 or higher in sustained bright light after recovering his sight.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kes keeps his glow off and sweeps the passage close to the walls. If the shutter throws sudden daylight into the passage, Kes takes cover until his sight returns, then resumes the search.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2, ECL 3 from Table A–14.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kesh asks the party to count the stamped casks while he checks the loading roster.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out who has diverted the forge fuel before he signs the next delivery.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +2, grapple +6. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +4. Improved Initiative.
Fire immunity. Under the 3.0 fire subtype, −10 on saves against cold attacks. Take double damage when the cold attack offers no save.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Slam +6 melee, 1d4+6 bludgeoning plus 1 fire. Heat also deals 1 fire on a successful grapple and each round Kesh maintains the hold.

Spell-like abilities at caster level 10. Detect magic and enlarge 1/day each. Enlarge increases a creature’s dimensions by up to 50% for 10 minutes, granting up to +2 Strength. Fortitude DC 13 negates for an unwilling target.

Produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Produce flame is a +6 melee or +3 ranged touch attack, up to 120 ft., dealing 1d4+5 fire. It lasts 10 rounds. Pyrotechnics can blind creatures that see the source within 120 ft. for 1d4+1 rounds, Will DC 14 negates. Its smoke option blocks sight in a 20-ft. spread for 10 rounds. Fortitude DC 14 negates the smoke’s −4 Strength and Dexterity penalties.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kesh gives telepathic orders and uses smoke to keep intruders away from the fuel. He uses produce flame if an assailant can see through the smoke.

printings.label: Kesh Reedroot, Kijani trail sentinel Fighter 2

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kesh waves the party through the crossing and asks someone to warn the next sentry that the road behind them has closed.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a narrow crossing open long enough for the last travelers to pass.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier.
Plantborn. Kesh is a Plant and is immune to effects that put a creature to sleep. Kesh rests in dormancy.
Contained Fury. At 9 HP or fewer, add 1d4 damage to one weapon hit per turn. While at 9 HP or fewer, use a reaction after an attack from a visible attacker hits to raise AC to 13 for that attack.
Dueling. The listed one-handed damage includes +2 while Kesh wields the staff with no other weapon.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 5 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 3 with two hands. Contained Fury adds 1d4 bludgeoning when eligible.
Action Surge. Take one additional action this turn. One use per short or long rest.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 2 HP. One use per short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kesh holds the narrow crossing from the near side. Once wounded, he decides whether to hold the line with Contained Fury or heal with Second Wind and carry a warning to the next sentry.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Keshar will escort the healer if the party can keep the alternate gate open.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a village healer safely from the closing market to the overnight camp.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4, Dexterity +4, and natural armor +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1.
Chain shirt check penalty −2. Jump includes +4 for speed 40 ft. Listen and Move Silently include +2 racial bonuses and have no purchased ranks.
Two-Weapon Fighting is the Fighter bonus feat. Catfolk Pounce is a separate feat. It applies only when Keshar charges a flat-footed opponent.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With both short swords in a normal full attack, +1/+1, for 1d6+2 on the main hand and 1d6+1 on the off hand.

Charge one attack at +5, 1d6+2 piercing. With Catfolk Pounce on a qualifying charge, make both short sword attacks at +3/+3, with normal damage by hand. Apply the charge’s −2 AC until the start of his next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Move the healer toward the camp by the clear path and keep a separate exit open. If combat blocks the way, charge only when there is a clear line and a flat-footed foe for the pounce.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Keshen asks the party to wait while he checks where the trail goes upwind.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a missing pack animal before it reaches the ravine.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +2.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Favored enemy animals gives +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival used against animals.
Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy check 1d20. Magical beasts with Intelligence 1 or 2 impose −4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Greataxe +4 melee, 1d12+4 slashing, critical ×3. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment. Add +2 to damage against animals.
Track by scent with Survival +6, or +8 when tracking animals. Fresh scent trails typically start at DC 10 and rise by 2 per hour.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Keshen pauses where the trail turns into the wind. He marks the path for the party before moving down to the crossing.

printings.label: Rilkan warehouse roof scout, Rogue 1 substitution

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kesra can check the roof hatch and get the party inside while the loading doors are watched.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get two apprentices out before the warehouse is sealed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Armor check penalty −1. Uses ordinary thieves’ tools.
Trapfinding can locate traps with a Search DC above 20 and disarm magical traps. Kesra took the first Rilkan Rogue substitution and has no sneak attack at this level.
Improved Flanking gives the Rilkan Rogue +4 to attacks when flanking in place of the usual +2. Other Rilkans flanking that same foe also get +4. Allies of other species use the usual flanking bonus.
Racial Knowledge treats all Knowledge checks as trained, even without ranks. Its +1 competence bonus on Knowledge and bardic knowledge checks increases by +1 per two soulmelds currently shaped.
Racial Aid gives +3 to the roll of another Rilkan when you successfully aid them. Use the ordinary bonus when aiding a creature of another species.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. +5 to hit while flanking via Improved Flanking.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kesra agreed to get two apprentices out before the warehouse is sealed. She checks the roof hatch for a trap, then looks for a way to flank a guard with the cargo inspector if he is nearby.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kestrel can brace the stalled pulley with a temporary tool, but needs someone to keep the cargo platform steady.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Restart the lift before its last passengers run out of drinking water.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt and shield, proficiency +2, Wisdom save +5, Charisma save +2.
Resilience. Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage. Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dim light and darkness.

Scroungecraft produces a temporary tool or adventuring item up to 30 gp in 10 minutes with suitable materials. Temporary tools are single-use. Other items generally last an hour. A repair with suitable materials holds as long as the GM decides.
Disciple of Life adds 2 + spell level to HP restored by spells of 1st level or higher.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 bludgeoning. Sacred flame DC 13 Dexterity save or 1d8 radiant.

Cleric spell save DC 13, spell attack +5, three 1st-level slots. Cantrips guidance, mending, and sacred flame. Prepared spells detect poison and disease, guiding bolt, healing word, sanctuary, and shield of faith. Domain spells bless and cure wounds are also prepared.
At 1st level, cure wounds restores 1d8+6 HP and healing word restores 1d4+6 HP with Disciple of Life.

Channel Divinity once per short or long rest. Preserve Life can allocate 10 HP among creatures within 30 ft., limited to half each target’s max HP and excluding undead and constructs. Turn Undead forces undead within 30 ft. that can see or hear Kestrel to save against DC 13 Wisdom or be turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kestrel climbs to the winch, improvises a tool when materials allow, and keeps healing word in reserve for anyone pinned below.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Kethan can rig a crossing if the party checks which downhill anchors survived the rockfall.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reopen the pass before sleet reaches the exposed shoulder.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Space 5 ft. Natural reach 5 ft. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +8 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Powerful Build lets Kethan wield Large weapons. Determine weapon reach from his actual Medium size and the weapon’s reach property.
Skill Focus (Sense Motive) adds +3. Sense Motive already includes the species’ +2 bonus. Each listed skill has four Expert class ranks.

Mountain Movement allows standing long jumps and high jumps using the running Jump rules. Accelerated climbing moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 Climb penalty. Climb checks still apply.
Acclimated removes the altitude penalties under Mountain Travel in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 90. Acclimation persists after time at low elevation.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large longspear +4 melee, 2d6+6 piercing, critical ×3. Hits at 10 ft. but cannot hit adjacent targets.
Large club +4 melee, 1d8+4 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. May instead throw it at +1 with a 10-ft. range increment.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Kethan asks the party to check the downhill anchors before he crosses to rig a line. He takes a standing jump across the break and can climb at half speed while attaching the line. If cornered on the path, he uses the longspear at 10 ft. and the club up close.

printings.label: Tanarukk coal-gate sentry, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Khar waits beside the brazier that lights the coal gate.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the gate clear until a work crew gets inside.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +5, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Fire resistance 10 and spell resistance 14. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Weapon Focus (battleaxe) adds +1 on battleaxe attacks. Illiterate.

Control Flame (Sp), 1/day, caster level 5. As a standard action, change an existing nonmagical fire within 10 ft. Dim it to coals or brighten it to daylight brightness and twice its normal illumination radius. The effect lasts 5 minutes. Heat output and fuel consumption stay the same.

The natural bite deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. In a full attack with a weapon, apply a −5 penalty to the bite attack and add half the Strength bonus to its damage.
Orc Blood allows the tanarukk to use or create items with orc-specific powers as an orc.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Battleaxe +10 melee in two hands for 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3. On a full attack, add bite +4 for 1d6+2, critical ×2. Bite alone +9 for 1d6+6, critical ×2.
Use the one daily activation to dim the coal gate’s nearest brazier from within 10 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Khar dims the brazier by the passage and watches the first landing with darkvision. If challenged, he uses the battleaxe and adds a bite when he can make a full attack.

gm.title: Hook
lines: K’tcha points out a gap in the rock and demonstrates the jump with a quick bound.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Guide the clutch across a break in the trail before the wind erases the route.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fortitude 13, Reflex 15, Will 11. Bloodied 13. Eight healing surges, worth 6 each.
Leather armor and longbow. A walking spear is backup. Archery style grants Defensive Mobility, for AC 18 against opportunity attacks.
Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with bows. Prime Shot adds +1 to a ranged attack if none of K’tcha’s allies is closer to the target.
Hunter’s Quarry, minor, designates the nearest visible enemy and adds 1d6 once per round on a hit against it.
Multiple Arms changes one minor item interaction to free each turn. Natural Jumper counts every jump as a running start. Four-hour aware torpor suffices for rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longbow basic attack, standard. Range 20/40, +6 vs. AC, 1d10+5 damage.
Spear basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +4 vs. AC for 1d8+2.
Twin Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, +6 vs. AC twice against one or two creatures, 1d10+1 per hit.
Nimble Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, shift 1 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Evasive Strike, encounter standard. Longbow, shift up to 2 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 2d10+5.
Split the Tree, daily standard. Longbow against two creatures within 3 squares of each other. Make two +6 attacks and compare the higher roll to both ACs. Deal 2d10+5 to each hit.
Thri-Kreen Claws, encounter minor. Melee 1 against one to three enemies, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4 plus the number targeted, even if not all attacks hit.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Shoots from the edge of a gap. Uses the rapid draw to keep moving, then spends the minor claw power if cornered by several enemies.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: The checkpoint clerk recorded an extra crossing after the last lantern went dark. Lampnote asks the party to repeat the route under observation.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the source of an extra bell note that sounds only when the gate is locked.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Expertise in Investigation and Stealth. Thieves’ tools +5 on Dexterity checks. Knows Thieves’ Cant.
Constant Tune. Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Cosmic Musician gives proficiency with the whistle and Performance.
