Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn to a finesse or ranged hit with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Lampnote has no disadvantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

Sublime Chord. One action per long rest. Creatures within 30 ft. that can hear Lampnote make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure they are charmed by Lampnote for 10 minutes and regard them as a casual friend. Targets in combat with Lampnote or an ally have advantage on the save.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lampnote uses the chord before anyone draws steel, and leaves room for a quick exit if persuasion fails.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lark makes the case for releasing the courier while quietly preparing an escape route.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a route contract taken during a dispute over the road toll.

gm.title: Traits
lines: AC 15 with mage armor already cast, otherwise AC 12. Proficiency +3. Intelligence save +6, Wisdom save +3. Evasive gives Dexterity save +5 including Intelligence modifier.
Improved Minor Illusion allows both image and sound with one casting of minor illusion. Arcane Recovery can recover up to 3 combined spell-slot levels after one short rest per day.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+2 piercing. Fire bolt +6 to hit, range 120 ft., 2d10 fire.

Wizard spell save DC 14, spell attack +6. Slots 4/3/2 by spell level, with one 1st-level slot spent if mage armor is active. Cantrips fire bolt, mage hand, message, minor illusion, and prestidigitation.
Prepared spells. 1st level detect magic, mage armor, shield. 2nd level mirror image, misty step, web. 3rd level counterspell, hypnotic pattern.

Bewitching Guile supplies charm person, 2nd-level ambush prey, and fear independently once each per long rest at DC 14 where applicable. Ambush prey grants invisibility for up to 1 hour and ends if Lark moves at least 5 ft. from the casting point or makes the first attack against an unaware target, which adds 1d6 damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lark opens with negotiation. Under threat, she uses ambush prey only when she can hold position, or drops web between herself and her pursuers before using misty step on a later turn.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Veyric can examine the rubbing from the far side of the threshold and tell the party which mark the crew covered.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a missing rubbing of an inscribed threshold before the crew tries to clear it.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unarmored. Touch 11, flat-footed 10. With mage armor, AC 15 and flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.
At 1st level, Naen adds +1 to Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks. With sigils doused, Decipher Script and Knowledge (arcana) drop to +6 and Spellcraft to +9.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.
Final Utterance lasts 1 round. Feats are Scribe Scroll and Skill Focus (Spellcraft). Familiar slot is unfilled. Prepared spells use caster level 1 and save DC 12 + spell level.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Minimum 1 damage on a hit.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, light, and read magic. Prepared 1st-level spells are grease and mage armor.
Mage armor gives +4 armor AC for 1 hour. Grease makes a 10-ft. square slippery within 25 ft. for 1 round, Reflex DC 13 or fall. Moving through the area requires a DC 10 Balance check at half speed.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Veyric asks the party to search for the missing rubbing before anyone touches the inscribed threshold. He examines the marks by sigil light and uses grease to hinder pursuit if the group has to retreat.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lethir can get the group to the survey camp by dawn if they carry a truthful message from the people displaced by the work.

gm.title: Role
lines: Guide with a conflict of interest

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a disused path out of a survey that would make it a toll road.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lilli has just recoated her shield and is holding the landing alone.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the landing open for the boat coming out of the lower passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1, natural armor +6. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +5.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) adds +1 to attacks with the shortspear.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Adhesive (Ex). Coating a shield takes 1 hour and materials worth 20 gp. A missed melee attack against the kuo-toa triggers Reflex DC 11 + its Constitution modifier. On a failed save a held weapon sticks and is pulled from its wielder’s grip, or a natural-weapon attacker is grappled. The coating expires after three days or one catch. A DC 20 Strength check frees the weapon or limb.
The shield starts with a fresh coating. The save to avoid it is Reflex DC 14. Once it catches a weapon or limb, mark the coating spent.
After one round of blindness from abrupt bright light, sustained bright light reduces the shortspear attack to +6, Search to +9, and saves to Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lilli keeps her coated shield between herself and an attacker on the landing. If daylight floods the shore, she withdraws into the deeper passage when she can do so safely.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lumen knows the line of cairns and can heal the surveyor once the party clears the path.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach an injured surveyor on the cairn road.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good Cleric of Fharlanghn, Protection and Travel domains. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5. Armor check penalty −4.

Nonverbal Spell uses audible Buommi song in place of verbal words. It keeps the vow and spends no higher-level slot. Magical silence still stops these castings. She keeps one hand free for somatic components.

Cleric caster level 1. Three prepared cantrips, two prepared 1st-level spells and one domain slot. Save DC 13 for cantrips and 14 for 1st-level spells if applicable. As a good Cleric, she can exchange a prepared non-domain spell for a cure spell of that level.

Travel domain freedom of movement applies automatically for up to 1 round per day against magical effects that impede movement. Turn undead twice per day (turning check 1d20−1, turning damage 2d6 HD).

The racial vow is against speech. A breach deals 1 Wisdom damage and applies −2 on attack rolls, saves, and checks for 24 hours. A further breach before expiry deals another point of Wisdom damage and extends the same penalty for another 24 hours.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Heavy mace +1 melee, 1d8+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.

Prepared cantrips are detect magic (60-ft. cone, concentrate up to 1 minute), guidance (touch, +1 competence on one attack, save, or skill check within 1 minute), and light (object touched, 10 minutes).
Bless (1st): allies within a 50-ft. burst centered on her gain +1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 1 minute.
Shield of faith (1st): touch, +2 deflection AC for 1 minute. On herself AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 18.

Longstrider (1st-level Travel domain slot): personal, land speed 40 ft. for 1 hour. Spontaneous cure light wounds can instead use bless or shield of faith’s slot and heals one willing living target for 1d8+1 HP by touch.
Protection domain ward once per day, standard action and touch. Give +1 resistance on the next saving throw within 1 hour.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lumen follows the cairns looking for an injured road surveyor. She sings as she casts and points out the stones the party can use to mark the way back. If someone needs healing, she gives up a prepared non-domain spell.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lysa can listen for the sentry and guide the party between passes if they leave the narrow ledge clear.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a quiet gap in an old stone sentry’s route so repairers can reach a counterweight.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +2. Armor check penalty −1.
Alertness and class bonus Track. Wild Empathy +0. Favored enemy constructs gives +2 to weapon damage and to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival against constructs.
The listed Hide total uses Camouflage. Hide +5 when its bonus is negated. The racial and Alertness bonuses are already included in Listen.
Camouflage still works against darkvision. True seeing negates the racial Hide bonus. Ordinary cover or concealment is still needed to attempt a Hide check.
Dazzled in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. While dazzled, Search +3, Spot +7 (+9 against constructs), light pick +1 melee, and longbow +2 ranged. Favored-enemy damage still applies.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light pick +2 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×4, 5-ft. reach. Add +2 weapon damage against constructs.
Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. increment. Add +2 weapon damage against constructs.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Listen for the stone sentry’s tread from behind cover. Lead the party to the safe gallery between passes. Keep the ledge clear while the party checks the old counterweight.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 2d6+4, plus 2 HP while attached
Challenge · Provisional CR 3 with throwing scarab attached. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lysa grips the case and asks which way the party came in. A blue scarab shifts on the back of her hand.

gm.title: Role
lines: Seam scout with a throwing scarab.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a survey map out before the lower tunnels are locked.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1.
Trapfinding and evasion in light armor. Tumble synergy is included in Balance.

Throwing scarab starts attached. AC 21, touch 21, flat-footed 18, 4 HP when targeted directly. It can be attacked in place of the host if visible, provoking from the host. While attached it makes no attacks of its own.
Scarab attachment or removal deals 1d3 Wisdom damage. The listed Wisdom assumes recovery from an earlier attachment. Deep-blue carapace, telepathy with the host, Ego 2.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Unbalanced Mind Will DC 12. Will +5 if the scarab enters a personality conflict against its Ego DC 2.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Throwing scarab shard +4 ranged, 1d6 slashing and 1d6 acid, 20-ft. range increment. Critical 19–20/×2 on the slashing damage. Point Blank Shot adds +1 to attack and damage within 30 ft., before range penalties.

Grasp one available shard as a free action and throw it as a normal ranged attack. A new shard becomes available at the beginning of Lysa’s next action, one shot per round. The shard counts as magic for damage reduction and dissolves within a round of removal.
Sneak attack adds 1d6 if the target is denied Dexterity to AC, or when flanking in melee. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lysa tries to get the map case past the party first. If the route closes, she uses the scarab shard from cover and moves before the next shot.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Lysa can keep the ramp open while the party checks the path home.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the ferry at the landing until a missing child comes back.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Aura (Ex) corresponds to her lawful good alignment. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Combined armor check penalty −3.

Three essentia from her race, Sapphire Smite, and Healing Soul. The normal capacity is 1 per feat. At the start of the day she puts 1 in Sapphire Smite and 1 in Healing Soul for 24 hours. The third point remains unspent.
At Soulborn 1, Lysa gets her essentia from her race and feats. Soulborn meldshaping starts at 4th level and class essentia starts at 6th.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Smite Opposition twice per day with Sapphire Smite. With her longsword, +5 melee for 1d8+4 against a chaotic or evil target. Another alignment receives the ordinary attack and still expends the attempt.
Healing Soul once per day as a swift action. Heal 2 HP to herself.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Lysa is holding the ferry until a missing child reaches the landing. She keeps the gate open for the party, shields the ramp, and saves Smite Opposition for an attacker whose allegiance she has confirmed.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Maera can speak with a badger from the bank while the party checks the spillway for what changed.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out why the animals no longer drink from the uphill spring.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Concentration +7, or +11 to cast defensively or while grappled or pinned
Diplomacy +4, or +6 with creatures of the earth subtype

gm.title: Traits
lines: Hide armor +3 and heavy wooden shield +2. Touch 10, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +4.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Stonecunning checks unusual stonework within 10 ft. and covers stonework traps. Combat Casting grants +4 on qualifying Concentration checks. Nature Sense is included in Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild Empathy +1. Animal companion slot open.

Spell Power adds +1 to effective caster level for divinations or spells with the earth descriptor when in contact with the ground. Apply the increase to level-dependent effects and caster level checks. It stacks with other Spell Power abilities.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, detect poison, and light. Prepared 1st-level spells are entangle and speak with animals. Spontaneously convert a prepared spell to summon nature’s ally of the same level when available.

On the ground, detect magic and detect poison use caster level 2, and speak with animals lasts 2 minutes. At base caster level 1, speak with animals lasts 1 minute. Detect poison has 30-ft. range on the ground and 25-ft. range at caster level 1.

Entangle uses caster level 1 in either case. For 1 minute, plants in a 40-ft.-radius spread within 440 ft. entangle creatures in or entering the area on a failed Reflex DC 13. On a success they move at half speed through the area. Spell resistance does not apply.

An entangled creature can spend a full-round action on a DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist check to break free and move at half speed. On each of Maera’s turns, the plants try again against creatures in the area that saved or broke free.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Maera wants to know why animals have stopped drinking at the spring. She speaks with a badger from the bank and uses detect poison on the spillway. If pursued, she falls back through the reeds and casts entangle to slow the approach.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mai can cross the ledge with the message while the party checks the marked footholds.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the watch a message before the shift changes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic neutral. The encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.
Trapfinding, sneak attack +1d6, and Point Blank Shot. Search can locate traps above DC 20 and Disable Device can handle magical traps. Use ordinary thieves’ tools.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Charge at +3, with AC 16 until the next turn.
Javelin +3 ranged, 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. Within 30 ft., Point Blank Shot gives +4 and 1d6+2 before range modifiers.

A camouflaged javelin within 30 ft. can deal 1d6+2 plus 1d6 sneak attack against a qualifying creature. Camouflage denies Dexterity AC on that throw. Once used, Mai cannot camouflage a charge or another throw against that creature this encounter.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mai needs to get a message across the split ledge before the watch moves. She uses Jump to cross when the gap is safe and watches for a trapped foothold. If a guard corners her, she can use a camouflaged javelin once against that guard and then retreats.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Maig uses a drum signal to group workers at the side exit.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the workers out before the foundry gates close.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, and natural armor +2. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +2.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds an orog for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
+2 racial bonus on Craft (armorsmithing) and Craft (weaponsmithing) checks.
Racial proficiency with the greatsword and throwing axe.
Orc Blood. An orog counts as an orc for racial effects, including the use or creation of magic items with orc-specific powers.
Skill Focus (Perform) adds +3 to Perform (percussion). Bardic Knowledge +2. Bardic music 1/day. Leather armor does not cause arcane spell failure for his Bard spells.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Greatsword +3 melee in two hands for 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Throwing axe +1 ranged for 1d6+3 slashing, critical ×2, range increment 10 ft.
Inspire Courage grants allies who can hear the performance +1 morale on saves against charm and fear, attack rolls, and weapon damage. It lasts while they hear him play and for 5 rounds afterward.
Bard spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, light, mage hand, and message share two cantrip slots.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Maig sounds the drum while workers flee the foundry. Once everyone has heard the beat, he stops playing and uses message to warn a worker ahead if pursuers close in.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 9. Glide 50 feet each round, subject to starting height and load.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Makurí can glide across the gap with a line once the party clears the far landing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a route that bypasses a split rope bridge before the next rain.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Mountaineering and Rope Use as learned proficiencies.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. AC 4 from natural AC 9, the racial 2-point bonus, and Dexterity improving AC by 3. No armor or shield.
After the racial bonus, saves are 12/14/13/15/15 for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell.
Charisma is 11 or 10 with the peoples affected by his racial penalty and 3 with araneas.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Wooden club, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets. Speed factor 4.
Glide up to three times the starting height at 50 feet per round. Subtract 20 feet of range per 100 coin-weight carried. Makurí cannot attack while gliding.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Makurí leads from above. He lands to fight and uses his staff as a club if someone reaches the lookout.

printings.label: Dvati split floodgate wardens, Fighter 1 twin pair

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 1d10 shared, +2 Constitution per twin
Challenge · Provisional CR 2 for the pair. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mara and Sera can coordinate through the stone while the party watches the crossing.

gm.title: Role
lines: Split floodgate wardens and Fighter pair.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep two pin wheels turning until the maintenance crew is out of the channel.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. The listed combat stats are per twin. Both share the maximum first Hit Die result of 10. Each gets 5 from the die and 2 from Constitution, for 7 HP each. Damage to either twin is tracked separately.

Each has a chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −2. Improved Initiative adds +4, and Weapon Focus (spear) adds +1 to spear attacks.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Table ruling for these encounters. Roll initiative once for the pair and resolve both turns on that count. Declare shared casting and Echo Attack together.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Each twin has a spear +5 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach. Thrown spear +3, 1d8+3 piercing, critical ×3, 20-ft. increment.

When both flank the same foe, each spear is +8. On a failed Echo Attack save against one shared 1d20+2 Perform (sing) check, choose +9 spear attacks against that foe or AC 16 against its attacks for one round.
Aid Another as a standard action in melee. Make a spear attack roll against AC 10 to give the other twin +4 on the relevant attack or to AC against the next attack from that opponent.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mara and Sera guard two pin wheels on opposite sides of the floodgate. They can warn each other through the stone telepathically. If a creature forces the crossing, they take both sides of it or have one help the other secure a clear strike.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mara can demonstrate the clasp for the party once they find the owner listed in her ledger.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Return an elf-restricted magic clasp before someone redeems it with a copied pawn ticket.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Use Magic Device +6, or +10 to emulate a nonhumanoid race

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision at twice human distance.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +0.
Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device checks against magic traps. Skill Focus (Use Magic Device) adds +3. The eight listed skills each have four ranks.
Apply other magic item requirements normally. An elf-restricted item needs no race check. A nonhumanoid race restriction is a DC 25 Use Magic Device check at +10.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sneak attack adds 1d6 damage when Mara flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Mara can see and reach and no concealment from her.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mara agreed to inspect an elf-restricted magic clasp. She will demonstrate its catch if the party finds the owner named on the pawn ticket. If cornered, she hides behind the counter and takes the back stair.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mara traced the rider as far as the bend above the ford.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the messenger before the ford becomes impassable.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Material Plane. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +1 (+3 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save).
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action that does not provoke. It returns at the start of the Bariaur’s next turn unless kept down.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +7. Light load up to 114 lb. with Strength 16.

Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Point Blank Shot adds +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls within 30 ft. Favored enemy undead adds +2 to the listed Listen, Spot, and Survival checks against undead and +2 to weapon damage against them. It also applies to Bluff and Sense Motive against undead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 100 ft. Within 30 ft. longbow +4 for 1d8+1.

Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +6 for 2d6+4 bludgeoning. Move at least 10 ft. along a clear path and up to 80 ft. on a normal full-round charge. AC drops to 13 until the start of her next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mara scouts the switchback for a messenger who never reached the ford. She uses the bow when the path bends. On the straight stretch she can charge a foe blocking the crossing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Marda has tied the ferry up herself and demands to see the deed before letting the buyer aboard.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a ferry crew from hauling away the one chain that still secures the landing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral evil. Large −1, natural armor +10, Dexterity +2. Touch 11, flat-footed 19. BAB +6/+1, grapple +19, reach 10 ft. Fortitude +6, Reflex +7, Will +7.
Spell resistance 18. Steely Skin subtracts 1 damage from slashing or piercing weapon hits and adds 1 to bludgeoning weapon hits, including morningstars. Alertness, Multiattack, Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw +14 melee, 1d6+9 slashing. On a full attack use both claws and bite +12 melee, 1d6+4 piercing. Two claws hitting the same target add rend damage of 2d6+18.

Improved grab after a claw hit against a Large or smaller foe. Start a grapple at +19 as a free action, without an attack of opportunity. Take a −20 penalty to grapple with just the claw while avoiding the grappled condition.

Change self 3/day for 60 minutes. Gain +10 on Disguise for visual changes, with DC 11 Will disbelief on interaction. Fog cloud 1/day at up to 160 ft., 30-ft. radius and 20-ft. height, lasts 60 minutes, no save or spell resistance. Both at CL 6.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Break up ranged support with fog cloud. Use reach to intercept the first creature to leave the fog and attack an adjacent foe with both claws when possible.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Bard 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Social encounter and support.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Marel asks the party to stage a calm first meeting before the ferrymen choose sides.

gm.title: Role
lines: Steers tense negotiations and discovers one relevant secret.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Learn why the ferrymen stopped honoring a trade agreement.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dexterity save +4 and Charisma save +5. Leather armor. Advantage on saves against being charmed and Powerful Build for moving loads.
Gift of Gab grants Insight and Persuasion. Jack of All Trades adds +1 to ability checks without proficiency, including initiative.

A Friendly Ear, DC 13 Wisdom. After at least 1 minute of conversation with a nonhostile creature, a failed save charms it for 1 hour and reveals one fact it knows about the topic, chosen by the DM. Target unaware either way. Recharges on a short rest.

Bardic Inspiration. As a bonus action, give an ally who can hear Marel within 60 ft. a d6. Within 10 minutes it can add the die to one check, attack, or save after rolling but before the result. Three uses per long rest.
Song of Rest. Allies who hear Marel and spend one or more Hit Dice during the short rest regain an extra 1d6 HP.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.

Bard spells, DC 13 and +5 spell attack. Cantrips are minor illusion and vicious mockery. Vicious mockery targets a creature who can hear Marel within 60 ft. and deals 1d4 psychic and imposes disadvantage on the target’s next attack before the end of its next turn on a failed Wisdom save.
Three 1st-level slots. Known spells are comprehend languages, dissonant whispers, faerie fire, healing word, and hideous laughter.

Healing word restores 1d4+3 HP to a visible creature within 60 ft. as a bonus action. Faerie fire outlines creatures that fail a Dexterity save in a 20-ft. cube within 60 ft. Attackers who can see an outlined creature have advantage. Concentration up to 1 minute.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Marel invites the visitor to sit and talk first. In a fight, Marel marks enemies with faerie fire and uses healing word to recover an ally who has fallen.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Maren can study the damaged catches if the party keeps the room clear and brings the missing inventory board.

gm.title: Role
lines: Seed vault keeper and generalist Wizard.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out who entered the seed vault before a delayed spring shipment is reopened.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination

gm.title: Traits
lines: Natural armor +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +3.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Generalist Wizard at caster level 1. Scribe Scroll as a class feat, Skill Focus (Spellcraft) as the 1st-level feat. She has no summoned familiar. She carries a spell component pouch.

Prepared spells are three 0-level and two 1st-level spells, including one Intelligence bonus slot. Save DC 13 + spell level. Spellbook: Wizard cantrips and the 1st-level spells alarm, comprehend languages, endure elements, grease, magic missile, and unseen servant.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff +1 melee using one end with two hands, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Light crossbow +0 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment.

Prepared cantrips: detect magic, mage hand, ray of frost. Ray of Frost +0 ranged touch within 25 ft., 1d3 cold, no save and spell resistance applies. The lighting and target modifiers apply to the ray.

Prepared 1st-level spells: grease and magic missile. Grease lasts 1 round within 25 ft. and ignores spell resistance. In a 10-ft. square, creatures make Reflex DC 14 or fall. Moving through it takes Balance DC 10 at half speed. Failure stops movement and calls for a Reflex save against falling. Failing Balance by 5 or more causes a fall outright.

Grease can instead coat one object. A creature using the object makes Reflex DC 14 or drops it, and saves again when trying to pick it up or use it. Greased armor or clothing grants a +10 circumstance bonus on Escape Artist and grapple checks to resist or escape a grapple or escape a pin.
Magic Missile deals 1d4+1 force within 110 ft. without an attack roll or saving throw. Spell resistance applies.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Keep the lamp hooded while checking the seed vault’s hinges and disturbed locks. Use Mage Hand for a light object out of reach. If pressed, use Grease to delay pursuit or Magic Missile when bright light would hinder a ray.

gm.title: Hook
lines: He can slip past the keeper if someone gives her a reason to leave the lantern door ajar.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover the forged signal order before the beacon is lit.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 11, Reflex 17, Will 14. Bloodied 9. No healing surges after Fragile Mortality.

First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act at the start of an encounter. Once per round, Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to a qualifying dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage. Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Sly Flourish (at-will, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+8.
Dazing Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5. On a hit, daze until the end of Marren’s next turn.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 2d4+5. On a hit, the target is slowed and grants Marren combat advantage (save ends both). On a miss, half damage and it grants Marren combat advantage through the end of Marren’s next turn.
One with Shadow (at-will, standard). Through the end of Marren’s next turn, he can attempt to hide with any cover or concealment and can use cover from allies to hide or remain hidden.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Marren asks an ally to stand between him and the guard while he reaches the shutter. If cornered, he dazes the nearest guard and heads for the stairs.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (2 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Maura asks for help carrying an injured porter out of the rain.

gm.title: Role
lines: Wayhouse keeper and Cleric of Luthic.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the shelter open until the night travelers arrive.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral evil. Chain shirt +4, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14, armor check penalty −2. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +6.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Cleric of Luthic. Earth domain grants 3 shared uses/day to turn or destroy air creatures or rebuke or command earth creatures. Healing domain adds +1 caster level to Healing spells.
Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration while casting defensively, grappled, or pinned.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Caster level 2, or 3 for Healing spells. Four orisons, DC 13 when relevant. Detect magic, guidance, light, and resistance.

First level, three slots plus one domain slot, DC 14 when relevant. Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+3 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain magic stone. Spontaneous inflict spells can replace prepared non-domain spells.
Magic stone enchants up to three pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. Thrown stone +3, 1d6+1 bludgeoning or 2d6+2 against undead, 20-ft. range increment.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day. Turning check 1d20, turning damage 2d6+2. Earth domain has its own pool and the same check and damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Maura keeps a lamp ready at the door and checks arriving travelers for injuries. If the wayhouse comes under attack, she casts bless before moving to cover.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 4 (2 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 20 ft. even in medium or heavy armor

gm.title: Hook
lines: Merec asks for a second lookout after a rockfall exposes the flank of his post.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the pass open while the last sled reaches camp.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Chainmail +5, heavy wooden shield +2, size +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 18, armor check penalty −7. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +0, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Land speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework and a reactive check within 10 ft. An Arctic Dwarf can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+2 racial bonus on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Immune to cold. AC 22 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Improved Initiative adds +4 and Weapon Focus adds +1 to heavy pick attacks.
Power Attack trades up to 2 points of melee attack bonus for an equal damage bonus with the one-handed heavy pick.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small heavy pick +9 melee, 1d4+5 piercing, critical ×4. With full Power Attack, +7 melee, 1d4+7 piercing.
Small shortspear +3 ranged, 1d4+5 piercing, critical ×2, 20-ft. range increment. Add +1 to either weapon’s attack against orcs and goblinoids.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Merec blocks the narrow approach while others secure the guide rope. He keeps his distance from any creature large enough to reach across the ridge.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Meren knows the last driver to use the road and offers to check the passenger roll with the party.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the waiting families together until the missing wagons come in.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +4. Light armor leaves bard spells usable. Armor check penalty −1.

Skill Focus (Perform [storytelling]) adds +3. Bardic knowledge +2. Bard caster level 2. Casts spontaneously, with three 0-level slots and one 1st-level slot per day. Save DC 13 or 14 respectively. Carries a spell component pouch.

Blood Quickening: Hlal active. At level 2 it adds +1 racial to Perform (storytelling) and grants three uses of Heighten Spell that day. He has one 1st-level slot to spend on a heightened cantrip or a 1st-level spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Shortbow +3 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, 60-ft. increment.
Bardic music 2/day, standard action to start. Inspire courage grants +1 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage, and saves against charm and fear while heard and for 5 rounds afterward.

Countersong lets listeners within 30 ft. use his Perform check instead of a lower save against magical attacks that are sonic or language-dependent, for up to 10 rounds. An ongoing eligible effect grants another save using the Perform result. Fascinate affects one attentive creature within 90 ft. outside combat distractions. It uses his Perform result as the Will DC and lasts up to 2 rounds with concentration.

Daze (0): standard action, one Humanoid of 4 HD or less within 30 ft. It takes no actions for 1 round on failed DC 13 Will. Spell resistance applies. Hlal allows Heighten Spell with his sole 1st-level slot for DC 14 and a full-round casting action.

Other cantrips known: detect magic (60-ft. cone), light (object touched, 20 minutes), mage hand (one unattended nonmagical object weighing at most 5 lb. within 30 ft. while concentrating), and prestidigitation.
Cure light wounds (1st): standard action, touch, heals 1d8+2 on a willing living target. Expeditious retreat (1st): standard action, personal, increases land speed to 60 ft. for 2 minutes.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Meren is keeping families together after the outbound wagons failed to arrive. He tells a story so they can count who is present. He keeps his only 1st-level slot for an injured traveler unless a hostile Humanoid needs to be stopped immediately.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 3 by Table A–34. Medusa monster class level 6, 4 HD.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mereth offers to show the party the stone dust on the statue’s boots if they agree to meet behind a screen.

gm.title: Role
lines: Keeper of a shuttered stone quarry.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the quarryhands from taking the blame for a statue they found underground.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. AC includes +2 natural armor and +3 Dexterity. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +4, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Alertness, Point Blank Shot, and Precise Shot. She can fire into melee without the usual −4 penalty.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Snake hair +5 melee, 1d4 piercing and poison. Fortitude DC 15 on the hit against 1d4 Strength damage, and again a minute later against 2d4 Strength damage.
Shortbow +7 ranged, 1d6 piercing, ×3, 60-ft. range increment. At 30 ft. or less use +8 and 1d6+1.

Petrifying Gaze (Su), 1/day. As an active gaze attack, choose one creature within 10 ft. It must make a Fortitude DC 16 save or turn to stone. Apply ordinary gaze avoidance rules when the target averts or covers its eyes.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mereth calls for parley from behind a pillar. If a foe rushes past it, she uses her gaze on that one foe and signals the quarryhands to leave.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Merrin has each crew’s witness mark and wants a third party to hear both accounts before the gate opens.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get two rival crews to honor a shared right of passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Charisma save +5. Leather AC 11 + Dexterity.
Jack of All Trades adds +1 to checks without proficiency, including initiative. Song of Rest adds 1d6 to healing for allies who spend Hit Dice on a short rest and can hear Merrin.
Shadow Camouflage gives advantage on Stealth checks to hide in dim light or darkness. Sunlight Sensitivity hampers attacks and sight-based Perception in direct sunlight.
Unseelie Blessing gives advantage on saves against charm and prevents magical sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d8 + 3 piercing.
Stink Eye. Action, visible target within 30 ft. who can see and hear Merrin, Charisma DC 13. On failure, disadvantage on its next ability check, attack roll or saving throw before Merrin’s next turn.

Bardic Inspiration. Bonus action, a creature other than Merrin within 60 ft. that can hear him gets 1d6 to add once to an ability check, attack roll or save within 10 minutes. Three uses per long rest.

Spellcasting, Charisma DC 13 and spell attack +5. Three 1st-level slots. Cantrips Mage Hand and Vicious Mockery. Known spells Charm Person, Disguise Self, Dissonant Whispers, Faerie Fire, and Healing Word.
Vicious Mockery. Action, visible creature within 60 ft. that can hear Merrin, Wisdom DC 13. Failure deals 1d4 psychic and imposes disadvantage on its next attack roll before its next turn ends.
Healing Word. Bonus action, visible creature within 60 ft. regains 1d4 + 3 HP. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.

Dissonant Whispers. Action, target within 60 ft., Wisdom DC 13. Failure deals 3d6 psychic and requires the target to spend its reaction if available to move away as far as its speed allows without entering obviously dangerous ground. Success halves damage and prevents that movement. A deafened creature succeeds automatically.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Merrin uses Stink Eye to break the aggressor’s focus and offers an exit before anyone draws steel. He saves Healing Word for an ally already down.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mheer can check the dark landing while the party works the shutter from below.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the spare key to the watch before the covered passage closes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Initiative includes Improved Initiative +4 and the species bonus +2.
Trapfinding and sneak attack +1d6. She can Search for traps above DC 20 and use Disable Device on magical traps. The 40-ft. land speed adds +4 to Jump.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.

While blinded, AC 11 and touch AC 8 after losing Dexterity AC and taking −2 AC. Move at half speed, 20 ft. Sight-dependent checks fail. Search and most Strength- or Dexterity-based skill checks take −4 when they can be attempted. Opponents have total concealment (50% miss chance).
Dazzled in bright light after the first round. AC 16 and movement 40 ft. Short sword +0, light crossbow +2, Search +4, and Spot +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Sneak attack adds +1d6 when the target is otherwise eligible and denied Dexterity AC or flanked by her melee attack. Ranged attack requires a target within 30 ft. Total concealment from blindness prevents the sneak attack while she cannot see the target’s vital area.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mheer is carrying the stairs’ spare key before the watch closes the covered passage. She can check the landing in dim light. If the upper shutter opens suddenly onto the sun, she feels for the rail and asks the party to guide her toward shade.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mina asks the group to serve as reading witnesses after the usual keeper stops answering messages.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a locked archive available to people who are still appealing a decision.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Minnet asks the closest traveler by telepathy to lower their weapon and wait for an answer.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Prevent a frightened crossing party from turning a meeting into a fight.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands, reads and writes Celestial and Common. Knows Umber Hulk through Favored Enemy. Speaks through telepathy 20 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Dexterity save +5. Studded leather AC 12 + Dexterity + shield + 1 from the Defense fighting style.
Grounded Celestial. Humanoid, susceptible to effects that target celestials.
Telepathic speech to a creature Minnet can see within 20 ft. if it understands a language.
Favored Enemy, monstrosities. Advantage on Survival to track them and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.
Natural Explorer, forest. Double proficiency for proficient Intelligence or Wisdom checks related to forest terrain. See class travel rules for journeys of at least one hour.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 piercing.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Tusks. Melee unarmed attack +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1 piercing plus 1d4 psychic.

War Chatter. Bonus action once per short or long rest. One non-Ratatosk creature within 30 ft. that can hear Minnet makes a DC 12 Charisma save. Failure gives disadvantage on attack rolls until Minnet’s next turn.

Two 1st-level spell slots. Hunter’s Mark is a bonus action and requires concentration. It adds 1d6 on weapon hits against the mark. Cure Wounds is an action that heals 1d8 + 1 on touch. Minnet frees the spear hand for the somatic component.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Minnet issues directions silently while closing on the route marker. She uses War Chatter to give the least armored traveler a turn to get behind her.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 5 (3 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +1 under Underdark).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mira is carrying a sealed bundle of passages she copied from old maps.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the records out of the gallery while the lower archives are still accessible.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3, size +1, and natural armor +2. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +3, grapple −2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +6, Will +9. Spell resistance 15.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. No familiar is present.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small light crossbow +7 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and color spray share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 20 for 1 hour, touch 14 and flat-footed 17. Color spray has Will DC 15.

Racial spell-like abilities keep CL 3. Ghost sound is Will DC 14 to disbelieve if interacted with. Daze is Will DC 14. Sound burst deals 1d8 sonic damage and has Fortitude DC 16 against its 1-round stun.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mira has mage armor active when she checks the gallery. She uses sound burst to stall pursuers at the entrance and then takes the covered route to the next chamber.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Mira needs someone to mark the return route in complete darkness.

gm.title: Role
lines: Spellborn wizard who crosses guarded compartments.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Trace an electrical fault back to its source.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., magical darkness vision 30 ft.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Sylvan, Gnomish, Orcish, Primordial, Halfling

gm.title: Traits
lines: INT and WIS saves +5 and +3. AC 15 with Mage Armor, AC 20 with Mage Armor and Shield. Necrotic resistance. Doubled survival time without air, food, water, or sleep.

Cosmopolitan heritage grants History and Street Smarts. In a city, Mira has advantage on checks to avoid getting lost or to find public destinations and cannot be surprised while conscious and able to act. Scholar background grants Arcana and Religion. Scholar and Polyglot provide extra languages.

INT spellcasting at +5 to hit, save DC 13. Two 1st-circle slots per long rest. Once daily after a short rest Arcane Recovery restores one spent slot. Prepared spells are Mage Armor, Shield, Magic Missile, and Longstrider. The spellbook also holds Burning Hands and Grease. Cantrips are Fire Bolt, Light, and Mage Hand. Detect Magic is the known ritual.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Fire Bolt +5 ranged spell attack at 120 ft., 1d10 fire on hit. Quarterstaff +1, reach 5 ft., 1d6−1 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8−1 two-handed.

Magic Missile creates three darts, 1d4+1 force each, distributed among visible creatures within 120 ft. Mage Armor gives AC 15 for eight hours. Shield reacts to a hit or Magic Missile, adds 5 AC until next turn, and negates Magic Missile damage.

Energy Form, once per long rest. Bonus action, last up to one minute. Mira usually picks lightning. Her form resists physical damage from nonmagical attacks, is immune to restrained, and can convert one attack or spell’s damage to lightning on each of her turns.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mira reads the corridor from the darkness and enters Energy Form when a crowd tries to pin her down. She converts a Fire Bolt if her opponent expects fire.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Miren offers to identify the object if the party helps recover her ledger.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Dex +5 and Int +4.
Dusk Skulker gives advantage on Stealth in dim light or darkness. Expertise with Stealth and thieves’ tools. Elusive in a crowd.

Cunning Action lets Miren Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action. Appraising Eye examines one object as an action to learn its magical properties, how to activate them, and an estimated market price. Recharge after a short or long rest.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Dexterity under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on a turn when a finesse or ranged attack has advantage or an eligible ally is next to the target. Attacks with disadvantage cannot use the ally condition.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Miren offers to inspect an object before naming a price. If the deal turns ugly, she uses cover and Cunning Action to withdraw through the stacks.

printings.label: Stonechild cartwright, 2 Outsider HD and Fighter 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Miren can replace the bearing blocks if the party carries them down from the old landing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Repair the cracked axle before a wagon and its crew have to ford the river.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, natural armor +4, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −4. BAB +3, grapple +9. Fortitude +11, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Blind-Fight is racial. The other feats are Skill Focus (Craft [stoneworking]), Power Attack, and Weapon Focus (warhammer). Weapon Focus and Skill Focus are included in the totals.
Search gives +2 synergy on Survival to follow tracks. Knowledge (the planes) gives +2 synergy on Survival on other planes. Apply both when both conditions hold.
Miren is on the Material Plane. Her two racial Hit Dice and one Fighter Hit Die give three Hit Dice total. The +4 level adjustment gives effective character level 7.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Warhammer +10 melee, 1d8+6 bludgeoning, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach. For Power Attack, subtract up to 3 from melee attack rolls and add the same number to damage with the one-handed warhammer.
Magic Stone 3/day, caster level 3. Miren can throw an enchanted pebble at +5.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Miren checks the cracked axle before anyone pulls the cart across the ford. She asks the party to bring the two stone bearing blocks from upstream. If the disturbance reaches the bank, she uses her shield to cover the crew and saves enchanted pebbles for undead.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Miren can identify where the wolf doubled back if the party keeps the last reliable tracks clear.

gm.title: Role
lines: Woodland reserve tracker and wildlife keeper.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a lost wolf before it blunders into someone else’s snare line.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +1.
+1 racial bonus to saves against powers, spells and spell-like effects. Base saves appear above.
Track, Wild Empathy +0, and Point Blank Shot. Favored enemy animals adds +2 to weapon damage and to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks against animals.
Naturally Psionic supplies a 1 PP reserve. Burst is independent of it.
Racial Burst 3/day. Standard action. Base land speed becomes 40 ft. for 3 rounds, with +4 to Jump from the increased speed. It costs no PP.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longbow +4 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment. Within 30 ft., Point Blank Shot gives +5 attack and 1d8+1 damage. Add +2 damage against animals.
Short sword +1 melee, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft. Add +2 damage against animals.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Follow the wolf’s track to the reserve boundary. Keep the party from crowding it, then loop ahead with Burst to flag the snare line before the wolf reaches it.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Morrow can point the party toward the sheltered entrance while he watches the open gate.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the last visitors inside before their pursuer reaches the gate.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Unarmored with Dexterity +2 and Wisdom +3. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +5. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Wisdom 16 and Charisma 8 reflect the racial adjustments. Monk unarmed damage is 1d6. Racial Listen and Perform (sing) bonuses are included.

The racial vow is against speech. A breach deals 1 Wisdom damage and applies −2 on attack rolls, saves, and checks for 24 hours. A further breach before expiry deals another point of Wisdom damage and extends the same penalty for another 24 hours.

After the first vow breach, Wisdom 15 and Wisdom modifier +2. AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12. Fortitude +2, Reflex +2, Will +2. Initiative checks +4, Listen +6, Perform (sing) +3. Stunning Fist DC 12 until Wisdom recovers.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Unarmed strike +2 melee, 1d6+2 bludgeoning (lethal or nonlethal), critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full-attack flurry +0/+0 for 1d6+2 each, with its −2 attack penalty also applying to other attacks before his next turn. On a vow breach, +0 single attack or −2/−2 flurry.

Stunning Fist once per day as a Monk bonus feat. Declare before rolling. On a hit, Fortitude DC 13 or stun for 1 round. A miss expends the use. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits are immune.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Morrow listens beside the north gate while the last visitors come in. He can give their keeper a Buommi departure song and point to the sheltered entrance. If a pursuer gets through, he tries to stop it with a stunning strike.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form

gm.title: Hook
lines: Murra found a narrow break in the submerged masonry.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Check whether the seep route opens into a safe vault.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +4. Improved Initiative adds +4. Scribe Scroll is the Wizard bonus feat.

Alternate Form (Su). Enter amorphous form as a standard action. It gives a 30-ft. swim speed and passage through openings as small as 2 inches in diameter. Return to normal form with a full-round action that does not provoke.

In amorphous form all worn and carried equipment melds and magic items stop functioning. Material and natural armor cease to apply. Dexterity, any effective deflection bonus, and armor from force effects can apply.

In amorphous form the Slyth cannot attack, be flanked, or be stunned, and is immune to critical hits. Other supernatural abilities stop. Spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components cannot be cast.
The form lasts up to 10 minutes per class level. After returning to normal, wait as long as the actual time spent in amorphous form before changing again.
Water Breathing (Ex) allows indefinite breathing underwater. Immunities (Ex) cover polymorphing and poison. Sonic resistance 5.
With mage armor already active, AC is 17 in either form, touch 13 and flat-footed 14. Without it, AC is 13 in either form.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +3 for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. The crossbow cannot be used in amorphous form.

Wizard spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are detect magic, light, and mage hand. First-level spells are mage armor (+4 force armor for 1 hour) and grease (Reflex DC 14, duration 1 round). Cast only in normal form because each requires components.
Cast mage armor before shifting. After three minutes scouting the seep, return using a full-round action in the vault and wait three minutes before shifting again.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Murra checks the seep opening before the party forces the vault door. Cast mage armor in advance and use amorphous form for the swim. Return to normal before using a spell or crossbow.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Myrine offers to draw attention down the broad trail while the party escorts the wagons.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the families across the open road before the storm reaches them.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. BAB +4, grapple +13. Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +6. Touch 12, flat-footed 12.

Natural armor +3, Dexterity +3, Large size −1 to AC and attacks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft., or 10 ft. with the lance against distant targets. Feats are Martial Weapon Proficiency (lance) and Weapon Focus (longbow), which also covers composite longbows.
Racial ranks, Listen 4, Move Silently 3, Spot 4, Survival 3.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large composite longbow (+5 Str rating) +7 ranged, 2d6+5 piercing, critical ×3, 110-ft. range increment.
Large lance +8 melee, 2d6+7 piercing wielded two-handed, critical ×3. A legal charge raises the attack to +10, deals 4d6+14 on an ordinary hit, and costs 2 AC until the next turn.
In a full attack, add two secondary hooves at +3 for 1d6+2 bludgeoning each against targets in natural reach.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Myrine uses the bow while the families open a clear path. She lowers her lance only if there is room for a straight charge.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nadi can guide workers through the side passage if the party moves the empty racks out of the way.

gm.title: Role
lines: Glassworks kiln watch and evacuation lead.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Clear the furnace passage before the glassworking crew loses its exit.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +8 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Against fire effects the saves are +6, +3, and +3.
Toughness adds 3 HP. Fighter bonus Weapon Focus (warhammer). Climb and Jump include the combined −2 armor check penalty.
Naturally Psionic provides 2 PP. The racial Stomp has its own daily use. Actual space and reach are 5 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large warhammer +5 melee, 2d6+3 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×3, reach 5 ft.

Racial Stomp once per day. Standard action, 20-ft. cone-shaped spread, grounded creatures only. Reflex DC 11 negates prone and 1d4 nonlethal damage. No power resistance, manifester level 1, no PP cost.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Clear the glassworks and keep the kiln passage open while the crew covers the hot channel. If the evacuation is interrupted, stand at the threshold and reserve the cone until workers are clear.

printings.label: Stonechild quarry marker, Stonechild monster class 3

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nalin asks the party to follow the quarry line and check the stone that moved overnight.

gm.title: Role
lines: Quarry marker and Stonechild monster class 3.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Determine why one boundary marker is out of line before the next shift begins.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +2.

Nalin has one racial Hit Die at monster-class level 3, which is effective character level 3. The progression gives him +4 Strength, +6 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma. The second Hit Die and Blind-Fight arrive at level 4.
Each listed class skill has four ranks. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Nalin is on the Material Plane.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longspear +4 melee, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×3, hits at 10 ft.
Heavy mace +4 melee, 1d8+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.
Magic Stone 1/day, caster level 3. Nalin can throw an enchanted pebble at +3.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nalin is replacing chipped boundary markers before the quarry crews change shifts. He asks the party to walk the new line with him and find the marker that moved overnight. If threatened, he keeps watch from behind the boundary wall with three enchanted pebbles at hand.

printings.label: Narel Claywind, Earth Shaper Jinnborn Fighter 1

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Narel offers passage with the caravan in exchange for help bringing one late cart in from the salt flats.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a cart of clay water jars through the pass before dawn.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. AC 14 from chain shirt and Dexterity.
Earth siraati. Narel has acid resistance. Once on his turn on a melee hit he can add 1d6 acid damage. Three uses per long rest.
Desert Dependent. Each month spent out of the desert, make a DC 15 Charisma save (−1) or gain indefinite madness as determined with the DM.
Dueling. The listed melee damage includes +2 when wielding the framing mallet in one hand with no other weapon.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Framing mallet (club). Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 5 bludgeoning.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 1 HP. One use per short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Narel talks first. If pressed into a fight beside the kiln, he tries to draw the intruder away from the dry clay racks and spends his elemental strike on an opening hit.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 30 ft., 60 ft. in wolf form

gm.title: Hook
lines: A goblin pays the party for news at the inn. The same voice calls to them from the ditch after dark.

gm.title: Role
lines: Roadside patrol hunter who changes between wolf and goblin.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the courier who sold his patrol route to the toll gang.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +6, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Improved Initiative. Scent gives direction as a move action and pinpoints within 5 ft. of the source.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite +5 melee, 1d6+3 piercing. On a full attack add two claws +0 melee, 1d4+1 slashing each. Bite and claws are available in both forms.
Alternate form as a standard action. Wolf form moves at 60 ft., gains +4 circumstance to Hide and can use pass without trace as a free action so ordinary tracking finds no trail.

Feed on a slain humanoid after making the kill. As a full-round action, destroys the body for +2 enhancement Constitution for one day (HP 17 and Fortitude +7). Revivals requiring the body fail. Wish, miracle or true resurrection succeeds only 50% of the time.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Listen from hiding in wolf form. Follow a lone courier and use speed to disengage if their escort returns.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
Speed · 50 ft. with fast movement; base 40 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nasha waits on the wider bank where there is room to turn.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the approach clear until the crew reaches the other bank.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +2, size −1, and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 17. Armor check penalty −2. BAB +6, grapple +17. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Fast Movement raises land speed to 50 ft. and the speed bonus to Jump to +8. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Power Attack and illiteracy.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large battleaxe +12 melee one-handed for 2d6+7 slashing, critical ×3. Full attack with the axe at +12/+7 plus one secondary claw at +7 for 1d6+3.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. AC 17, HP 63 at full health, grapple +19, Fortitude +8, Reflex +6, Will +7. Full attack with the battleaxe at +14/+9 for 2d6+9 and one claw at +9 for 1d6+4. When rage ends, lose the 12 HP from increased Constitution and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nasha guards the broad approach while the crew crosses. She uses the battleaxe alone while moving and adds the secondary claw when she can make a full attack.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nella can approach the postern while the party checks the dark lantern and its keeper.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Deliver a ledger slip before the postern closes and find out why its intended recipient missed the lantern signal.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, small size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0.
+1 racial on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.

Against Giant-type creatures, AC 20 and touch 18 while able to dodge. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot, already included. Trapfinding allows Search checks for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device against magic traps.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small rapier +1 melee, 1d4 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. +2 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.

Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Nella flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Nella can see and reach and no concealment from her.

Racial silence 1/day at caster level 1, regardless of Charisma. Center it on the Whisper Gnome’s body. The 20-ft.-radius emanation moves with the gnome and lasts 1 minute, dismissible. It blocks sound and verbal spell components.
Charisma 10 grants ghost sound (Will disbelief DC 10 on interaction), mage hand, and message 1/day each at caster level 1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nella needs to deliver a ledger slip before the postern closes. She asks the party to find who left the recipient’s lantern unlit. She uses message to speak before crossing, then centers silence on herself if she must move through a stairwell without being heard.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nemi can lead the party up an old canopy route if they carry a coil of rope and check the upper anchor.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a repair crew across the ravine before another support gives way.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +0. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +2. Alertness is the chosen feat.
Climb uses Dexterity and can take 10 under pressure for a result of 23. Accelerated climb 30 ft. with one Climb check per round at +8 after the −5 penalty.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club. Melee −1, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d6−1 bludgeoning, minimum 1, critical ×2.
Light crossbow. Ranged +1, 80-ft. range increment. Hit 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Reload as a move-equivalent action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Stays near a climbable route, points out safe handholds, and keeps people moving. Uses a loaded crossbow from cover only if the group is forced to defend itself.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nera offers the party the unlit tower room as a lookout. She wants the culprit identified before anyone cuts the bell rope.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Prove someone is sending false warnings to reroute trade away from the hill road.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
Speed · 20 ft. in breastplate, sandswim 5 ft. in breastplate

gm.title: Hook
lines: Neral can reach the landing from the sand beside the cistern wall.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the dry exit open while the overflow is stopped.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Body Lamp senses solid objects to 60 ft. in loose soil while active.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Breastplate +5, Dexterity +1, natural armor +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. Armor check penalty −4. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Sandswim (Su) works in sand, dust, ash, and softsand. Slipsand, packed dirt, and rock are excluded. Under sand it allows normal breathing. It gives no protection from water or dangerous gases.
The player entry gives land speed in light armor or with a light load. Heavier armor or a medium load limits it to 5 ft. A heavy load prevents movement.

Body Lamp (Su) glows at will, with bright light to 60 ft. and shadowy illumination to 120 ft. In loose soil the Asherati can make out solid objects to 60 ft. for navigation and general identification. Other creatures in the sand see an orange glow. The glow confers no finer perception or advantage against invisibility or concealment. The Asherati cannot Hide while glowing.
Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects and heat protection level 1, with no heat saves needed through 120°F.
Water Vulnerability. Completely wet causes −1 on attack rolls, ability checks, and skill checks. Immersion prevents breath-holding and immediately triggers Constitution checks against drowning.
The breastplate is medium armor and limits Sandswim to 5 ft. The eagle’s claw counts as martial for Asheratis. Weapon Focus (eagle’s claw) is the Fighter bonus feat.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Eagle’s claw +5 melee, 1d6+3 slashing and piercing, critical 18–20/×2. Javelin +2 for 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.
Body Lamp flash, 1/day as a free action. All creatures within 30 ft. must pass Fortitude DC 11 or be dazzled for 1 minute (−1 on attack rolls, Search, and Spot).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Neral guards the dry landing beside a cistern overflow. He can move through the sand beside the landing at 5 ft. while armored. He takes the dry route around the overflow and keeps his allies outside the flash radius before using it.

printings.label: Sea Kin tidal basin healer, Druid 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Neressa can test a sample and tend the sick while the party searches the intake.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find why the boats can no longer draw safe water from the tidal basin.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Swim +12 on hazards and special actions

gm.title: Traits
