lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5.

Constitution 14 gives 112 rounds of held breath, or 56 rounds if she takes a standard or full-round action each round. Each such action spends one extra round. Once the budget runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and increasing by 1 each round. Failure starts drowning.
With a swim speed, she can take 10 on Swim checks for hazards or special actions even when threatened.
Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Heal) adds +3. Wild Empathy +0. No companion accompanies her on this inspection.
Caster level 1, save DC 13 + spell level, three prepared cantrips and two prepared 1st-level spells, including one Wisdom bonus slot. She carries a druidic focus and spell component pouch.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear +0 melee wielded two-handed, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, reach 5 ft.
Prepared cantrips: guidance, know direction, purify food and drink. Purify Food and Drink makes up to 1 cubic foot of ordinary spoiled or fouled food and water fit for consumption at caster level 1.

Prepared 1st-level spells: cure light wounds and speak with animals. Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+1 HP to a living creature touched. Speak with Animals lasts 1 minute at caster level 1. She can convert a 1st-level slot to Summon Nature’s Ally I, such as a porpoise in suitable water.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Examine the water at the surface before diving to inspect the intake. Use Heal on the crew and cast at the surface. A small supply can be purified for drinking while the party looks for the source of the fouling.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nerin recognizes fresh morel tracks beyond a blocked side passage. They need help moving a waterlogged beam to follow them.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a route around a flooded section of tunnel before the overnight market lets out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Fungoid Form. Nerin has advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease.
Adaptable Camouflage. At least a minute spent adjusting coloration in an area rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi gives Nerin advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Nerin has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Stealth and Survival. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Nerin’s background grants Medicine, Nature, Common, and an herbalism kit.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nerin adjusts their coloring in a fungus bed before scouting the next tunnel. If a creature follows, they use its route to lead it away from the group.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nerin needs help opening the route while he guards the approach.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the flooded arch until the crew reaches the sandbar.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple −1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +3. Iron Will adds +2 to Will. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The attack bonus includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with thrown weapons.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small shortspear +5 melee for 1d4+2 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown above water +6 for 1d4+2 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Use the piercing melee attack underwater. The usual underwater attack and damage penalties for slashing and bludgeoning weapons do not apply to the shortspear thrust.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nerin holds the flooded arch while the crew opens the route to the sandbar. Use the shortspear in melee until everyone can surface.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Neris marks the first doorway with charcoal so the party can find it from either side.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Map the lower vault and bring her notes back intact.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Roushoum, Aquan, Celestial, Draconic, Undercommon

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +3. Improved Initiative adds +4. Scribe Scroll is the Wizard bonus feat. No familiar is present.

Spell Clutch (Su). Once per day, use a standard action to prepare again one 1st-level spell you previously prepared and cast. Cast the spell separately when needed. The supernatural activation does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Wizard spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are detect magic, light, and mage hand. First-level spells are mage armor and grease. Mage armor raises AC to 15 for 1 hour, touch 11 and flat-footed 14. Grease lasts 1 round and has Reflex DC 15.
Spellbook includes Wizard cantrips and seven 1st-level spells: alarm, detect secret doors, expeditious retreat, grease, mage armor, magic missile, and shield.
After casting grease at the first doorway, use Spell Clutch to prepare it again. Cast it separately when pursuit reaches the second doorway.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Neris checks a lower vault for two routes out. She casts mage armor before entering and uses the corners and her underground Hide bonus to avoid pursuit between doors.

gm.title: Hook
lines: She can see a safe landing beyond the grate but needs the party to tell her which counterweight to release.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Free a jammed gate before the patrol makes its next circuit.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 12, Reflex 17, Will 12. Bloodied 9. One healing surge worth 4 HP. Winterkin adds +2 on death saves and saves against unconsciousness.

First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act at the start of an encounter. Once per round, Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to a qualifying dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage. Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Deft Strike (at-will, standard). Before the attack, Nesha can move 2 squares. Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Positioning Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +9 vs. Will for 1d4+5. On a hit, slide the target 1 square.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee 1 or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 2d4+5. On a hit, the target is slowed and grants Nesha combat advantage (save ends both). On a miss, half damage and it grants Nesha combat advantage through the end of Nesha’s next turn.
Shadow Jaunt (encounter, move). Teleport 3 squares, then remain insubstantial until the start of Nesha’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 4 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Nesha’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nesha jaunts past the jammed gate if she can see a clear square. If anyone follows her, she slides the first foe away from the release lever.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nessa knows who first moved the trail markers. She'll name them if the visitors agree to inspect the alternate route.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep an herb garden accessible without letting visiting carts crush the old path.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nik fits a wedge to the edge of the plate and asks the party to watch for movement above.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the party around a tunnel trip plate and into the open.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Fortitude 14, Reflex 17, Will 12. Bloodied 12. One healing surge, worth 6 HP.
Trap Sense raises AC to 19, Fortitude to 16, Reflex to 19, and Will to 14 against traps.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures that have not acted yet when the encounter starts. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to one eligible hit per round with the dagger against a target granting combat advantage.
Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attack rolls.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1 +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10 +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Deft Strike (at-will, standard). May move 2 squares before a dagger attack. Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
King’s Castle (encounter, standard). Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. Reflex for 2d4+5 on a hit. Hit or miss, switch places with a willing adjacent ally.

Trick Strike (daily, standard). Melee or ranged 5/10, +9 vs. AC for 3d4+5 and slide the target 1 square on a hit. The target can also be slid 1 square each time Nik hits it for the rest of the encounter.
Shifty is an at-will personal minor action that lets you shift 1 square.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 6 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Nik’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nik points out the exposed shortcut, then uses Shifty to clear the doorway and make room for the party.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).
Speed · 30 ft. with fast movement, base 20 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nima asks the party to wait on the bank while she finds a crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the survey party back across the river before it rises.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 14 with uncanny dodge, armor check penalty 0. BAB +2, grapple +1. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded.
+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Immune to Wild Dwarf knockout poison. Poison Use prevents accidental self-poisoning during application to a weapon.
AC 18 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Uncanny dodge retains Dexterity when flat-footed or against an invisible attacker. Weapon Focus adds +1 to handaxe attacks.
Fast Movement applies in light or medium armor and under a light or medium load. Nima is illiterate.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small handaxe +7 melee, 1d4+3 slashing, critical ×3. Add +1 to the attack against orcs and goblinoids.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. AC 12, HP 28 at full health, grapple +3, Fortitude +8, Reflex +1, Will +3. Handaxe +9 melee, 1d4+5. Lose the 4 bonus HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter when rage ends.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nima goes first along the bank and stops at the washed-out crossing. She holds the approach so the others can get to firm ground.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nura can take the party across if everyone keeps the chain of hands intact.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover the apprentices stranded on the Plane of Air before their guide's endurance expires.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. BAB +6, grapple +10. Fort +7, Ref +8, Will +8. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. Unarmored with natural armor +1 and Dexterity +3.
Fire resistance 10. She can stay on an Elemental Plane for 48 hours before taking 1 damage per additional hour. She checks the elapsed time before offering another crossing.
Nine racial ranks in each listed skill. Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Focus (scimitar), and racial Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Scimitar +11 melee, 1d6+4 slashing, critical 18–20/×2. Iterative attack at +6 on a full attack.
Change size 2/day, Fort DC 14 if resisted, as enlarge person or reduce person and can affect Nura despite her type.
Invisibility (self only) and speak with animals 3/day each, CL 12. Ethereal jaunt 1/day for 1 hour, CL 12. Create food and water 1/day, CL 7.
Plane shift at CL 13 to the Material, Astral, or Elemental Planes. Nura can bring up to eight other creatures who link hands with her.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nura changes size to clear a tight route or uses invisibility to approach a stranded crew. She saves plane shift for the return when everyone can link hands.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 Wizard NPC. Uses 4e character math.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nura offers to test an unstable doorway in exchange for a witness describing exactly what they see.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Map the unstable gaps before another traveler goes missing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Cloth, Intelligence +4 and Staff of Defense +1. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 14. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Immortal living construct. Resist 5 psychic and telepathy 5 squares with creatures that have a language. The extra shardmind skill bonus applies to Religion. Staff of Defense once per encounter adds 2 to the defense targeted by one attack as an immediate interrupt.
Ritual Caster and four wizard cantrips. Daily prepared spell is Sleep. Flaming Sphere is the alternate spell in Nura’s book.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff, melee basic. +2 vs. AC for 1d8 damage.
Ray of Frost, at-will standard, ranged 10. +4 vs. Fortitude, 1d6+4 cold and slowed until the end of Nura’s next turn.
Thunderwave, at-will standard, close blast 3 against creatures. +4 vs. Fortitude, 1d6+4 thunder and push 2 squares.

Icy Terrain, encounter standard, area burst 1 within 10 against creatures. +4 vs. Reflex, 1d6+4 cold and prone. The burst creates difficult terrain until the end of Nura’s next turn. Nura can end it as a minor action.
Sleep, daily standard, area burst 2 within 20 against creatures. +4 vs. Will, slowed (save ends) on hit or miss. A hit target that fails its first save becomes unconscious (save ends).
Shard Swarm, encounter move, close burst 1. Enemies in the burst grant combat advantage to Nura until the end of Nura’s next turn. Then teleport 3 squares.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nura lays Icy Terrain across a lane and uses Shard Swarm to escape enemies that close the distance. If they crowd together, Nura uses the exposed angles to land Thunderwave.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 4 (1 class HD, LA +3).
Speed · 30 ft.; fly 40 ft. (poor) in natural winged form

gm.title: Hook
lines: Nyrel can cross the gate once the party confirms a clear landing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the message to the far side of the gate before it seals.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4. No familiar is present.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are dimension door 1/day, charm person 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, and fire resistance 10. Dimension door is the marked choice, giving LA +3. Caster level 1.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +3 ranged for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Dimension door reaches 440 ft. at caster level 1. Its passenger allowance starts at caster level 3. After using it, Nyrel can take no further actions until the next turn. Charm person is Will DC 14 and detect thoughts is Will DC 15.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and grease share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 17 for 1 hour, touch 13, flat-footed 14. Grease is Reflex DC 14 and lasts 1 round.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Nyrel scouts the courtyard in a humanoid guise, then uses dimension door to carry the message across the closed gate after the party clears the far side.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
Speed · 25 ft., burrow 20 ft. in earth or sand

gm.title: Hook
lines: Oolay has two working routes to the far bank. The shorter passes through sand and the longer crosses a bridge watched by the forgery’s author.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Deliver a corrected sluice schedule before the culvert fills.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +4. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Expertise in Perception and Stealth. Thieves’ tools +5 on Dexterity checks. Knows Thieves’ Cant.
Hardy. Resist poison damage and roll saves against poison with advantage.
Spines. A creature grappling Oolay, or grappled by him, takes 1d4 piercing at the start of his turn.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn to a finesse or ranged hit with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Oolay has no disadvantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Oolay uses Acrobatics to break a grapple and Disengages before leaving reach. He burrows into firm earth or sand to put a barrier between himself and an attacker.

gm.title: Hook
lines: A voice above the gallery tells the party where they can safely put their feet.

gm.title: Role
lines: Sentry who watches a gallery from the wall and casts web across its approaches.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep looters away from the half-collapsed gallery until two trapped workers get out.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +4 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +6. Spell resistance 10.
Alertness, Combat Casting and Improved Initiative. May take 10 on Climb while threatened.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite +5 melee, 1d4+1 piercing. Fortitude DC 15 negates 1d4 temporary Strength damage on contact and again 1 minute later.

Sorcerer casting at CL 4, save DC 13 + spell level. Daily slots 6/7/4. Knows dancing lights, detect magic, light, mage hand, message, ray of frost, mage armor, magic missile, shield, and web. Mage armor raises AC to 21 for 4 hours. Magic missile sends two 1d4+1 force missiles. Shield lasts 4 minutes, prevents magic missile, and grants directional cover (+7 AC and +3 on Reflex against area effects from that half). Ray of frost +6 ranged touch for 1d3 cold.

Web at up to 140 ft., 20-ft.-radius spread, duration 40 minutes with opposing supports. Reflex DC 15 or stuck. A stuck creature can spend a round to break free (DC 20 Strength or DC 25 Escape Artist). A creature that saves or breaks free can spend a round moving 5 ft. per full 5 points by which a new Strength or Escape Artist check exceeds 10. Spell resistance applies. Fire burns away affected web sections and deals 2d4 fire damage to creatures in the burning webs.

Each spell-like ability 1/day at CL 4, DC 13 + spell level. Clairaudience/clairvoyance, dancing lights, darkness, detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect magic, discern lies, dispel magic, faerie fire, levitate, and suggestion.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Check the approach from cover using clairvoyance. Cast web between the gallery supports after workers pass, then remain above reach and use magic missile against a looter who gets through.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
Speed · 40 ft. in light armor with a light load

gm.title: Hook
lines: Oren is waiting at the entrance while the snow blocks the upper path.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the shelter passage clear until the last travelers arrive.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Fast movement raises land speed to 40 ft. with this gear and adds +4 to Jump.

Climate Tolerant (Ex) waives environmental Fortitude saves between −20°F and 140°F. It gives no protection from fire or cold damage and counts as Cold Endurance only for feat and prestige-class prerequisites.
+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Primitive Weapon Mastery adds +1 to greatclub and javelin attacks. Barbarian proficiency covers both weapons. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Oren is illiterate.

Rage 1/day lasts 8 rounds with the improved Constitution modifier. It gives +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 morale on Will saves, and −2 AC. HP rises by 2, Fortitude becomes +7, Will becomes +3, and AC drops to 11. Oren is fatigued when rage ends.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Greatclub +6 melee with two hands for 1d10+6 bludgeoning, critical ×2. While raging, greatclub +8 for 1d10+9.
Javelin +3 thrown for 1d6+4 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft. While raging, javelin stays +3 and deals 1d6+6.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Oren waits by the shelter passage while the party brings people in from the cold. His climate trait covers the ambient cold within its range. Resolve fire or cold attacks normally.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Orla waves the party through as the bridge starts to shake.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the bridge until the last evacuee crosses.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Chain shirt and Defense fighting style. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Str +5 and Con +5.
Patterned Feathers gives advantage on Stealth checks to hide in a forest. Imposing grants Intimidation proficiency.
Second Wind (bonus action) restores 1d10+2 HP. Action Surge provides one extra action on Orla’s turn. Both recharge after short or long rests.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light hammer +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Strength under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Brawler (bonus action after a talon hit). With a free hand, grapple that target using Athletics +5 against its choice of Athletics or Acrobatics. The target can be at most one size larger.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Orla lets evacuees pass first. She tries to restrain someone rushing the bridge so the people behind her have time to cross.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Orla spots a false exit guard and asks the party to walk the witness through as if the guard belongs there.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Deliver a witness safely to the magistrate.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor. Fortitude 16, Reflex 12, Will 15. Bloodied 10. One healing surge worth 5 HP, or 3 while bloodied.
Orla counts as living and undead and chooses the result if a power treats the two differently. Resist 5 necrotic.
Combat Leader adds +2 to Orla’s initiative and grants a +2 power bonus to initiative to allies within 10 squares who can see and hear her.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5.
Wolf Pack Tactics (at-will, standard). Before attacking, let one ally adjacent to Orla or her target shift 1 square. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5.

Guarding Attack (encounter, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5. On a hit, one ally adjacent to Orla or the target gains +2 power bonus to AC against that target through the end of Orla’s next turn.

Bastion of Defense (daily, standard). Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 3d8+5. On a hit, allies within 5 squares gain a +1 power bonus to defenses through the encounter. Hit or miss, allies within 5 squares gain 8 temporary HP.
Inspiring Word (encounter, minor, twice per encounter and once per round). Orla or one ally in close burst 5 can spend a healing surge to regain its value plus 1d6 HP.
Lifeblood (encounter, free) triggers when Orla bloodies or kills an enemy. Choose a shift up to 7 squares, 5 temporary HP, or a +2 power bonus to attacks through the end of Orla’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 5 HP, or 3 if bloodied, and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Orla’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Orla makes space for the witness with Wolf Pack Tactics. If a wound triggers Lifeblood, she shifts to the witness’s side or takes temporary HP if she is already in place.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ornek can identify an unusual seam in the new stonework if the party brings the old floor plan.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Identify the old exit an ethereal traveler crossed just before a tunnel was bricked up.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Each listed Expert class skill has four ranks. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. Stonecunning adds another +2 when checking unusual stonework, including a stonework trap. A search is possible within 10 ft. even without actively looking.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ornek surveys a bricked-up passage after glimpsing an ethereal traveler through its entrance. He marks the seam for the party and uses ordinary tools to check the wall.

printings.label: Dragonborn of Bahamut ravine rope guard, Wings Fighter 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Orra can bring a light messenger line down from the high ledge while the party carries the heavier rope.

gm.title: Role
lines: Ravine rope guard and Wings Fighter.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Restore the torn rope crossing before the last travellers arrive.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Former dwarf. Keeps the dwarf subtype, the 20-ft. base land speed, and the dwarf +2 Constitution and −2 Charisma adjustments. Rebirth adds +2 Constitution and −2 Dexterity. The rite removes darkvision, stability, and the old armored movement perk.

Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +0. Armor check penalty −4. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to attack.
Against attacks by Dragon-type creatures, +2 dodge AC (AC 19, touch 13 when eligible for the dodge bonus). Immune to dragons’ frightful presence.
Wings is her only aspect. Jump +7 includes 4 ranks, +3 Strength, +10 racial, −4 armor check penalty, and −6 for her 20-ft. land speed. Her listed equipment is a light load.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Glide with a light load at 30 ft. with average maneuverability, moving 20 ft. forward per 5 ft. of descent and negating falling damage. Orra has no powered flight at 1 HD. If unconscious or helpless in midair, her involuntary descent limits falling damage to 1d6.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Orra wants to replace a torn ravine rope before the last travellers arrive. She can glide down with the light messenger line while the party carries the heavier replacement rope along the ridge.

printings.label: Dekanter Goblin gallery lookout, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, LA +4).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Orrik signals from the high gallery that a rope is missing from the shaft.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out why the lift has stopped before sending anyone down.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +2, grapple +7. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Power Attack can trade up to 2 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Horn +7 melee, 1d6+5 piercing, critical ×3. Full attack with the horn and two secondary claws at +2 each for 1d4+2 each, critical ×2.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Orrik watches the higher gallery. He prefers to stay by the narrow bend if a fight breaks out, where he has room to use his claws.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Orrin can repair the route lanterns if the party finds him somewhere dry to work.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Salvage the paper lanterns that were left under a leaking roof before the procession assembles.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +2.
+4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.

Against Giant-type creatures, AC 18 or AC 22 with mage armor while able to dodge. Touch 18 includes the dodge bonus. Skill Focus (Spellcraft) and racial Listen bonus are included. Immune to confusion effects. Familiar slot open.
Luck of Chaos (Ex) allows one reroll per day of a roll the gnome just made, before the DM announces success or failure. Keep the new result even if it is worse.
Spell Power adds +1 effective caster level to spells with the chaos descriptor. It applies to level-dependent spell variables and caster level checks and stacks with other Spell Power abilities.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Small dagger +0 melee, 1d3−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1 damage, critical 19–20/×2.

Five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Known 0-level spells are detect magic, light, message, and ray of frost. Known 1st-level spells are mage armor and protection from law. Base caster level 1 and spell save DC 13 + spell level.
Mage armor gives AC 18, flat-footed 15, for 1 hour. Ray of frost is a +4 ranged touch attack within 25 ft. for 1d3 cold damage. Spell Power casts protection from law at caster level 2 for 2 minutes.

Protection from law wards one creature touched. It grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against lawful creatures’ attacks or effects. It blocks new possession and suppresses ongoing mental control regardless of alignment. It also blocks contact by lawful summoned creatures. The contact ward ends if the subject attacks a blocked creature or forces the barrier against it. Spell resistance can bypass the contact ward.
Entropic shield 1/day at caster level 1. The personal effect lasts 1 minute and gives ranged attacks that require an attack roll a 20% miss chance.

Daze, flare, and prestidigitation 1/day each at caster level 1. Daze affects a humanoid of 4 HD or less. On a failed Will DC 13 save, the target takes no actions for 1 round. Flare is Fortitude DC 13 or dazzled for 1 minute.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Orrin wants help drying out the flooded lantern stock before the procession arrives. He uses mage armor if the work area is threatened and protection from law at the first sign of trouble from a lawful summoned creature.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Oru can listen for movement through the flooded cave mouth.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach the stranded gatherers before the tide closes the cave.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Blindsense 20 ft. in water only.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Oru spent 2 skill points to learn Common. Illiterate.
Barbarian fast movement raises land speed to 30 ft. in light armor with a light load. Swim speed stays 40 ft.
Hold Breath (Ex). At Constitution 16, budget 128 rounds before drowning checks in a calm dive. Track exertion under the drowning rules.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.

Rage 1/day lasts 8 rounds at the increased Constitution modifier. It gives +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, +2 morale on Will saves, and −2 AC. HP rises by 2, Fortitude becomes +7, Will becomes +3, and AC drops to 11. Oru is fatigued when rage ends.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Primary bite +5 melee, 1d6+6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, critical ×2. Against sahuagin the bite is +7 for 1d6+8.
While raging the primary bite is +7 for 1d6+9, or +9 for 1d6+11 against sahuagin.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Oru dives through the flooded cave mouth to find stranded gatherers. Use echolocation to locate nearby creatures in murky water. Surface at the air pocket before holding off pursuers on the rock shelf.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Oswin can inspect the dark maintenance stair if the party keeps the main lever still.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find what keeps tripping the cistern gate before the next water draw.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft.; Shadow Affinity in darkness or shadowy illumination

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +1.

In darkness or shadowy illumination, add +2 to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. Attacks suffer −1 in bright sunlight or inside daylight, and gain +1 against orcs and half-orcs. Apply both attack modifiers if both conditions hold.
Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. In darkness or shadowy illumination, Hide +7, Move Silently +7, Search +11, and Spot +7.
Trapfinding permits searching for traps with DC above 20 and using Disable Device on magical traps. He carries ordinary thieves’ tools.

Sneak Attack +1d6 when he flanks a creature or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged attacks must be within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits and have no concealment from Oswin.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +2 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Inspect the dark cistern steps before anyone pulls the main lever. Keep one route lit for the party and use the shadowed side passage to spot traps or tampering.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Parry can hold the mill gate while the party checks the service ladder.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the approach clear until the workers finish closing the shutters.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Natural armor +1, chain shirt +4, and Dexterity +3 after the racial armor cap. Touch 13, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −4. With the shirt removed, AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 11.
BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +0. The armor cap applies to AC. Initiative and Reflex still use Dexterity +4.
Two-Weapon Fighting is the Fighter bonus feat. Weapon Focus (longsword) adds +1 to longsword attacks. The natural spikes are a light off-hand option with the racial proficiency.
Natural armor +1, acid resistance 5, and DR 2/piercing or slashing. Either piercing or slashing bypasses the DR. The official errata corrects the first printing’s DR label.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Natural spikes alone +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach.

Two-weapon full attack: longsword +2 for 1d8+2 and light off-hand spikes +1 for 1d6+1. Apply −2 to both attacks and half the Strength bonus to off-hand damage. The spikes occupy the off-hand attack in this sequence.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Parry waits at the mill gate while the workers bring down the shutters. He keeps his chain shirt on while holding the approach. If he needs to climb the service ladder, he can take off the shirt first to free his reach and improve Climb.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pell can scout as a cat and get the tack-room door open if the party watches the mews.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Retrieve a misdelivered letter before the porter locks up.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Humanoid form uses studded leather +3, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Cat form: Tiny, STR 3, DEX 18, HP 8, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −12, Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor and thieves’ tools meld.
Trapfinding and sneak attack +1d6. Search can locate traps with DC above 20. Magical traps can be disarmed with Disable Device. Pell returns to humanoid form to manipulate his tools.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small dagger +1 melee, 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Cat form: claw −2 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at −2 and bite −7 for 1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. All critical hits are ×2. Tiny reach requires entering the target’s space and normally provokes. The listed damage includes the minimum 1 before damage reduction.

Add 1d6 sneak attack to a qualifying attack against a target denied Dexterity to AC or when flanking with melee. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft. The cat’s 0-ft. reach cannot flank, but it can still sneak attack a target denied Dexterity to AC.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pell scouts the mews in cat form while the porter makes his rounds. He returns to humanoid form in an alcove and uses his tools to open the tack-room lock. The party can warn him if the porter returns during the change.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pell will walk the group to the ferry after closing if they bring a copy of the charter to the next meeting.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a lease over a ferry landing where her neighbors work.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Knows a nearby route to cover. The route is visible to a creature that watches the warden take it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Hook staff. Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Sling. Ranged attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses cover and directs bystanders out of the scene. Offers a route to safety once the other side stops pressing.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pella can keep the crossing open if the party helps count the damaged goods in front of both drivers.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Resolve a dispute over damaged cargo before sunset strands both wagons at the bridge.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 17. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +4.
+4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Against Giant-type creatures, AC 22 and touch 16 while able to dodge. Skill Focus (Diplomacy) and racial Listen bonus are included. Immune to confusion effects.
Luck of Chaos (Ex) allows one reroll per day of a roll the gnome just made, before the DM announces success or failure. Keep the new result even if it is worse.

A chaotic good cleric devoted to the ideals of freedom and charity. Chaos and Good domains add +1 caster level to chaos and good spells respectively. The Chaos domain bonus stacks with racial Spell Power.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small light mace +1 melee, 1d4 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Small dart +2 ranged, 1d3 piercing, critical ×2, 20-ft. increment.

Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, guidance, and light. Prepared 1st-level spells are bless and cure light wounds, with protection from law in the domain slot. Base caster level 1 and spell save DC 12 + spell level. Spontaneously trade non-domain prepared spells for cures of the same level or lower.
Protection from law uses effective caster level 3 and lasts 3 minutes.
Turn undead 4/day. Turning check 1d20+1 and turning damage 2d6+2, as a 1st-level cleric.

Protection from law wards one creature touched. It grants +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against lawful creatures’ attacks or effects. It blocks new possession and suppresses ongoing mental control regardless of alignment. It also blocks contact by lawful summoned creatures. The contact ward ends if the subject attacks a blocked creature or forces the barrier against it. Spell resistance can bypass the contact ward.
Entropic shield 1/day at caster level 1. The personal effect lasts 1 minute and gives ranged attacks that require an attack roll a 20% miss chance.

Daze, flare, and prestidigitation 1/day each at caster level 1. Daze affects a humanoid of 4 HD or less. On a failed Will DC 11 save, the target takes no actions for 1 round. Flare is Fortitude DC 11 or dazzled for 1 minute.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pella has stopped both wagons at the bridge until the damaged cargo is counted. She asks the party to hear each driver’s claim. If a lawful summoned guard intervenes, Pella casts protection from law on the person closest to it.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (2 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Perrin shows the party a washed-out trail marker and points to the old crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find which bridge supports failed before the next supply run.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty 0. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded.
+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Immune to Wild Dwarf knockout poison. Poison Use prevents accidental self-poisoning during application to a weapon.
AC 20 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Trapfinding. Evasion in light armor, except while helpless. Tumble synergy is included in Balance.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small handaxe +3 melee, 1d4+1 slashing, critical ×3. Small blowgun +5 ranged, 1 piercing, critical ×2, 10-ft. range increment. Point Blank Shot raises the blowgun to +6 and 2 piercing within 30 ft. before range penalties. Add +1 to either attack against orcs and goblinoids.
Sneak attack +1d6 when the target is denied Dexterity to AC or flanked. For ranged attacks, the target must be within 30 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Perrin checks the trail markers before the crew moves. If the crossing is contested, he uses cover to watch the far bank.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Rogue 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Infiltration and evacuation.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pip asks the party to clear a second exit while they slip through the press to check the wards.

gm.title: Role
lines: Carries messages where disease or crowds stop other runners.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get medicine and patients through a blocked infirmary entrance.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common and Sylvan from Wechselkind. Dwarvish from the 2014 Noble background.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dexterity save +4 and Intelligence save +3. Studded leather armor. Expertise in Acrobatics and Stealth.
Artificial Form. Humanoid. Advantage against being poisoned, poison resistance, disease immunity, and no need for food, drink, sleep, or air. Magical aging has no effect.
Childish Agility. Can move through the space of larger creatures. Cunning Action allows Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

Sneak Attack, once per turn. Add 1d6 when a finesse or ranged weapon attack hits with advantage, or when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Pip does not have disadvantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.
Shortbow. +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.
Faerie Glamour, once per long rest. Cast disguise self (DC 12 to discern by inspection) to resemble the one child Pip was created to replace.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pip slips through the crowd to reach the blocked infirmary exit and uses Cunning Action to cover ground before the next patient arrives.

printings.label: Air mephling bell loft guide, Bard 1

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pip can fly through the hatch and mark the safe route.

gm.title: Role
lines: Air mephling bell loft guide and Bard.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the party past a collapsed stair.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. Studded leather armor +3, Dexterity +3, size +1. Armor check penalty −1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Bardic music 1/day. Inspire courage adds +1 morale on attack and weapon damage rolls and on saves against charm and fear. Allies must hear the performance.
Bardic knowledge +1. Bard can cast Bard spells in light armor without arcane spell failure. Matching air spells gain +1 caster level. None of these cantrips have the Air descriptor.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of dust and grit (piercing), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit for 1d6+1.
Bard cantrips, CL 1, two casts per day. Detect magic, ghost sound (Will DC 13 if interacted with), light, and message.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pip flies up through the bell loft’s broken hatch, signals the party with his flute, and guides them across the narrow gallery. If a creature blocks the exit, he waits for his allies to clear the cone before using his breath.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form

gm.title: Hook
lines: Plip knows where the grate leaves an opening into the release chamber.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach the submerged release without trapping the party on the wrong side.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +5.

Alternate Form (Su). Enter amorphous form as a standard action. It gives a 30-ft. swim speed and passage through openings as small as 2 inches in diameter. Return to normal form with a full-round action that does not provoke.

In amorphous form all worn and carried equipment melds and magic items stop functioning. Material and natural armor cease to apply. Dexterity, any effective deflection bonus, and armor from force effects can apply.

In amorphous form the Slyth cannot attack, be flanked, or be stunned, and is immune to critical hits. Other supernatural abilities stop. Spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components cannot be cast.
The form lasts up to 10 minutes per class level. After returning to normal, wait as long as the actual time spent in amorphous form before changing again.
Water Breathing (Ex) allows indefinite breathing underwater. Immunities (Ex) cover polymorphing and poison. Sonic resistance 5.
Armor is AC 15 in normal form and AC 13 in amorphous form, with touch 13 and flat-footed 10 in amorphous form.

Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. Wild empathy +1. No animal companion is present in this encounter.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff +0 melee with one end for 1d6 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Use it in normal form.

Druid spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required). These prepared spells require components, so cast them only in normal form.

At one class level, plan for a maximum of 10 minutes in amorphous form. After a six-minute swim through the grate, return to normal in a space large enough to stand and wait six minutes before shifting again.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Plip follows the flooded channel through the grate to reach the sluice release from the other side. She returns to normal form before working the release or casting.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Pohl can watch the approaches while the party moves the travellers from arch to arch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the late travellers off the road before undead reach the arches.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. This encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Initiative includes the species bonus +2.

Point Blank Shot adds +1 to ranged attack and damage within 30 ft. Favored enemy undead adds +2 to weapon damage and Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival against undead. Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. No spells at Ranger 1.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.

While blinded, AC 11 and touch AC 8 after losing Dexterity AC and taking −2 AC. Move at half speed, 20 ft. Sight-dependent checks fail. Search and most Strength- or Dexterity-based skill checks take −4 when they can be attempted. Opponents have total concealment (50% miss chance).
Dazzled in bright light after the first round. AC 16 and movement 40 ft. Longsword +1, longbow +3 or +4 within 30 ft. before range modifiers, Search +4, and Spot +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longbow +4 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. increment. Point Blank Shot gives +5 and 1d8+1 within 30 ft.
A longbow hit against undead within 30 ft. deals 1d8+3 with Point Blank Shot and Favored Enemy. When dazzled that shot is +4 and deals the same damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pohl watches for undead along a road where two stone arches give cover after dusk. He asks the party to walk the late travellers through the arches. If daylight blinds him, he backs away from the road on the first round and resumes watching when he can see.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Qid spots a ledge above the sentries where her four blades can reach them.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a way past the blocked gallery without alerting the guards.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4 and size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +9, Will +3.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.
Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for the light short swords. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One Small short sword +7 melee for 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2.

Four light short swords as a full attack with Multiweapon Fighting. Each attacks at +5. The primary sword deals 1d4+1 piercing and each off-hand sword deals 1d4 piercing. All threaten on 19–20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
While dazzled, the single attack is +6, the full-attack swings are +4 each, and Search is +3.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Qid circles the party along the ceiling with her hands free, then descends to a ledge. She draws her swords once she has footing and uses the four-sword full attack when she can stay in place.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rasha finds a broken trail marker and offers to trade what she knows for news of the next ridge.

gm.title: Role
lines: Outrider who switches from archery to a charge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Check the boundary trail before the pack comes through.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Fortitude 14, Reflex 16, Will 12. Bloodied 11. One healing surge, worth 5 HP.

Archer Fighting Style gives Defensive Mobility, granting +2 AC against opportunity attacks. Hunter’s Quarry designates the nearest visible foe as a minor action. Once per round a hit against that foe can deal 1d6 extra damage.
Blood Fury adds 2 to damage rolls while you are bloodied, or 4 at level 21.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Handaxe basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +5 vs. AC for 1d6+3. Longbow basic attack at range 20/40 is +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Nimble Strike (at-will, standard). Shift 1 square before or after a longbow attack at range 20/40. +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Two-Fanged Strike (encounter, standard). Two longbow attacks against one creature at range 20/40. Each is +7 vs. AC for 1d10+5. If both hit, deal 1 additional damage.

Hunter’s Bear Trap (daily, standard). Range 20/40, +7 vs. AC for 2d10+5, and the target is slowed and takes ongoing 5 damage (one save ends both). On a miss, half damage and slowed until the end of Rasha’s next turn.
Ferocious Charge (encounter, standard). With the handaxe ready, charge up to speed under the normal charge rules. +6 vs. AC for 1d6+5. If bloodied, damage is 1d6+7 before Hunter’s Quarry.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 5 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Rasha’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rasha starts at bow range. When a foe closes and leaves a charge lane, Rasha puts the bow aside and presses through that gap with the handaxe.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
Speed · 30 ft., sandswim 30 ft. in leather armor with a light load

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rashen can reach the release frame from outside the sandlock.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the jammed release without letting sand fill the room.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Body Lamp senses solid objects to 60 ft. in loose soil while active.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Sandswim (Su) works in sand, dust, ash, and softsand. Slipsand, packed dirt, and rock are excluded. Under sand it allows normal breathing. It gives no protection from water or dangerous gases.
The player entry gives land speed in light armor or with a light load. Heavier armor or a medium load limits it to 5 ft. A heavy load prevents movement.

Body Lamp (Su) glows at will, with bright light to 60 ft. and shadowy illumination to 120 ft. In loose soil the Asherati can make out solid objects to 60 ft. for navigation and general identification. Other creatures in the sand see an orange glow. The glow confers no finer perception or advantage against invisibility or concealment. The Asherati cannot Hide while glowing.
Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects and heat protection level 1, with no heat saves needed through 120°F.
Water Vulnerability. Completely wet causes −1 on attack rolls, ability checks, and skill checks. Immersion prevents breath-holding and immediately triggers Constitution checks against drowning.

Hide and Move Silently each include +2 racial. Sand adds another +2 to Hide when unlit. Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a flanked target or one denied Dexterity to AC, if there is no concealment. Ranged sneak attack is limited to 30 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Shortbow +3 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft.
Body Lamp flash, 1/day as a free action. All creatures within 30 ft. must pass Fortitude DC 12 or be dazzled for 1 minute (−1 on attack rolls, Search, and Spot).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rashen follows loose sand to a blocked sandlock. He turns on Body Lamp to find the release frame below the sand. On the surface he extinguishes the glow before hiding. He warns the party to clear the radius before flashing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rell wants the crossing kept open. He offers to go below the water to retrieve a slipped mooring.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the last passenger across before someone cuts the ferry rope.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity + Constitution.
Imperfect Undeath. Humanoid vulnerable to effects that target undead. Rell can receive ordinary healing.
Resist necrotic and poison. Immune to disease. Advantage on saves against charm and poison. Sunlight Sensitivity applies to attacks and sight-based Perception.
Undead Vitality. Rell does not breathe. The encounter assumes Rell has fed within the past 24 hours.
Undead Fortitude. Once per long rest, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 when the hit does not kill Rell outright.
Reckless Attack. On the first attack of his turn, Rell can claim advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against him then have advantage until his next turn.
Danger Sense gives advantage on Dexterity saves against visible effects while Rell can see, hear and act.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite. Melee unarmed attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 3 with two hands.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest. Up to 1 minute, advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage to Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Ends early on unconsciousness, or at the end of a turn if he has neither attacked a hostile creature since the last turn nor taken damage since then.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rell holds the landing long enough for passengers to clear it. If pushed into the river, he uses the fact that he does not breathe to reach the rope below the waterline.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rellan is holding the manifest until a neutral party can compare it with the shipowner's advances book.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Leave town with all the wages the shipowner promised his crew.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rem can show the witness both appearances from the registry counter if the party brings the disputed copy.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reconcile the two docket copies before the afternoon hearing.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Disguise +6, or +16 with Minor Change Shape

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
+2 racial on saving throws against sleep and charm effects.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) adds +3. Natural Linguist makes Speak Language a class skill. Elven comes from Intelligence, and two skill points buy Dwarven and Giant.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, minimum 1 damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rem needs someone to compare two copies of the same docket before the hearing begins. As the relief clerk, Rem showed a different face but wore the same office coat. If the party brings the witness upstairs, Rem can repeat the change in front of them.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rena knows when the sluice gate closes and can hold the causeway while the party leads people off it.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the crossing open long enough for the night shift to get away.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative is the Fighter bonus feat.
Three essentia from her race, Cobalt Charge, and Midnight Dodge. Invests 1 in each feat for 24 hours. The normal capacity is 1 per feat. One point remains unspent.

Midnight Dodge grants +1 dodge AC against one opponent designated on Rena’s turn. She may change the target each turn without moving any essentia. AC 16 against that opponent, or 14 while under the charge penalty. Losing her Dexterity bonus also removes the dodge bonus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Cobalt Charge with the greatsword: +7 melee, 2d6+5 slashing. This includes the ordinary +2 charge attack bonus and a +1 insight bonus to attack and damage. Charge imposes −2 AC until her next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rena keeps the causeway clear while mill workers cross. She chooses the opponent most likely to reach her, then charges only when she has a clear lane. If the gate or workers block that lane, she holds the bottleneck.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Renn can carry the signal line up to the catwalk.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the release catch before the broken landing gives way.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Padded armor +1 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +0.

Gliding. While using its membranes to glide, a Hadozee takes no damage from a fall of any height. It can travel 20 ft. horizontally for each 5 ft. descended, with glide speed 40 ft. and average maneuverability in the p. 41 player rules. Gliding requires descent.
Hadozee have +4 racial bonuses on Balance and Climb. They keep their Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing and can climb with one hand occupied.
Dodge is Renn’s first-level feat. AC +1 against one designated opponent, including while climbing. Lose the dodge bonus in situations that deny the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or flanked by Renn. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger +1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Thrown dagger +4 for 1d4+1 piercing, range increment 10 ft.
On a clear crossing, a drop of 5 ft. allows a glide of up to 20 ft. horizontally. A drop of 10 ft. allows up to 40 ft. horizontally with the 40-ft. glide speed.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Renn checks the raised catwalk for a release catch. He carries the signal cord in one hand while climbing, then glides from the damaged landing to the lower platform.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 Monk NPC. Uses 4e character math.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Reth asks visitors to cross the threshold one at a time and offers to carry their guide’s lantern.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep both sides of the border from blaming each other for the broken gate.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Cloth, Dexterity +4 and Unarmored Defense +2. Fortitude 13, Reflex 15, Will 14. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Initiative includes +2 Danger Sense and +4 Improved Initiative.

Centered Breath adds +1 Fortitude through Mental Equilibrium. A mundane ki focus provides no enhancement. Choose one Full Discipline per turn unless an action point permits switching. Its movement and attack techniques use their listed actions.
Defended Mind grants +2 on saving throws against daze, domination, and stun. On second wind, Reth can also shift 3 as a free action.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Monk unarmed strike, melee basic. +4 vs. AC, 1d8+1 damage while at least one hand is free.
Five Storms, at-will Full Discipline. Standard attack, close burst 1, +4 vs. Reflex against visible enemies for 1d8+4. Movement technique shifts 2 squares as a move action.
Dragon’s Tail, at-will Full Discipline. Standard melee touch, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 and prone. Its move technique swaps places with an adjacent ally or prone enemy.

Drunken Monkey, encounter Full Discipline. Standard melee touch, +4 vs. Will against an enemy for 1d8+4 and slide 1. The target then makes a free melee basic attack with +3 to hit against an enemy that Reth chooses. Its move technique moves up to 7 squares ignoring difficult terrain, with +3 to defenses against opportunity attacks.
Masterful Spiral, daily standard, close burst 1 against enemies. +4 vs. Reflex, 3d8+4 force and half damage on a miss. The stance increases melee touch reach by 1 until it ends.

Centered Flurry of Blows, free once per round after a hit on Reth’s turn. An adjacent creature takes 5 damage. Slide it to an adjacent square, or 1 square in any direction if the triggering attack did not target it.
Iron Mind, encounter immediate interrupt when hit. Increase all defenses by 2 until the end of Reth’s next turn and check the triggering attack against the boosted defense.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Reth uses Iron Mind to hold the doorway, and Dragon’s Tail to trade places with an ally. Second wind and Shifting Fortunes move him back into the next choke point.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rimewillow knows where a fox has been using the hollow.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a trail that the stranded travelers can cross.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2, size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +2, Will +5.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Knowledge [nature]) adds +3. Wild empathy +1. The encounter begins without an animal companion present.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small quarterstaff +1 melee with one end for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch active while holding it. Critical ×2.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.
Prepared druid spells, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rimewillow uses speak with animals to ask a fox which trail remains open. She takes the party through a cold hollow and uses the staff only if something blocks the way.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ripple can reach the far ladder and signal when the line is ready.

gm.title: Role
lines: Water mephling sluice rescuer and Monk.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a rope across the flooded sluice.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Material Plane. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +2. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −2. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +4. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for hazards or special actions, and permits taking 10 even under pressure. She still needs to breathe air.

Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day, declared before the attack roll. On a damaging hit the target must pass Fortitude DC 12 or be stunned for one round.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of caustic liquid (acid), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 13 half. No attack roll.
Small Monk unarmed strike +3 melee, 1d4+2 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Unarmed flurry +1/+1 on a full attack, 1d4+2 each.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ripple swims a rope to the sluice ladder, surfaces, then helps the party guide workers onto the dry ledge. She saves the caustic breath for a clear cone on land.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rivet can descend with a line while the party controls the hoist brake above.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a new guide chain down to the stranded hoist platform.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Unarmored, +4 natural armor. Touch 10, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +1. Alertness gives +2 Listen and Spot. Barbarian illiteracy applies.
Fast movement adds 10 ft. with his light load and no armor. The 40-ft. speed gives +4 to Jump. His matching lower arm steadies his Large longsword, and it is a one-handed attack for him.
Immune to sleep effects. Monstrous Humanoid type.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large longsword +4 melee, 2d6+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. No oversized attack penalty with the lower arms available for support.

Rage once per day, at most once per encounter, lasts 8 rounds. STR 20 and CON 20. HP 17, AC 12 (touch 8, flat-footed 12), grapple +6, Fortitude +7, Reflex +0, Will +3. Large longsword +6 for 2d6+5, javelin +1 for 1d6+5. Climb +9 and Jump +13. Remove 2 HP when it ends, then apply fatigue for the rest of the encounter (−2 Strength and Dexterity, no running or charging).

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rivet keeps watch beside a scree hoist that has lost a guide chain. He can take the line down to a lower ledge with his wings while the party works the brake. If anything comes over the side, he braces the longsword with his lower hand.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rova can lead the party to the shelter if they help account for the crew at the path marker.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the quarry crew into shelter before the next fall.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Space and natural reach 5 ft. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +9 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1.

Improved Initiative adds +4. Fast Movement adds 10 ft. before armor and load modifiers. With the listed gear and a light load, speed is 40 ft. and Jump includes the +4 speed bonus. Barbarian illiteracy applies.

Mountain Movement allows standing long jumps and high jumps using the running Jump rules. Accelerated climbing moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 Climb penalty. Climb checks still apply.
Acclimated removes the altitude penalties under Mountain Travel in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 90. Acclimation persists after time at low elevation.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large greatsword +5 melee, 3d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft. In Mountain Rage, +7 melee, 3d6+10 slashing, 10-ft. reach.
Large javelin +2 ranged, 1d8+4 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. In Mountain Rage, +1 ranged and 1d8+7 piercing.

Mountain Rage once per day, at most once per encounter, for up to 7 rounds. Rova can enter it on her turn without spending an action. Become Large with 10-ft. space and reach, Strength 25, Constitution 19, HP 16, AC 11, touch 8, flat-footed 10, grapple +12, Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +3, Climb +10, and Jump +14. Weapons stay Large and the grapple size modifier stays +4. Remove 2 bonus HP when rage ends. Fatigue lasts through the encounter, with −2 Str and Dex and no running or charging.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rova calls the watch when stones start moving above the quarry path. She holds anyone at the marked turn until the path is clear, and uses Mountain Rage to defend the shelter if a creature follows the crew down.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rovan can reach the far stair if the party clears the square and holds the loose line.

gm.title: Role
lines: Festival rigging keeper and apprentice Soulknife.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring the festival lanterns down before a jammed counterweight tears free.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, Will +3.
+1 racial bonus to saves against powers, spells and spell-like effects. Base saves appear above.
Improved Initiative. Soulknife bonus feats Weapon Focus (mind blade) and Wild Talent. Reserve 3 PP from Wild Talent and Naturally Psionic. Blade and Burst consume none of that reserve.
The mind blade has hardness 10 and 10 HP. It dissipates when released. It counts as magic for overcoming damage reduction.
Racial Burst 3/day. Standard action. Base land speed becomes 40 ft. for 3 rounds, with +4 to Jump from the increased speed. It costs no PP.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Form mind blade (Su) as a move action. Mind blade +2 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, reach 5 ft.
Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ask the party to clear the square before freeing the jammed lantern counterweight. Use Burst to reach the far stair once the platform is clear. Keep the mind blade in hand if needed.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.
Speed · 25 ft. walk, 15 ft. burrow through soil

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rowan asks a beetle which camp crossed the garden wall, then offers to pass on what it saw.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Send a message to both camps before a quarrel reaches the village.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Quill AC 14 + Dexterity modifier. Dexterity save +4, Charisma save +5. Jack of All Trades gives +1 to initiative and other ability checks that do not already include proficiency.
Speak With Bugs conveys simple ideas to Beast insects, spiders, worms, and similar creatures. Song of Rest lets a friendly creature spending Hit Dice in a short rest regain an extra 1d6 HP.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing. Bard spell save DC 13, spell attack +5, three 1st-level slots. Cantrips mage hand and vicious mockery. Known spells cure wounds, faerie fire, healing word, speak with animals, and thunderwave.

Bardic Inspiration. Three times per long rest, bonus action to grant a d6 to another creature within 60 ft. that can hear Rowan. Healing word restores 1d4+3 HP at range 60 ft. as a bonus action using a spell slot.
Forest Magic grants druidcraft and one 2nd-level casting of animal messenger per short or long rest.

Curl Up as an action. AC 19, no Dexterity bonus. Rowan cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components. Each creature missing him with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing. A hit knocks him prone at the end of the turn. Rowan may uncurl on his turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rowan sends word before taking sides. If pinned down on soil, he burrows out of reach or curls up to hold the passage.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rripp gives the party a signal when the unseen swimmer passes the sluice.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the moving intruder before it reaches the upper gate.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, natural armor +6. Touch 13, flat-footed 18. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +8, Will +6.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
