Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity to attack with the rapier. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 on eligible hits.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Use Swim +12 to take 10 for a result of 22 when crossing a hazardous sluice. Use Escape Artist +16 if caught in a mundane snare. Webs do not impede this scout.

A moving invisible swimmer can be seen through Keen Sight if the scout can otherwise see the swimmer’s location. A perfectly still opponent can evade the ability. Seeing an ethereal target does not allow a mundane rapier to strike it.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rripp waits below the sluice, watching for movement in the dim channel. He signals the party when the moving scout crosses his view, then swims around the obstruction.

printings.label: Umber Hulk barricade keeper, monster class 9

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 4 from Table A–51. ECL 9 with 6 class Hit Dice.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rusk taps a warning through the floor, then rises between the crew and the tunnel mouth.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the quarry crew out of the abandoned haulage tunnel.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +7, Dexterity +1, Large size −1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +14. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +7. Reach 10 ft.
Alertness, Iron Will, and Ability Focus (Confusing Gaze).

gm.title: Actions
lines: Two claws +9 melee, 1d6+6 each, and a secondary bite +4 melee, 1d8+3, when making a full attack.

Confusing Gaze (Su), 10-ft. range. Will DC 16 negates. On a failure, use confusion for 8 rounds. Resolve passive gaze at the start of each opponent’s turn and one active gaze as an attack action. An opponent averting their eyes has a 50% chance to avoid the save. Covering their eyes avoids the save and gives Rusk total concealment.

Confusion behavior each turn (1d10). On 1 wander away for up to 1 minute without rerolling. On 2–6 do nothing. On 7–9 attack the nearest creature. On 10 act normally. A confused creature that is attacked retaliates on its next turn if it can.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rusk listens for footfalls through the rock and burrows to the tunnel mouth. He warns anyone close enough to meet his gaze, then holds the passage with his claws.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rusk found the first scent at a bank that has begun to collapse.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the woodcutters before rising water cuts off the trail.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Dwarven, and communication with badgers as speak with animals.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. Barbarian fast movement adds 10 ft. to land speed in light armor with a light load.
BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot. Illiterate.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Strength-based resistance is +7 before Fury or rage, +9 with one, and +11 with both.

Fury (Ex), 1/day. After taking at least 1 point of damage, the Wildren can activate Fury at the start of its next turn. For one round, it gains +4 Strength and takes −2 AC. It cannot end Fury voluntarily. Fury stacks with barbarian rage.

Barbarian rage 1/day lasts 9 rounds (3 + raging Constitution modifier of +6). It adds +4 Strength, +4 Constitution, and +2 morale on Will saves, and applies −2 AC. Fortitude becomes +8, Will becomes +3, and current and maximum HP rise by 2 for the duration. After rage, Rusk is fatigued for the rest of the encounter.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One claw +4 melee as a standard attack, or two claws at +4 each in a full attack. Each deals 1d4+3 piercing and slashing, critical ×2, reach 5 ft.
With Fury or rage alone, claws attack at +6 each for 1d4+5 and AC drops to 11. With both active, claws attack at +8 each for 1d4+7 and AC drops to 9 for the one round of overlap.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rusk uses scent to check the ashbank for missing woodcutters. He follows a trail through broken ground and burrows through loose earth if a surface passage collapses. When injured, he decides at the start of his next turn whether to spend Fury.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rusk will check the dark loft while the party keeps watch on the storekeeper.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out what is moving between the sacks after the shop closes.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic neutral. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +1. Armor check penalty −3. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Cat form: Tiny, STR 8, DEX 18, HP 11, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −8, Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor, shield, and weapons meld. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity to hit with natural weapons.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small longsword +5 melee, 1d6+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small javelin +5 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Cat form: claw +7 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at +7 and bite +2 for 1d3−1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning (minimum 1). All critical hits are ×2. The cat normally provokes when entering an enemy’s space to attack.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rusk waits in cat form near the loft opening. He listens for movement and can use scent to pinpoint a creature within 5 ft. in the dark. If someone threatens the storekeeper, he retreats behind the sacks to spend a full round returning to humanoid form, then uses his shield and longsword.

printings.label: Quaggoth shaft guide, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (3 racial HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rusk points out a rough seam that leads past the broken ladder.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reach the high brace so the party can cross without losing the rope.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral beast-follower. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +8. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +4.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One claw +8 for 1d4+5. Full attack with two claws at +8 each for 1d4+5 and a secondary bite at +3 for 1d4+2. All threaten on 20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
If rage triggers, AC drops to 11 and grapple rises to +10. Full attack becomes two claws at +10 for 1d4+7 each and a bite at +5 for 1d4+3. Hit points and saves stay the same.
Take 10 with Climb +13 for a result of 23 while using the shaft wall.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Rusk climbs the shaft first to reach a brace for the party’s rope. Check for rage the round after he takes damage. If he rages, he fights the attacker with claws and bite.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · 4e level 1, built as a player character.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Rusk has found the bell rope tied to a skiff and asks for help watching who returns for it.

gm.title: Role
lines: Ambush fighter who guards a ferry winch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a missing ferry bell whose signal keeps the night crossing safe.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather, Medium mace in one hand. One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to weapon attacks. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 14. Ten healing surges at 7 HP.

Oversized permits a weapon one size larger. Combat Challenge may mark each enemy Rusk attacks through the end of his next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that omit him. If a marked adjacent enemy shifts or makes an attack that omits Rusk, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.
Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. A hit stops movement that provoked it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Opportunity attack +8 vs. AC.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit one other enemy adjacent to Rusk takes 4 damage.
Reaping Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a miss, deal 2 damage.
Spinning Sweep, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4 and knock the target prone.
Comeback Strike, daily standard, reliable. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4 and Rusk can spend a healing surge on a hit.
Predatory Eye, encounter minor, personal. Adds 1d6 damage to the next attack against a target granting Rusk combat advantage. Use it by the end of Rusk’s next turn.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Rusk’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Waits out of sight beside the winch until an ally can flank. Uses Predatory Eye before Spinning Sweep when the opening appears.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2, ECL 4 from Table A–27.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Ryn circles low and calls for the party to steady the scout’s rope.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep scavengers away from the trail until a stranded scout can descend.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +5. Touch 15, flat-footed 11. BAB +4, grapple +6. Fortitude +3, Reflex +9, Will +5. Alertness and Weapon Focus (claw).

gm.title: Actions
lines: Two claws +7 melee each on a full attack, 1d3+1 slashing each. A single claw is available with a standard attack.

Captivating Song, 10-ft. radius, DC 15 Will. Nonharpies that fail follow the most direct route toward Ryn and can only defend themselves. They stop within 5 ft. and offer no resistance to her attacks. A dangerous route or a bard’s countersong grants another save. A successful save gives one day of immunity to her song. This is a sonic mind-affecting charm. It lasts while she sings and 4 rounds afterward.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Ryn descends close enough to catch pursuers with her song, then keeps them away from the scout’s rope by singing from a clear stretch of trail.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (1 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sael asks the party to watch the narrow trail while he checks the ridge from above.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Warn the lower outpost before a rockslide cuts off the pass.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.
Weapon Finesse applies Dexterity to the rapier attack roll. Flyby Attack lets Sael take one standard action during a flying move.

gm.title: Actions
lines: On a clear dive-charge line that descends at least 30 ft., rapier +7 melee, 2d6+4 piercing on a hit or 3d6+6 on a confirmed critical. AC 15 until Sael’s next turn.
Flyby Attack. Split one flying move around a standard rapier attack at +5. Use the ordinary attack damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sael patrols the exposed ridge. He makes a flyby pass when he has room to keep moving. He saves the dive for an open line with enough height.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 9. ECL 16 (8 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +7).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sael can translate the outer inscription in exchange for time to study it.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Finish reading the seal before the chamber is closed again.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Terran, Undercommon

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and natural armor +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +6, grapple +6. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +12. Spell resistance 26.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.

Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for tentacle attacks. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Combat Casting adds +4 on Concentration checks when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. The Wizard bonus feat is Scribe Scroll. No familiar is present.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One tentacle +9 melee for 1d4 bludgeoning, critical ×2. A full attack uses four tentacles at +9 each.
Mind Blast Will DC 17. Charm monster Will DC 17, detect thoughts Will DC 15, and suggestion Will DC 16.

Wizard spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are detect magic, light, and mage hand. First-level spells are grease (Reflex DC 16), mage armor (AC 20 for 1 hour, touch 13, flat-footed 17), and magic missile (one missile for 1d4+1 force).
Spellbook includes Wizard cantrips and eight 1st-level spells: alarm, detect secret doors, feather fall, grease, mage armor, magic missile, shield, and silent image.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sael casts mage armor before approaching the seal. If interrupted, Sael greases the approach and keeps the other researchers clear of the Mind Blast cone.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Safa gives the party a head count by telepathy while watching the cliff from above.

gm.title: Role
lines: Airborne guide who clears a landing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a cliffside rescue route open until the last porter crosses.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Dexterity +3 and natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +6, Will +5.

Acid resistance 5. Air Mastery imposes a −1 circumstance penalty on attack and damage rolls by airborne creatures against Safa. Alertness, Dodge, and Improved Initiative. Dodge adds +1 AC against a designated foe.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Slam +4 melee, 1d4+3 bludgeoning. At-will invisibility affects Safa only and ends if Safa attacks.

Whirlwind 1/day for up to 7 rounds. Travels at fly speed and is 5 ft. wide at the base, up to 30 ft. wide at the top and 10–50 ft. high. On contact a Medium or smaller creature rolls Reflex DC 20 or takes 3d6 damage. A separate DC 20 Reflex save prevents suspension, which deals 1d8 damage each round. Flyers can save at the same DC to escape after taking that round's damage. Safa can release captured creatures at will.

If the whirlwind touches the ground, debris clouds an area whose diameter is half its height. At 5 ft. there is one-half concealment. Beyond 5 ft. there is total concealment, even against darkvision. Casting within the debris requires a DC 20 Concentration check.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mark the quiet side of the landing by telepathy. Fly overhead unseen and use whirlwind to pull pursuers away once the porters have cleared the ledge.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sarruk asks for a guide rope across the last ledge before lifting his passenger.

gm.title: Role
lines: Short-haul escort and Defender of Idu

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring an injured traveler over the ravine.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Distinguishes daytime detail up to half a mile away.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Height 6 ft. 8 in. and weight 243 lb. Leather improves natural AC 6 to AC 5. Proficient with the footman’s mace.

Can fly in class C with up to 243 lb. of load or D up to 486 lb. Apply the campaign’s normal encumbrance rules as well. Check Constitution 16 each turn after the third. At 5 HP remaining only gliding is possible. At 2 HP remaining both flight and gliding are lost. Apply the sourcebook’s wing-fire rule.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with its faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Footman’s mace, effective THAC0 19, 1d6+2 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d6+1 vs. Large targets.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction, per the Defender kit and the core paladin procedure.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sarruk carries supplies across the gap, lands before the fourth turn and holds the ledge until the rest of the party crosses.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2, ECL 4 from Table A–18.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sava asks the party to check the valve crate while he holds the bridge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Stop a runner from taking the foundry’s cooling valve across the service bridge.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Small +1, natural armor +5, Dexterity +3. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +2, grapple +1, Fortitude +5, Reflex +6, Will +5. Weapon Focus (salamander halfspear).
Fire immunity. −10 on saves against cold attacks. Take double damage from cold attacks that offer no save.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Salamander halfspear held in two hands +7 melee, 1d8+4 piercing plus 1d4 fire, ×3.
Tail slap +6 melee, 1d4+1 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire. In a full attack with the halfspear, add the tail at +1.
Constrict on a successful grapple check against a creature up to Medium size. Deal 1d4+1 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sava holds the bridge with the halfspear. If the runner closes, he tries to grab and constrict them before they can circle him.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sava offers to lure the patrol along a ledge while the party takes the cart below.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a delivery cart out of the hands of a rival patrol.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Front claws as a natural weapon proficiency, which also covers war claws.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. Unarmored. Base AC 10 improved by 3 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Half falling damage. Saves against sound suffer −1. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Paired war claws, THAC0 20 for each attack, speed factor 1. Roll two separate attacks per round without a two-weapon penalty. Each hit deals 1d4+1 slashing against small or medium targets or 1d3+1 against large targets.
Without the fittings, roll the two natural front-claw attacks separately using THAC0 20 for 1d2+1 slashing each. Speed factor 1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sava crosses ledges the patrol avoids. She turns to drive back the first pursuer if the cart needs time.

printings.label: Feral Gargun glacier wayfinder, 2 Monstrous Humanoid HD and Ranger 1

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sava knows where the ridge takes a safe turn. She needs the party’s help moving the old waymarks before travelers follow them onto the shelf.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Shift the route away from an ice shelf that has started to break.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, natural armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +11 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +6, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Powerful Build allows the use of a Large battleaxe in one hand. Two racial Hit Dice, Ranger 1, and +2 level adjustment give effective character level 5.
Cold resistance 5. Alertness, Weapon Focus (claw), and class bonus Track. Wild Empathy −1.
Favored enemy Giant grants +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival against giants.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Large battleaxe +7 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach.
Primary claws +8 melee, 1d6+4 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the battleaxe in one hand, add the free claw at +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing and slashing.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sava wants the party to help move the waymarks above the crumbling ice. She shows them where a new path crosses the ridge, then checks for giant tracks before leading anyone across.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and burrow 10 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Seki will inspect a narrow support passage if the party keeps the main shaft clear.

gm.title: Role
lines: Badger example. Cave surveyor and rescue contact.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Confirm which shaft can still support the weight of trapped workers.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision in hybrid and animal forms

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Hengeyokai; badger communication in hybrid or animal form

gm.title: Traits
lines: Human scores listed. Hybrid Con 15 with the other scores unchanged. Leather armor gives AC 12, touch 10, and flat-footed 12 in either form.
Human Fortitude +1, Reflex +0, Will +0. Hybrid Fortitude +2, Reflex +0, Will +0. Base attack bonus +0. Skill Focus (Profession, mine surveyor) adds +2 under 3.0.

Animal form: Tiny badger, AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12, initiative +3. Walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft. Str 8, Dex 17, Con 15. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +0. Merged gear. Add +10 circumstance to Disguise in animal form.
Use the same 5 maximum HP in all forms under the original 3.0 polymorph hit-point rule. Start in hybrid form. Two supernatural changes per day, each full-round and provoking an attack of opportunity.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club in human or hybrid form. Melee +1, 5-ft. reach, 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Animal form. One claw +1 melee for 1d2−1, minimum 1. Full attack: two claws +1 each and secondary bite −4 for 1d3−1, minimum 1 per hit. Tiny natural reach 0 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Check timber supports before anyone enters. Use the animal form to inspect a tight gap if necessary. Report back in hybrid form and help guide people out if the tunnel shifts.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 Invoker NPC. Uses 4e character math.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Selian remembers the seal from a former life and asks to see the original charter.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Settle the dispute before the wardens close the archive.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned, follows Ioun. Hide armor +3 and Intelligence +3. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 15. Bloodied 11. Seven healing surges at 5 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4. She uses a mundane quarterstaff as an implement.
Astral Majesty grants +1 to all defenses against a bloodied attacker. Resist 5 radiant and 5 necrotic. Immortal origin.
Covenant of Preservation. When she uses a divine encounter or daily attack on her turn, Selian can slide one ally within 10 squares 1 square. She uses one Channel Divinity power per encounter.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff, melee basic. +2 vs. AC for 1d8 damage.
Sun Strike, at-will standard, ranged 10. +4 vs. Reflex, 1d8+4 radiant and slide the target 1 square. This also works as her ranged basic attack.
Divine Bolts, at-will standard, ranged 10. Choose one or two creatures. +4 vs. Reflex against each, 1d6+4 lightning on a hit.

Blades of Astral Fire, encounter standard, area burst 1 within 10. +4 vs. Reflex against enemies in the burst, 1d6+4 radiant. Allies in that burst gain +4 AC until the end of Selian’s next turn through Covenant of Preservation.
Binding Invocation of Chains, daily standard, close burst 10. +4 vs. Reflex against each enemy. Hit slows (save ends). Miss slows through the end of Selian’s next turn.
Preserver’s Rebuke, Channel Divinity encounter reaction. After an enemy within 10 squares hits an ally, add +3 to Selian’s next attack against that enemy before her next turn ends.
Rebuke Undead, Channel Divinity encounter standard, close blast 5 against undead. +4 vs. Will, 1d10+4 radiant, push 2 squares, and daze through the end of Selian’s next turn. Half damage on a miss.
Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes, encounter, no action. Add 1d6 after seeing an attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Selian opens with Blades of Astral Fire to shield the archive staff, then uses Sun Strike to pull an attacker away from the reading desk. She saves Memory for a narrow miss.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Selka can reach the cistern’s upper chamber through the flooded stairs.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get clean water and an open route to the trapped survivors.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good, cleric of Aventernus. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +5. Combat Casting adds +4 on Concentration checks to cast defensively or while grappled or pinned.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water without a time limit.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.

Water Spell Power (Ex) grants +1 effective caster level for spells with the [Water] descriptor. The trait provides no spells or spell slots. A spell’s name or presence in a domain list does not supply the descriptor.
Human Blood means an Aventi counts as human for race-related effects, including human-only magic items. The Aventi traits do not grant the standard human bonus feat or extra skill points.

Ocean and Good domains. Ocean grants up to 10 rounds per level of water breathing, redundant with Amphibious. Good adds +1 caster level to Good spells. The spells on this card have no Good descriptor.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear +1 melee, 1d8+1 piercing, critical ×3. Turn undead 5/day, check 1d20+2 and turning damage 2d6+3 HD.
Prepared cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. Create water [Water] is CL 2 and creates up to 4 gallons of drinkable water at up to 30 ft. Guidance and light stay at CL 1.
Prepared first-level spells are bless and cure light wounds (1d8+1 healing). The Ocean domain slot is endure elements. All three are CL 1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Selka swims under the collapsed stairs to reach the cistern’s dry upper chamber. She uses create water to fill the survivors’ jug and marks an exit so the party can bring them out.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sella has a copper marker for the crossing and can check the lock.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reopen the floodgate without springing the trap.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +0.
Cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 when a target is denied Dexterity bonus to AC or when Sella flanks it. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft. A target with concealment cannot be sneak attacked.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. Shortbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit for 1d6+1.

Darkness (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Shadowy illumination in a 20-ft. radius for 10 minutes, dismissible. Creatures in the area have concealment (20% miss chance), even against darkvision, including the Tiefling’s own. Ordinary lights and lower-level light spells do not brighten the area. A lightproof cover over a small object blocks the effect until removed.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sella checks the floodgate for a trap and picks the lock if the gate is safe. If the party needs to retreat, she uses darkness on a copper token and leaves it at the bend. She looks for sneak attacks where the target has no concealment. A lightproof pouch can cover the token before the duration ends.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sena communicates a warning telepathically before she speaks out loud.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Talk an ally out of entering a dangerous shared dream.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision, passive Insight 21 and Perception 14

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fortitude 11, Reflex 11, Will 16. Bloodied 14. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each. Chainmail, holy symbol, and Toughness.
Uses Diplomacy for the flexible +2 racial skill bonus. Makes Dual Soul saves at turn start, with no turn-end retry for a failed early save.
Healer’s Lore adds +4 to healing granted by a cleric power that makes the target spend a surge. Follows the Path of Light. Ritual Casting grants Gentle Repose and Comprehend Language.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +3 vs. AC for 1d8+1 damage.
Lance of Faith, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant and one ally Sena sees gets +2 power bonus on its next attack against the target.
Sacred Flame, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 radiant. One visible ally can save or gain 3 temporary HP.
Divine Glow, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant. Allies in the blast get +2 power bonus to attacks until the end of Sena’s next turn.

Beacon of Hope, daily standard. Close burst 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Will to weaken it through the end of its next turn. Sena and allies in the burst regain 5 HP, and her healing powers heal 5 more through the encounter.
Healing Word, encounter minor, twice per encounter and once per round. In close burst 5, Sena or an ally spends a surge and regains 1d6+4 more HP.

Channel Divinity, choose either power once per encounter. Divine Fortune is free and gives +1 to the next attack or save through the end of Sena’s next turn. Turn Undead is standard, close burst 2, +4 vs. Will against each undead for 1d10+4 radiant, pushing 6 and immobilizing through the end of Sena’s next turn. Miss for half damage only.

Bastion of Mental Clarity, encounter immediate interrupt when an enemy hits or misses Sena against Will. Sena and allies in close burst 5 gain +4 power bonus to Will through the end of Sena’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Keeps allies in reach of her telepathy and defends their Will against a shared threat. Opens with Divine Glow when the group can stay close.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Senn calls down a warning just before the path gives way.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep travelers from stepping onto a damaged span.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Str +2 and Dex +5.
Archery adds +2 to ranged weapon attacks. Woodland Hunter treats half cover as no cover and three-quarters cover as half cover. The longbow does not count as heavy for Senn.
Aerial Defense imposes disadvantage on attacks against Senn while falling, gliding, or jumping. Favored Enemy beasts and Natural Explorer forest.
Spellcasting uses Wisdom. Spell save DC 12 and spell attack +4. Two 1st-level slots. Known spells are cure wounds and hunter’s mark.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longbow +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+3 piercing.
Talons +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, 1d4+3 piercing. Use Dexterity under the appendix’s NPC rules.
Hunter’s mark (bonus action). Mark a visible creature within 90 ft. Weapon hits on it add 1d6 damage. Concentration up to 1 hour. Cure wounds heals a touched creature for 1d8+2 HP.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Senn watches the trail through the canopy and warns strangers away from a broken bridge. In a fight, they look for angles through cover and glide to a lower branch when pressed.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sera can hold the gate and tell the party how to reach the chain from the bank.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the lockgate clear until the crew can reach the jammed chain.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −4.
Power Attack is the Fighter bonus feat. Cobalt Power supplies one essentia and the Incarnum subtype. Capacity is 1. Invest the point in Cobalt Power once per day for 24 hours.

Cobalt Power grants +1 insight on attack rolls or ability checks to succeed at a bull rush, overrun, or sunder. It also adds up to +1 insight damage on Power Attack, capped by the attack penalty taken.
An arm cannot attack with both its spines and a weapon it wields in the same round. Attacking with spines on an arm carrying a shield removes that shield’s AC bonus until the start of your next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. With Power Attack set to −1 and Cobalt Power invested: +3 melee, 1d8+5. Choose Power Attack before making attack rolls. Its modifier lasts until her next turn.

Primary arm spine +4 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. As a single attack, use the sword arm’s spines in place of the sword to keep the shield bonus. Using the shield arm costs 2 AC until the start of her next turn, leaving AC 15 and flat-footed AC 14.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sera is holding the lockgate while the crew checks a jammed chain. She keeps her shield up if the lane is crowded and uses a sword-arm spine if someone knocks the sword from her hand.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · 4e level 1, built as a player character.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sera offers a hidden route through the toll gate if the party helps the families board.

gm.title: Role
lines: Passage scout who screens an evacuation.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the underground ferry path open while the last families cross.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather, short sword, and light shield. Shield Proficiency (Light) adds the shield’s +1 to AC and Reflex. Fortitude 11, Reflex 17, Will 13. Bloodied 11. Six healing surges at 5 HP.

Artful Dodger raises AC to 20 against opportunity attacks. First Strike grants combat advantage against enemies that have yet to act in the first round. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to an eligible short-sword hit when Sera has combat advantage, once per turn.
Trance grants an extended rest in 4 hours while Sera stays alert. Darkfire uses Charisma. Sera may use either Lolthtouched power once per encounter.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +4 vs. AC for 1d6+1.
Deft Strike, at-will standard. May move 2 squares before a melee 1 attack at +7 vs. AC for 1d6+4.
Piercing Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4.
Positioning Strike, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. Will for 1d6+4 and slide the target up to 3 squares.
Trick Strike, daily standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC. On a hit, deal 3d6+4 and slide the target 1 square. For the rest of the encounter, slide that target 1 square whenever Sera hits it.

Cloud of Darkness, Lolthtouched encounter minor, close burst 1. Stays in place through the end of Sera’s next turn. Blocks line of sight for other creatures and blinds them if they are entirely inside.

Darkfire, Lolthtouched encounter minor, ranged 10. +5 vs. Reflex. On a hit, the target grants combat advantage to attackers and gains no benefit from invisibility or concealment until the end of Sera’s next turn.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Sera’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Screens the passage with Cloud of Darkness while people move behind it. Shifts a blocker out of the crossing with Positioning Strike.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Seravakri can speak telepathically with a willing witness while the party checks the warehouse ledger.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Resolve a dispute about a signed warehouse delivery before the crates get moved again.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unarmored with Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +3.
+2 racial on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities and against possession.
Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Telepathy discipline. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Psionic Talent adds 2 power points.

Six power points per day. Two base, one bonus from Intelligence, one racial, and two from Psionic Talent. Class manifester level 1, with at most 1 power point spent per manifestation. Save DC 13 + power level.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, minimum 1 damage.

Known 1st-level powers are inertial armor, mind thrust, and mindlink. Each costs 1 power point at this level. Inertial armor gives +4 armor AC for 1 hour. Mind thrust is mind-affecting and deals 1d10 damage to one target within 25 ft. Will DC 14 negates. Power resistance applies.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

For racial Mindlink without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round at character level 1. This mind-affecting link allows no saving throw or spell resistance.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Seravakri asks each witness for permission before opening a mindlink. She listens to both accounts of the warehouse dispute and asks the party to check which crates were signed in. If threatened, she uses inertial armor and withdraws to the public room.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 4 by Table A–32. Lillend monster class level 6, 5 HD.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sereva asks the party to look for a missing apprentice on the far bank.

gm.title: Role
lines: Aerial gatekeeper of a footbridge across a gorge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep a repair crew safe until it can lower the crossing ropes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. AC includes +2 natural armor and +1 Dexterity. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +5, grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +6.
Poison immunity and fire resistance 5. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (longsword). Her lyre is an ordinary instrument.

Bard spells at caster level 3. Three 0-level slots per day shared by detect magic, ghost sound, light, mage hand, mending, and read magic (save DC 15 where relevant). Two 1st-level slots per day shared by cure light wounds, feather fall, and grease (save DC 16).

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +11 melee, 1d8+5 slashing, 19–20/×2. Tail slap +10 melee, 1d8+2 bludgeoning. When using both in a full attack, the tail is secondary at +5.

Improved Grab and Constrict (Ex). A tail hit against a Medium or smaller creature lets Sereva start a grapple at +10 without an attack of opportunity. On a hold she adds 1d8+5 constrict damage. She cannot take move actions while constricting and may still attack with a held weapon.

Bardic music 3/day. Each use can inspire courage, countersong, fascinate, or inspire competence. Inspire courage gives allies who hear her for a full round +2 morale on saves against charm and fear and +1 morale on attack and weapon damage. It lasts while they hear her and for 5 rounds afterward. Countersong lets listeners within 30 ft. substitute her Perform result for a lower save roll against a sonic or language-dependent magical effect. Fascinate affects one listening, attentive creature within 90 ft. outside combat, with Will DC set by her Perform check, and lasts up to 3 rounds. Inspire competence gives one ally within 30 ft. +2 on one skill for up to 2 minutes while the ally hears her. The ally and Sereva must be able to see each other.

World and talk powers (Sp), each 1/day at caster level 7. Darkness, hallucinatory terrain (Will DC 19 where relevant), knock, light, charm person (Will DC 16), speak with animals, and speak with plants.

Cure light wounds restores 1d8+3 HP by touch. Grease coats a 10-ft. square within 30 ft. for 3 rounds (Reflex DC 16 to avoid falling). As a free action, feather fall slows falling targets in a 10-ft. radius within 30 ft. until they land or 3 rounds pass. The targets may weigh up to 900 lb. in total.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sereva takes the high walkway and asks for the old crossing song. If someone runs toward the gate, she lands beside the latch and grabs with her tail.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Serr can take the missing performer’s place once the party retrieves the costume from the dressing rack.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Cover the opening scene while the crew locates a missing performer.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Disguise +5, or +15 with Minor Change Shape

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +4, Will +0.
+2 racial on saving throws against sleep and charm effects.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Trapfinding allows Search checks above DC 20 for traps and Disable Device checks against magic traps.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sneak attack adds 1d6 when Serr flanks the target or it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. The target must be vulnerable to critical hits, with a vital spot Serr can see and reach and no concealment from Serr.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Serr can cover for a missing performer while the party searches the wings. Serr makes the physical change backstage, then puts on the performer’s costume separately. If the rigging comes loose, Serr moves the visitors away from it before looking for the source.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
Speed · 20 ft. in scale mail; base 30 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Serran sends the party ahead to hold the inner doors.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Move the refugees through two barricades before the gates close.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good Cleric of Mystra. Scale mail +4, heavy wooden shield +2. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5. Combat Casting adds +4 on Concentration checks when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned.

Spell Clutch (Su). Once per day, use a standard action to prepare again one 1st-level spell you previously prepared and cast. Cast the spell separately when needed. The supernatural activation does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Knowledge and Magic domains. Knowledge makes all Knowledge skills class skills and gives +1 caster level to divinations. Magic permits use of arcane spell-trigger and spell-completion items as a 1st-level wizard. Turn undead 3/day, check +0, turning damage 2d6+1.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light mace +1 melee for 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2.

Cleric spells prepared, CL 1, divinations CL 2. Cantrips are detect magic, guidance, and light. First-level spells are bless and cure light wounds. The Knowledge domain slot holds detect secret doors. Bless gives allies a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear for 1 minute. Cure light wounds heals 1d8+1.
After casting the prepared bless, use Spell Clutch to prepare bless again. Save the second casting for a fresh clash after the first duration ends.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Serran meets refugees at the waystation and casts bless as they get through the first barricade. He uses the lull to regain bless and saves the second casting for the defense of the inner doors.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sethra holds the witnessed signature on the guarantee but will wait if the players can provide collateral of equal worth.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Protect her retirement fund by collecting a late payment without putting a family out of its home.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sethren needs the party to clear the stairs while he grounds the ward. The owner is still insisting the building can stay open.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the tenants out of a building whose lightning ward was damaged during construction.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Can identify the visible maker's mark on a local ward without rolling.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Ward spark. Ranged spell attack +4, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

Hold the threshold (1/day). Choose a 5-foot square within 30 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Protects a door or witness and leaves by a prepared route when challenged in the open.

printings.label: Troglodyte cistern guide, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sethrik can find the dry route where the stone wall meets the old grate.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the group past the cistern before the lower passage fills.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Hide +10 (+14 in rocky or underground surroundings)

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +1 and natural armor +6. Touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +1, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw +3 for 1d4+2. On a full attack, two claws at +3 for 1d4+2 each and a bite at +1 for 1d4+1. Critical ×2 on all three.
When anger or fear triggers Stench, allies and foes who are living and within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Fortitude save unless exempt. On a failure, apply sickened for 10 rounds.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sethrik follows the cistern wall using Hide +14. If a threat corners the group, he calls for his non-troglodyte companions to move past the 30-ft. range before they hold the passage.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 10 (4 racial HD, 2 class HD, LA +4).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sira asks for a signal when the last evacuee reaches the open ledge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the lower access clear while the rookery evacuates.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4, natural armor +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −2. BAB +6, grapple +11. Fortitude +7, Reflex +6, Will +4.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Flyby Attack and Stealthy are the racial feats. Weapon Focus (longsword) and Power Attack are Fighter bonus feats. Improved Initiative adds +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +12 melee, 1d8+5 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Full attack with sword +12/+7 and one secondary claw +6, 1d4+2 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. Claw alone +11 for 1d4+5 piercing and slashing.

Touch +11 or claw +11 against normal AC, with Fortitude DC 12. Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. The Kir-Lanan regains HP equal to the hit point damage dealt by the negative energy, up to its maximum HP. Ignore claw damage and Strength damage when calculating healing.

Ray of Enfeeblement, ranged touch +8. Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as Cleric 6. Turning check 1d20, turning damage 2d6+6.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sira keeps the mouth of the rookery in sight. When she needs to hold the opening, she lands with her free claw facing the approach.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 5 (2 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sive appears in the standing mirror and asks who last saw the apprentice.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a missing apprentice before their mirror route closes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +3, Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +2, Reflex +7, Will +2. Trapfinding, evasion, and Improved Initiative.
Reflective spell resistance 14. Reflects targeted spells it successfully resists, and reflects gaze attacks. Cold, electricity, and fire resistance 5. Takes half again as much sonic damage.
Racial bonus Exotic Weapon Proficiency (shard dagger and shard longsword). Uses revised wounding on the shard dagger.

gm.title: Actions
lines: +2 wounding shard dagger +4 melee or +7 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing or slashing as a dagger, 19–20/×2, 10-ft. range increment. When wounding applies, the hit also deals 1 Constitution damage. Sneak attack +1d6 when eligible (within 30 ft. at range).

Disguise self 3/day and mirror image 1/day, caster level 12. Disguise self lasts 120 minutes and adds +10 to the Disguise check, Will DC 15 to disbelieve when interacted with. Mirror image creates 1d4+4 images for up to 12 minutes.
Mirror Jump at will, standard action. Vanish through a mirror to another mirror at most 1 mile away. A usable reflective non-mirror is a 30% entry chance and never an exit.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sive offers a way out through the mirror if the party can bring the missing apprentice. When cornered, Sive makes mirror images and stays close to the exit.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sivi signals from the top of a waypost and asks the party to watch where she lands.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a way across a broken trail before the pack animals arrive.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Natural Armor sets AC to at least 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Gliding Wings. Sivi cannot hover and takes no fall damage. Finish the round at least one-quarter of the distance flown below the start or fall. A 40 ft. glide requires a drop of at least 10 ft.
Stalker supplies Perception and Stealth. Expertise doubles the proficiency bonus for both. Sivi is proficient with thieves’ tools.

Sneak Attack deals an extra 1d6 once per turn on a hit with a finesse or ranged weapon. Sivi needs advantage or an active enemy of the target within 5 ft. of it, provided she has no disadvantage on the attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Claw. Melee attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 − 1 slashing.
Cunning Action. Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Sivi scouts from ledge to ledge, keeping enough height to clear each gap. She calls down the route from cover before moving again.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Skel trades the best lead for help convincing the rival expedition to lend its rope ladders.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a lost climbing crew before bad weather strands a second crew.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

printings.label: Air Elemental beacon tender, monster class 5

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2 from Table A–1. ECL 5 with 4 class Hit Dice.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Skirl rattles the beacon lanyard three times when the party approaches the wrong ledge.

gm.title: Role
lines: Whirlwind controller and cliff beacon tender.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep climbers off a landing where the stone anchors are about to fail.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +3 and Dexterity +5. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +9, Will +2.
Alertness and Dodge. Dodged opponent faces AC 19 while Skirl can use his Dexterity bonus. Bonus Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, and Weapon Finesse (slam).
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Air Mastery imposes −1 on airborne opponents’ attack and damage rolls against Skirl.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Slam +8 melee, 1d6+4 bludgeoning. Flyby Attack allows a partial action, such as the slam, during movement.

Whirlwind (Su), once every 10 minutes for up to 2 rounds. Fly at normal speed in a 5-ft.-wide base and 10- to 30-ft.-high funnel. A Small or smaller creature touching or entering it makes two DC 16 Reflex saves, one to avoid 1d6 damage and one to avoid being lifted. A lifted creature takes 1d6 damage each round and a flyer gets another DC 16 Reflex save each round to escape. Skirl may eject a carried creature at any time. While the base touches the ground, the debris cloud spans half the funnel’s height. It gives concealment at 5 ft., total concealment farther away, and requires a DC 16 Concentration check to cast spells inside.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Skirl swoops low over the beacon to get attention. If a Small creature rushes the ledge anyway, he uses the whirlwind to pick it up and carry it inland.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Skriv knows which part of the wall has handholds for the climb.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the party to a ledge above the blocked passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4. Sonic resistance 5.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or daylight, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attacks, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Vulnerability to Poison (Ex). Take −4 on Fortitude saves against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom.

Skinshift (Ex). As a move action, choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and gain damage reduction 5 against that damage type for 3 + Constitution modifier rounds. One use per day, plus one more at 4th level and every four levels thereafter.

Shriek (Ex). Once per day as a standard action, emit a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on the vril or a 30-ft. cone. Creatures in the area take sonic damage. Reflex halves at DC 10 + half character level (round down) + Constitution modifier. Vril barbarians can use Shriek while raging.
Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 on eligible hits.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small short sword +1 melee for 1d4 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Small shortbow +4 ranged for 1d4 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft.
Skinshift once per day lasts 6 rounds. Shriek once per day deals 1d6 sonic damage, Reflex DC 13 half.
Fortitude becomes −1 against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom before any bright-light penalty.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Skriv climbs the ledge before signaling the party. If blocked, Skriv uses Skinshift against the damage type the defenders are dealing and aims the Shriek cone away from allies.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sova offers to escort the party as far as the old gate in exchange for making room for two injured riders.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get stranded travelers across the pass before the next council vote ends their permit.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: A lamp smashed against the gate has left a burning spill between Split-Tusk and the alarm bell. The carts behind him are still loaded.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the loading gate until the last dockhand is accounted for.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. Unarmored AC 10 + Dexterity + 1 from Thick Hide.
Dueling adds +2 damage when Split-Tusk uses a one-handed melee weapon and holds no other weapon.
Action Surge grants one extra action on his turn once per short or long rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Handaxe. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 5 slashing when Dueling applies, or 1d6 + 3 otherwise.
Claws or fangs. Unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 slashing for claws or piercing for fangs.
Second Wind. Bonus action, regain 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.
Inhuman Vigor. Bonus action, spend one available Hit Die to regain 1d10 + 3 HP once per long rest. Acid or fire damage blocks this until he finishes a short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Split-Tusk has both recovery options available at the start of the watch. He tries Second Wind first so he can save a Hit Die for a later rest.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Stillrime can hear movement beyond the snowbank outside the shelter.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the shelter entrance until the travelers are inside.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +3. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +5. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day. Declare before the attack roll. On a damaging hit, Fortitude DC 13 prevents a one-round stun.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small Monk unarmed strike +1 melee for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch. Unarmed flurry as a full attack uses two strikes at −1 each, same damage on each hit.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Stillrime guards the shelter entrance as the party brings travelers through the pass. He activates Frosty Touch before engaging and uses the ray if a target stays out of reach. Apply normal cold resistance to his separate cold damage.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Sura can identify which release pin was replaced if the party keeps the walkway clear.

gm.title: Role
lines: Ice Caste locksmith and floodgate witness.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reopen the jammed floodgate before water backs up into an occupied alley.

gm.title: Traits
lines: AC 18 includes leather armor +2, natural armor +3, Dexterity +2, and size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +1.
Cold resistance 5 and bonus Blind-Fight. Skill Focus (Disable Device) adds +3. Ordinary thieves’ tools. The Expert can disable ordinary devices and search for tampering.
Scent 30 ft. normally, 60 ft. upwind or 15 ft. downwind. Move action to find direction and pinpoint within 5 ft. Strong or overpowering scents extend detection.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point. Racial Energy Ray has its own use and consumes none of that point.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small dagger +0 melee, reach 5 ft., 1d3−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1, critical 19–20/×2.
Small light crossbow +3 ranged, 80-ft. range increment, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Reload as a move action.
Cold Energy Ray once per day. Standard action, +3 ranged touch at up to 25 ft., 1d6+1 cold, no save, power resistance applies, manifester level 1.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Inspect the jammed floodgate before turning the lock. Ask the party to hold the upstream walkway. If interrupted, move behind the ratchet housing and use the crossbow from cover.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Swage can get the lift working if the party retrieves the old hinge from the inspection cage.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Replace a worn lift hinge and repair the attendant before the next shift.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Use Magic Device +4, or +6 to activate a scroll

gm.title: Traits
lines: Composite Plating +2 armor and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.

Artificer 1 gains Scribe Scroll, Craft Reserve 20 XP, Disable Trap, and Artisan Bonus +2 to Use Magic Device when activating scrolls. Artificer Knowledge +3, DC 15, requires 1 minute of examining an item. Skill Focus (Craft [armorsmithing]) adds +3.

Three 1st-level infusions per day, two base and one for Intelligence. Class caster level 1. The infusions are neither arcane nor divine. The plating’s 5% arcane failure chance applies to arcane spells and does not apply to these infusions.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Repair light damage. Standard action, touch, instant. Restore 1d8+1 HP to an ordinary construct with at least 1 HP or a living construct with at least −9 HP. No save or spell resistance.
Skill enhancement. Cast in 1 round on a touched item using fine black thread. It grants the wearer or wielder +2 circumstance on checks with the chosen skill for 10 minutes.
Trained Craft repair takes 8 hours. Craft (armorsmithing) +9 restores 4 HP by taking 10, including for self-repair.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Swage needs the worn brass hinge before making a replacement that will fit the old lift cage. The party can retrieve it while Swage repairs the injured construct serving as lift attendant.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2 from Table A–29. ECL 4 with 3 class Hit Dice.

gm.title: Hook
lines: The same raven appears outside three shuttered offices. Its footprints lead away from none of them.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the clerk responsible for opening sealed appeals before the hearing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2, Dexterity +4, Tiny size +2. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple −5, reach 0 ft. Fortitude +5, Reflex +7, Will +5.
Poison immunity, fire resistance 5, and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Alertness, Improved Initiative, and bonus Weapon Finesse (sting).

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sting +9 melee, 1d4 damage. Fortitude DC 15 or take 1d4 Dexterity damage, then a second save one minute later or take another 1d4 Dexterity damage.
Detect good, detect magic, and invisibility at will, caster level 6. Invisibility affects Tack alone, lasts up to 60 minutes or until Tack attacks, and is usable in either form.

Polymorph (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 12. Tack picked a raven as his only alternate form. He can stay in that form for up to 12 hours under the updated 3.0 polymorph self rules. In that form he has a raven’s 10-ft. land speed and 40-ft. fly speed (average) and loses access to his sting.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tack follows a suspect as a raven. As soon as someone bars the shutters, he turns invisible and waits at the door for the next visitor.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 1d10+2, plus 2 HP from Combat Conditioning

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tam asks the party to watch the gate while he takes the narrow route.

gm.title: Role
lines: Courier skilled at disengaging after a hit.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a message through the blockade without exposing the sender.

gm.title: Traits
lines: STR and CON saves +5 and +4. Wears leather armor. Fey Resilience gives advantage on saves against magic and on checks and saves to avoid or end charm and unconsciousness.

Cottage heritage with Animal Handling. At the end of a long rest, Comforts of Home can give four temporary HP to as many as two participants. Soldier background grants Athletics and Survival, and Combat Conditioning grants 2 maximum HP.

Last Stand. If incoming damage would bring Tam below half his maximum HP (below 7 HP), he can spend his one hit die as a reaction and heal 1d10+2 HP, with a minimum roll of 2 from Combat Conditioning. This competes with Bounding Leap for the reaction.
Martial Action Aim. Use a bonus action to pick a creature Tam can see. The first ranged weapon attack against that target this turn adds PB again.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Horn strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 bludgeoning, using STR. Shortsword +5, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing, using STR. Sling +4, range 30/120 ft., 1d4+2 bludgeoning, or +6 to hit after Aim.
Bounding Leap, 2 uses per long rest. After a melee weapon or unarmed hit, use the reaction to move up to 15 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tam runs his message around the blockade. If boxed in, he catches one opponent with a horn strike and uses Bounding Leap to slip out of reach.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tamar’s gate ledger has one more name than the people inside. The signature is still wet.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Account for everyone sheltering behind the gate before dusk.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Infravision 60 ft. Range taken from the setting’s companion appendix.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Wears a cloth sash, with natural AC 7. Effective Charisma is 9 with other humanoids and 6 with demihumans or humans.
The Um-Shedu profile is free of the sunlight curse. Immune to manscorpion venom and +2 on saves against all other poison, giving a poison save of 12.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with the faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear, effective THAC0 20 in melee, 1d6+1 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8+1 vs. Large targets.

Tail sting, effective THAC0 20, reach 10 ft. and 1d4+1 piercing damage as an encounter ruling. Choose this or the spear for the round. A failed unmodified save vs. poison causes one woozy round followed by 2d8 rounds of sleep. Neutralize poison ends the sleep early.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tamar keeps enough space behind the gate to raise the tail, then leaves the spears lowered if the intruder surrenders.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Classed NPC using the player species profile. Challenge rating depends on the encounter.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tansy points to a shorter crossing and asks who will tie off the line after she jumps.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the guild ledger over the old ropeway before the lower trail closes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor, proficiency +2, passive Perception 13. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +2. Expertise in Stealth and thieves’ tools.
Standing Leap. Long jump 30 ft. or high jump 15 ft., with or without a running start, spending movement normally. Can move through a larger creature’s space.
Take Heart. Advantage on Strength saves and saves against being frightened with an ally within 5 ft. who is visible, audible, neither frightened nor incapacitated.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Dagger +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+3 piercing.

Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn on a qualifying finesse or ranged weapon hit. Use the bonus action for Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Help. For combat Help, Tansy must be within 5 ft. of the target when she aids the ally.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tansy jumps across, keeps an ally close when facing fear, and uses bonus-action Help to line up the ally’s next strike when in range.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
Speed · 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tara can reach the barge from the water if someone draws the sentry away from the mooring.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Rescue a dockhand held on a moored barge.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +4 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Serpent Strike gives Tara advantage on attacks against a creature she has surprised or that she or an ally has charmed.
Snake Body gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid being knocked prone. Tara gains no benefit from effects or gear that require legs or feet.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Tara has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Deception and Stealth. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Tara’s background grants Sleight of Hand, Survival, navigator’s tools, and water vehicles.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 2 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tara swims to the pilings, climbs onto the quay, and waits out the patrol. If spotted, she Disengages and drops back into the river.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Taren can guide the group along the dune’s shallow shoulder.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Mark a crossing before the afternoon wind obscures the trail.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Water Sense 100 ft. with a Survival check.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Sure Feet (Ex) treats shallow sand as normal terrain, costing 1 square per square entered, and deep sand as shallow sand, costing 2 squares for a Medium Bhuka.
Glare Resistance (Ex) prevents the dazzled condition from bright sunlight.

+2 racial on Constitution checks or Fortitude saves against harmful heat and dehydration. Bonus feat Heat Endurance gives +2 on saves against fire effects, heat protection level 1, and comfort through 120°F.
+2 racial on Knowledge (nature), which is always a class skill.

Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Favored enemy animals adds +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, and weapon damage rolls against animals. Water Sense uses the normal Survival modifier.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Water Sense (Ex) uses Survival to detect drinkable water within 100 ft. The DC depends on depth. Surface DC 10, up to 10 ft. deep DC 12, 11–20 ft. DC 15, 21–40 ft. DC 20, 41–70 ft. DC 25, and 71–100 ft. DC 30. Taren rolls at Survival +6. A source 15 ft. deep and within range uses DC 15, so he needs a 9 or higher on the die.
Shortspear +2 melee for 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2. Shortbow +4 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit and 1d6+1 damage.
On a straight clear move through only deep sand, 30 ft. of movement budget covers three 5-ft. squares. In shallow sand the same budget covers six squares.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Taren crosses the shallow shoulder of the dune to check the trail and marks a safe approach for the party. If they need water, he checks for a nearby drinkable source with Water Sense.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tarenkhad can link with the passenger if the party holds the berth and asks for their consent.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find which berth received the luggage a passenger cannot describe to the dock crew.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Disguise +6, or +8 to impersonate a human

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +4.
+2 racial on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities and against possession.
