Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) adds +3, already included. Each of the seven listed Expert skills has four ranks.
Naturally Psionic gives one racial power point. Use racial Mindlink once per day without spending that point. Tarenkhad has no known class powers or general manifester level.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

For racial Mindlink without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round at character level 1. This mind-affecting link allows no saving throw or spell resistance.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tarenkhad has one daily mindlink and saves it for a willing passenger with whom the dock crew shares no language. He asks the party to keep the berth open while he establishes the link and locates the passenger’s missing luggage.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · Walk 30 ft. Fly or glide 40 ft. (average).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tarinel can reach the far platform in a short powered bout if the party clears the lower perch.

gm.title: Role
lines: Beacon sentry and footbow specialist with limited flight.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get both cliff beacons back in sight of each other before the pass closes.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision and Unerring Direction on the Material Plane

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chain shirt +4 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +5, grapple +7. Fortitude +6, Reflex +4, Will +2. Strength 14 allows a light load up to 58 lb.

With Constitution 14, fly safely for 2 consecutive rounds. Can fly for up to 4, becoming fatigued at the end. More than 10 minutes actual flight in a day also causes fatigue. Glide between bouts. A medium or heavy load, fatigue, or exhaustion prevents powered flight.
Feats are Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (footbow), and Weapon Specialization (footbow). The footbow is masterwork with a +2 Strength rating.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Footbow +10 ranged, critical ×3 and 110-ft. range increment. Damage 1d8+4 with one hand drawing, or 1d8+5 with both hands drawing and the feet holding the bow. Within 30 ft., add +1 attack and damage from Point Blank Shot.

Ground footbow shots require prone posture and take −4 on attack rolls. Rapid Shot is a full attack with an extra shot and −2 to both attacks. Use it from a stable prone firing position on the ground. At more than 30 ft. the ground volley is +4/+4.

Shortspear wielded two-handed, +7 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Diving charge +9 melee: move at least 30 ft. and descend at least 10 ft. Double damage on a hit. Apply the ordinary charge requirements and AC penalty.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Use a brief powered bout to reach a beacon platform, then glide to the lower perch and signal across the ravine. Make single moving shots in the air. Use the ground volley only once there is secure footing and cover.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tava has found a rock ledge where the team can get out of the water.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Guide the rope team safely across the channel.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Blindsense 20 ft. in water only.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1, touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +0. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat.
Hold Breath (Ex). At Constitution 14, budget 112 rounds before drowning checks in a calm dive. Track exertion under the drowning rules.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortspear +6 melee or +3 thrown, 1d6+4 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 20 ft. Against sahuagin, +8 melee or +5 thrown for 1d6+6.

Shortspear-and-bite full attack. Shortspear +6 for 1d6+4 piercing and secondary bite +0 for 1d6+2 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Against sahuagin, shortspear +8 for 1d6+6 and secondary bite +2 for 1d6+4.
With the spear set aside, primary bite +5 melee for 1d6+6. Against sahuagin, +7 for 1d6+8.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tava leads the rope team across the submerged channel and emerges onto the ledge at the far gate. Keep the exit clear. Fight from the ledge and use the full attack if a sahuagin reaches it.

printings.label: Wemic gully guide, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (5 racial HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavaro points out a flat approach to the far-side anchor.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Secure a rope across the gap before the water rises.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2, size −1, and natural armor +4. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +5, grapple +15. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +5.
Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Great Fortitude adds +2 to Fortitude saves.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One claw +10 melee for 1d6+6. On a full attack, two claws at +10 for 1d6+6 each. Critical ×2 on both.
With 20 ft. of run-up, use Jump +26 against DC 20 to cross a 20-ft. gap. The run-up and jump together use 40 ft. of movement.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavaro crosses the gully first to reach the rope anchor. He checks the approach and keeps enough open ground for a running jump.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavi waves the party inside while a disagreement builds at the shelter door.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the shelter open to both sides of a local dispute.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Leather armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Saving throws Dex +4 and Cha +5. Jack of All Trades adds +1 to otherwise untrained ability checks, including initiative.
Fated rerolls one attack, ability check, or save after seeing the roll and before learning the outcome. Recharge after a long rest.

Spellcasting uses Charisma. Spell save DC 13 and spell attack +5. Cantrips mage hand and vicious mockery, plus light from Touched. Three 1st-level slots. Known spells are detect magic, dissonant whispers, healing word, heroism, and thunderwave.

Bardic Inspiration (bonus action, 3/long rest). An ally within 60 ft. who can hear Tavi gains a d6 for one check, attack, or save within 10 minutes. Song of Rest adds 1d6 healing for allies spending Hit Dice during a short rest.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., 1d4+2 piercing.
Songbird. While performing, cast charm person (Wisdom DC 13) without somatic components once per long rest.
Vicious mockery. One target within 60 ft. that can hear Tavi makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Dissonant whispers. One creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage and uses its reaction, if available, to move away. Success halves the damage and prevents that movement.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavi uses a tune to settle a dispute at the shelter door. If someone threatens the guests, they force that creature back with dissonant whispers.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavi surfaces below the ferry and describes a figure pacing the shaded bank.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep an upstream signal lit when the current rises.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. in full color. Advantage on visual Perception to locate creatures and moving targets.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DEX and INT saves +5 and +2. Wears leather armor. Tavi can breathe in air and water. Toadfolk cheeks hold up to three Tiny objects while allowing normal speech.

Wildlands heritage with Animal Handling. Beasts or Animal-tagged creatures of CR 2 or lower must first contest their WIS check against Tavi’s Animal Handling to attack Tavi. On Tavi’s win they choose another target or lose their attack.

Criminal background grants Investigation and Deception. Touch of Luck grants 2 instead of 1 Luck when gaining Luck for a missed attack or failed save, and replaces the sixth point gained with a reset to 1d4+1. Rogue expertise applies to Perception and Stealth.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Launch Tiny object +5 at 20/60 ft., 1d6+3 damage. The object determines bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. Tavi carries three smooth clay pellets for bludgeoning damage.
Shortbow +5 at 80/320 ft., 1d6+3 piercing. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once on Tavi’s turn with advantage, or if an active enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Tavi lacks disadvantage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavi checks both sides of the ferry in darkness and drops under the waterline if threatened. The pellets are a fallback when there is no time to draw a bow.

gm.title: Hook
lines: She offers to guide the party through the grove if they can persuade the carter to unhitch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep wheel ruts away from the buried roots without closing the route to travelers.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Endurance +1 (+6 against starvation, thirst, or suffocation)

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Cloth armor and a quarterstaff. AC includes +1 for wielding the staff. Fortitude 12, Reflex 15, Will 16. Bloodied 9. One healing surge worth 4 HP.

Tavia ignores forest-growth difficult terrain. Tree Mind adds +2 on saves against daze, domination, or stun. She can wait twice as long before making Endurance checks against starvation, thirst, or suffocation. Four hours of conscious meditation with water, light, or earth give an extended rest.
Ritual Caster. Her book contains Comprehend Language, Make Whole and Tenser’s Floating Disk. Sleep is prepared. Freezing Cloud is her other spellbook daily.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1, +3 vs. AC for 1d8+1.
Ray of Frost (at-will, standard). Range 10, +5 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+5 cold. On a hit, slow the target through the end of Tavia’s next turn.

Icy Terrain (encounter, standard). Area burst 1 within 10, +5 vs. Reflex against each creature for 1d6+5 cold and prone on a hit. The area is difficult terrain until the end of Tavia’s next turn, or until she ends it with a minor action.

Sleep (daily, standard). Area burst 2 within 20, +5 vs. Will against each creature. A hit slows the target (save ends). If its first save fails, it becomes unconscious (save ends). A miss slows the target (save ends).
Staff of Defense (encounter, immediate interrupt). While wielding the staff, gain +1 to the targeted defense against one attack.
Hamadryad Aspects (encounter, minor). Until the end of Tavia’s next turn either enemies who see her grant her combat advantage or she gains resist 5 to all damage.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend one surge to heal 4 HP and gain +2 to all defenses until the start of Tavia’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavia offers a way through on foot. If the parley breaks, she uses Icy Terrain to slow pursuers and takes Wooden Form if they get close.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavin can imitate the cracked ferry bell. The party can watch the landing to see who comes for the crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out who rang the ferry in after it had already docked for the night.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Low-light vision at twice human distance.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Each listed skill is a selected Expert class skill with four ranks. Alertness gives +2 Listen and Spot, already included.

Emulate Race (Ex) automatically satisfies the racial requirement of a magic item for any humanoid race. A Mongrelfolk trained in Use Magic Device gets a +4 racial bonus on checks to emulate a nonhumanoid race.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sling +1 ranged, 1d4+1 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 50-ft. increment. Loading takes a move action.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavin heard two ferry calls using the same bell. Ask the party to watch the landing, then imitate the damaged bell from shore to see who answers. In a fight, Tavin keeps behind the stone mooring post.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavira can compare the disputed terms if the party brings the original tally tablet and a witness.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Settle a dispute over a toll before the two trading parties leave.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, and natural armor +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Skill Focus (Diplomacy) gives +3. Listen and Move Silently already include racial bonuses. Bardic Knowledge +2.
Caster level 1. She knows four 0-level spells and can cast two per day. Light armor is compatible with her bard spells.
One Bardic Music use per day shared by Inspire Courage, Countersong and Fascinate. Begin a performance as a standard action. She can't cast spells while performing.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing, minimum 1, critical 19–20/×2.
Inspire Courage +1 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and saves against charm and fear, for allies who hear her. It lasts while they hear her and for 5 rounds afterward.

Countersong lasts up to 10 rounds. Roll Perform (oratory) +7 each round. A creature within 30 ft. can substitute that result for a lower save against a sonic or language-dependent magical attack. A creature already under such an ongoing effect that allows a save saves again each round it hears her, using her Perform result.

Fascinate one creature within 90 ft. that can see, hear, and pay attention to her. Tavira must see it too. Its Will save DC is her Perform result. If it saves, she must wait 24 hours before trying again. On failure it listens without acting for up to 1 round of concentration, with −4 on reactive skill checks. Nearby combat prevents Fascinate. A possible threat prompts a new Perform check and save. An overt threat ends it.
0-level spells known: detect magic, light, mage hand, message.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Compare the two versions of the trade terms before the market closes. Ask the witness to read the tally aloud, or use Message to confer privately across the crowd. If the crowd panics, use Inspire Courage to steady allies who can hear her.

printings.label: Dekanter Goblin cold passage guard, Barbarian 1

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 7 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +4).
Speed · 30 ft. with fast movement, base 20 ft.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tavra waits by the shutter and asks for news from the older branch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the lower passage open for the returning crew.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −1. BAB +3, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus. Fast movement and illiteracy.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One-handed battleaxe +9 melee, 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3. Add one secondary horn at +4 for 1d6+3, critical ×3, or one secondary claw at +4 for 1d4+3, critical ×2, on a full attack.

Rage 1/day for up to 9 rounds. AC 17, full HP 38, grapple +11. Fortitude +8, Reflex +5, Will +7. Battleaxe +11 for 1d8+8. The secondary horn or claw is +6, with 1d6+4 or 1d4+4 damage respectively. Lose the 6 rage HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter when rage ends.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tavra listens for the first returning crew before she opens the cold passage. She stays between the crew and the older branch of the mine.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Teo can cover the exposed ramp while the party checks the loose rail.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a replacement lamp across the ramp before the night crew arrives.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. The encounter takes place on the Material Plane. Studded leather +3, natural armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.

Ranger martial proficiency covers the annulat through Weapon Familiarity. Point Blank Shot adds +1 on ranged attack rolls and damage within 30 ft. Wild empathy +0, Track as a bonus feat, and no spells at Ranger 1.
Favored Enemy is outsiders with the Chaotic subtype. Against them add +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks. Chaotic alignment alone does not qualify.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. On a charge +5 melee, with AC 15 until the next turn. Camouflage on that charge denies Dexterity AC for the attack.
Annulat +3 ranged, 1d6+2 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 30-ft. increment. Point Blank Shot brings this to +4 and 1d6+3 within 30 ft. before range modifiers. Reduce a target’s cover bonus by 2.

Camouflaged annulat example at 20 ft.: against a target with AC 16 from base 10, Dexterity +2, and ordinary cover +4, roll at +4 against AC 12. The camouflage removes +2 Dexterity and annulat proficiency reduces cover to +2. This uses the same per-target option as a camouflaged charge.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Teo wants to bring a replacement lamp across the ramp. He asks the party to check the rail and keeps his one camouflage use against each opponent for whichever opening exists first: a clear charge or a clear throw.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Ranger 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Amphibious skirmisher.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Teral asks the party to moor while he questions an animal and checks beneath the boats.

gm.title: Role
lines: Guides crossings and keeps attackers away from the boats.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the shoal animal that witnessed a missing boat’s passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Strength save +5 and Dexterity save +4. Studded leather, shield, and Defense fighting style give AC 17.
Amphibious. Breathes air and water. Laneshi warrior training supplies Animal Handling and proficiency with spears, tridents, javelins, and light armor.
Skirmish Tactics. After hitting a hostile creature with a weapon attack, take Disengage as a bonus action before the end of the turn.
Beast Whisperers. Speak with animals once per long rest through the species.
Favored Enemy: beasts. Advantage to track beasts with Survival and to recall information on them with Intelligence checks. Natural Explorer: coast.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Trident. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., 1d6+3 piercing with the shield equipped.

Ranger spells, DC 11 and +3 spell attack, two 1st-level slots. Hunter’s mark adds 1d6 on weapon hits against the marked target while concentration holds. Cure wounds restores 1d8+1 HP to a creature Teral touches.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Teral stays within swimming distance. When he neither casts nor moves hunter’s mark with his bonus action, he can use Skirmish Tactics to leave melee after a hit.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
Speed · 20 ft. in armor (base land speed 30 ft.)

gm.title: Hook
lines: Teren has heard footsteps from below the dark stair.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Guide the stranded travelers to the upper landing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good, cleric of Pelor. This encounter takes place on Ysgard. Chainmail +5 and light wooden shield +1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.

Healing and Sun domains. Healing adds +1 caster level to spells of the Healing subschool, including spontaneous cures. Once per day use greater turning in place of a regular turning attempt. Undead that would be turned by that attempt are destroyed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Turn undead 5/day. Turning check 1d20+2 determines the highest individual HD affected. Turning damage is 2d6+3 total HD. One attempt may be greater turning.

Prepared cleric spells, CL 1 unless stated. Cantrips are detect magic, guidance, and light. First-level spells are bless and protection from evil. Domain slot is cure light wounds at CL 2 for 1d8+2 healing.

Daylight (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Bright light in a 60-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for another 60 ft. Lasts 10 minutes and can be dismissed. It applies bright-light penalties without damaging creatures harmed only by actual sunlight. A lightproof cover blocks the effect on a small object. Where it overlaps magical darkness, use the otherwise prevailing light.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Teren keeps watch at a stair in Ysgard where travelers lost their lanterns. He lights the handrail and helps them reach the upper landing. If undead block the stair, he uses turning and saves healing for the injured.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tesk saw who moved the flood markers and will take the party to the washed-out trail if someone stays to warn incoming travelers.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the refuge supplied after travelers stop trusting the road markers.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. unless using the longspear.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +0. Add +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Alertness is the chosen feat. Scent is an optional species feat and is not part of this build.
Cannot gain Shadowlands Taint from exposure. Cloud of Taint and special attacks from Shadowlands creatures can still harm Tesk.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longspear. Melee +2, 10-ft. reach only. Hit 1d8+1 piercing, critical ×3.
Claw or bite. Melee +2, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d4+1 normal damage. One such unarmed attack per round.
Javelin. Ranged +2, 30-ft. range increment. Hit 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Warns from cover first. Uses the spear to hold a narrow passage or the javelin to cover a retreat. Falls back if the party agrees to verify the route together.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tess finds a torn rope down in the sluice and asks who cut it while the current was low.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Reopen a blocked side channel before floodwater reaches the pens.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. HP 4 on 1d6. Wears cloth, with a −3 Dexterity adjustment from AC 10.

Unarmored thief scores are Pick Pockets 15%, Open Locks 30%, Find/Remove Traps 10%, Move Silently 60%, Hide in Shadows 50%, Detect Noise 25%, Climb Walls 70% and Read Languages 0%. In wilderness add 10 points each to Move Silently and Hide in Shadows. In towns subtract 5 points from all thief skills. Opponents take −1 to surprise rolls.
Saving throws are 13 paralysis/poison/death magic, 14 rod/staff/wand, 12 petrification/polymorph, 16 breath weapon and 15 spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sling with stone, effective THAC0 18 at short range and 1d4 damage. Range bands 40/80/160 yards outdoors or feet indoors. Apply −2 attack at medium range and −5 at long range.
Dagger, melee THAC0 20, 1d4 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d3 vs. Large targets. Backstab from behind against an unaware target with discernible anatomy, +4 to hit and double weapon damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tess scouts ahead through the culvert and uses the sling only when a noise will draw the watch away from the exit.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., climb 25 ft. in spider form

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tess offers to check the underside of the bridge while the party questions the toll collectors.

gm.title: Role
lines: Shapechanging scout who can pin a pursuer at a crossing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the missing bridge warden before the night shift closes the span.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +1 and Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +3, grapple +4. Fortitude +6, Reflex +6, Will +2.
Alertness and Improved Initiative. May take 10 on Climb while threatened.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite +4 melee, 1d6+1 piercing. Fortitude DC 14 negates 1d6 temporary Strength damage on contact and again 1 minute later.

Web 3/day as a standard action in spider or hybrid form. Ranged touch +6, range increment 10 ft., maximum 50 ft., targets up to Large. A hit anchors the target. It cannot move, takes −2 to attacks and −4 Dexterity, and must make a DC 15 Concentration check to cast. Escape Artist DC 20 or Strength DC 26 escapes. The web has 6 HP and takes double damage from fire.

Alternate form as a standard action. Switch to the spider-humanoid hybrid at will or to one fixed human form 3/day for 1 hour per use. The human form retains spellcasting and loses the spider's web and poison. Tess carries a dagger (+4 melee, 1d4+1 piercing, 19–20/×2) when traveling in human form.

Sorcerer casting at CL 2, save DC 14 + spell level, 6 cantrips and 5 first-level spells per day. Knows detect magic, ghost sound, light, mage hand, and resistance, plus mage armor and silent image. Mage armor raises AC to 18 for 2 hours. Silent image fills up to six 10-ft. cubes, lasts while concentrating, and allows DC 15 Will disbelief on interaction.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Cast mage armor before investigating. Thin out pursuers with a false barricade, web the first to cross, and withdraw along the underside of the bridge.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tess can reach the back of the lock through the low sluice.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Open the lower gate without letting the channel flood the storehouse.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4, size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +7, Will +1. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or flanked by Tess. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.
Climb, Jump, and Move Silently have no racial bonus. The 20-ft. land speed gives −6 to Jump. Listen retains the +2 racial bonus.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small dagger +1 melee for 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Above water, Small sling +5 ranged for 1d3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, range increment 50 ft. Point Blank Shot makes it +6 for 1d3+1 within 30 ft.
The sling attack includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with slings or thrown weapons.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tess swims through the low sluice and checks the lock from the other side. If a foe follows, she retreats to the dry step before using the sling.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Teva can retry a failed reading after a minute of quiet. The party needs to buy that time while the closing bell draws nearer.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover the names erased from a public register before its replacement is certified.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Touch 11, flat-footed 10. With Inertial Armor, AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Manifester level 1, Seer discipline. 5 PP per day: 2 class, 1 Intelligence, 2 Elan. Each known power costs 1 PP. No known power here requires a save.
Investigator adds +2 to Search and Gather Information. Psion bonus feat Combat Manifestation gives +4 on Concentration to manifest defensively or while grappled or pinned.
Resistance: 1 PP, immediate action, +4 racial bonus to all saves until the start of the next action. Resilience: immediate action, reduce incoming damage by 2 HP per PP spent.
Repletion: 1 PP for 24 hours without food or water. A flat-footed Elan cannot use either immediate defense. All three abilities draw from the same reserve.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Reload as a move action. Dagger −1 melee, 1d4−1 piercing or slashing (minimum 1), critical 19–20/×2.
Inertial Armor, 1 PP. Standard action, personal. Gain +4 armor AC for 1 hour. This armor bonus applies against incorporeal touch attacks.
Call to Mind, 1 PP. Take 1 minute to retry a failed Knowledge check with a +4 competence bonus.

Detect Psionics, 1 PP. Standard action, 60-ft. cone, concentration up to 1 minute. First round detects presence, second reveals number and strongest aura, third locates and gives the strength of each aura.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Read the overwritten entry from the gallery where the original ledger still catches the light. Reserve enough points for one defense. If threatened, use cover and the crossbow while the party gets the ledgers clear.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1 by Table A–37. Nixie monster class level 2, 1 HD.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tivin offers a dry sack for the party’s gear and asks them to lift the anchor from below.

gm.title: Role
lines: Ford negotiator who can guide travelers beneath the current.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Stop a ferryman’s new anchor from tearing an eggbed loose.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. AC includes +1 size and +4 Dexterity. Touch 15, flat-footed 11. BAB +0, grapple −6. Fortitude +1, Reflex +6, Will +3.
Improved Initiative. Amphibious. Tivin can take 10 on Swim checks and run in a straight line while swimming.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sling +5 ranged, 1d4−2 bludgeoning (minimum 1), ×2, 50-ft. range increment. Loading the sling is a move-equivalent action.

Charm Person (Sp), 1/day at caster level 2. One Medium or smaller humanoid within 30 ft. becomes friendly for 2 hours on a failed DC 15 Will save. Give the target +5 on the save if Tivin or his allies are threatening or attacking it. Requests outside the target’s normal behavior require an opposed Charisma check. The target refuses suicidal orders. Threatening it afterward breaks the charm.
Water Breathing (Sp), 1/day at caster level 4. Divide 8 hours of underwater breathing evenly among the living creatures touched.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tivin offers to help the first traveler who puts their weapon down. If talks stall without violence, Tivin uses charm person to get one traveler to hear them out and then offers water breathing for the crossing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tongs can flash readiness across the gantry and hold the approach while the party moves the last porters.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the porters across before the gantry is closed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful neutral. Custom studded leather +3, natural armor +4, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 17. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Limb Symmetry lets this Fighter take Two-Weapon Fighting with Dexterity 12. Both Medium greatswords use two hands and gain 1½ times the Strength bonus. If using both weapons on a full attack, apply −4 to each attack because the off-hand weapon is non-light.
Immune to sleep effects. Monstrous Humanoid type.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.

gm.title: Actions
lines: One Medium greatsword +4 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach.
Full attack with two greatswords, +0/+0 melee, 2d6+4 slashing each, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. This uses all four hands.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. Free a hand before throwing it.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tongs can signal across the gantry with light while the porters cross. If something charges the line, Tongs makes one swing while moving into position and uses both swords only after settling into place.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Toren can identify the replacement timber and needs someone to hold the brace while it seats.

gm.title: Role
lines: Drydock shipwright and hull repair lead.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Lift a grounded vessel enough to inspect the keel without collapsing the bracing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +2. Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +2.
Skill Focus (Craft, shipbuilding) adds +3. Armor check penalty −1, doubled to −2 for Swim. Naturally Psionic supplies 2 PP. The racial ray uses its own daily use.

Outburst (Ex) once per day for up to 4 rounds. This encounter uses a standard action to start it. While active, Str 16, Int 11, Wis 8, grapple +3, Will +1, Climb +6, Swim +5, Craft +7, Knowledge +4, Search +4, and Profession +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Club +2 melee, 1d6+2 bludgeoning one-handed, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. With Outburst, +3 melee and 1d6+3 damage.
Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action.
Sonic Energy Ray once per day. Standard action with a scream, +1 ranged touch to 25 ft., 1d6−1 sonic, ignores object hardness. No save. Power resistance applies. Manifester level 1. Costs no PP.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Inspect and brace the hull before asking anyone to work below it. Use Outburst for the lift after the supports are ready. Keep the ray away from the loaded braces.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 2, ECL 3 from Table A–5.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tov shows the party three sets of tracks and asks which are freshest.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a stolen wage pouch without getting the quarry workers involved.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +5. Multidexterity and Multiweapon Fighting.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Three-arm full attack with club +3 melee (1d6+3 bludgeoning) and two daggers +3 melee each (1d4+1 piercing, 19–20/×2). Add a secondary bite +0 melee (1d4+1 plus poison).
Bite poison, Fortitude DC 14. Initial and secondary damage are each 1d4 Strength, with the second save after 1 minute.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tov leads with his club and keeps the daggers tucked away when a warning will do. When surrounded, he draws both daggers and uses all three weapon arms.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tovin can surround the repair platform with silence while the party steadies the bell and lowers the clapper.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Weigh the cracked clapper before the crew recasts it.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2, small size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 14. BAB +1, grapple −2. Fortitude +5, Reflex +2, Will +0. Armor check penalty −1.
+1 racial on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids. +4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Against Giant-type creatures, AC 20 and touch 17 while able to dodge. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (gnome hooked hammer) are already included. Weapon Familiarity makes the hammer martial.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Small gnome hooked hammer +4 melee with either head wielded alone in two hands. Blunt head deals 1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical ×3. Hook deals 1d4+1 piercing, critical ×4. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action. +5 to hit against kobolds and goblinoids.

Racial silence 1/day at caster level 1, regardless of Charisma. Center it on the Whisper Gnome’s body. The 20-ft.-radius emanation moves with the gnome and lasts 1 minute, dismissible. It blocks sound and verbal spell components.
Charisma 8 leaves only the always-available racial silence on the spell-like ability list.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Tovin asks the party to steady the cracked bell before it rattles the repair platform. He surrounds himself with silence while they lower the clapper. He keeps the platform clear with his hooked hammer if anything threatens the crew.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · 4e level 1, built as a player character.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Tovin asks the party to follow the chalk reed signs while he sends the guard toward a false signal.

gm.title: Role
lines: Wizard who lays false trails and guides retreats.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Lead the last survey crew past the guards without revealing its route.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Cloth, wand, dagger, and a walking stick. Fortitude 12, Reflex 14, Will 13. Bloodied 12. Eight healing surges at 6 HP. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Wand of Accuracy, encounter free action. While wielding the wand, add +1 to one attack roll.

Check Stealth on the initiative roll when in cover or concealment. Gain +5 to saving throws against illusions. Tovin also knows Light, Mage Hand, and Prestidigitation. His spellbook has Comprehend Language, Make Whole, and Tenser’s Floating Disk, plus Flaming Sphere as his alternate daily spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1 at +3 vs. AC for 1d4 or ranged 5/10 at +4 vs. AC for 1d4+1.
Ray of Frost, at-will standard. Ranged 10, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 cold and slowed through the end of Tovin’s next turn.
Thunderwave, at-will standard. Close blast 3 against creatures, +4 vs. Fortitude for 1d6+4 thunder and push 1 square.

Icy Terrain, encounter standard. Area burst 1 within 10 against creatures, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 cold and knock prone. The ground in the burst is difficult terrain through the end of Tovin’s next turn or until he ends it as a minor action.

Sleep, prepared daily standard. Area burst 2 within 20 against creatures, +4 vs. Will. Slowed (save ends) on a hit or miss. A creature hit that fails its first save instead becomes unconscious (save ends).
Ghost Sound, at-will standard or, through Master Trickster, encounter minor. Ranged 10. Make an illusory sound of up to the volume of a shouting creature at an object or unoccupied square.
Fade Away, encounter immediate reaction after taking damage. Tovin becomes invisible until he attacks or his next turn ends.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Tovin’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Places Ghost Sound away from the crew to draw attention, then blocks pursuit with Icy Terrain. Uses Fade Away after a hit to take cover without giving away the way out.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
Speed · 30 ft.; fly 40 ft. (poor) in natural winged form

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vaelis waits on the far side of the checkpoint in a human disguise.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a route across the gap before the checkpoint changes shift.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +6, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are darkness 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, fire resistance 10, and +2 racial on saves against poison. Caster level 1. Trapfinding and Sneak Attack +1d6.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow +4 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Rapier +0 melee for 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
Detect thoughts is Will DC 12. Darkness uses caster level 1. Both are racial spell-like abilities.
Assume a human disguise at Disguise +14. The human form moves 30 ft. on land. Return to natural form before taking off at fly 40 ft. with poor maneuverability.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vaelis approaches the checkpoint in a human disguise. Once past the watch, she returns to her natural shape before crossing the broad gap on the wing. She keeps her load light and leaves enough room to turn.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: A new flight of iron rungs leads through a locked hatch. Vael knows an exposed route around the hillside and asks the party to check the hatch.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get a missing charcoal crew home before the stream rises.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Constitution save +4. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity.
Quadruped. Trapdoors and manholes may require squeezing, and ladders and stairs count as difficult terrain.
Woodfriend. In forests Vael leaves no tracks and can always find true north.
Archery adds +2 to ranged weapon attack rolls. Action Surge grants one extra action on her turn once per short or long rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 piercing, or 1d8 + 1 with two hands in melee.
Second Wind. Bonus action, regain 1d10 + 2 HP once per short or long rest.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vael marks a way out before checking the undergrowth. If threatened, she uses her speed to keep an open line for her shortbow.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vara can carry a depth line to the pilot if the party secures it on shore.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Bring a pilot off a tidal shelf before the channel fills.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. With Force Screen, AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 16. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +1, Will +1.
Skill Focus (Swim) adds +3. Wilder manifester level 1. Reserve 5 PP per day, from 2 class, 1 Charisma and 2 species. Force Screen is the sole known power.

Wild Surge +1 can increase Force Screen to manifester level 2 for the same 1 PP, extending its duration to 2 minutes. Immediately roll for 5% psychic enervation. On enervation, lose 1 PP and become dazed until the end of your next turn.

Outburst (Ex) once per day for up to 4 rounds. This encounter uses a standard action to start it. While active, Str 14, Int 8, Wis 6, grapple +2, Will +0, Swim +9, Spot +2, and Profession (sailor) +2.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortspear +1 melee, 5-ft. reach, or +1 thrown, 20-ft. range increment. One-handed damage 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2. With Outburst, melee +2 and damage 1d6+2 on melee or thrown hits.
Sonic Energy Ray once per day. Standard action with a scream, +1 ranged touch to 25 ft., 1d6−1 sonic, ignores object hardness. No save. Power resistance applies. Manifester level 1. Costs no PP.
Force Screen, 1 PP. Standard action, personal. Gain a +4 shield bonus to AC for 1 minute. The shield bonus also applies against incorporeal touch attacks.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Mark the shallow route with the depth line. Ask the party to secure its shore end before swimming out for the marooned pilot. Use Outburst when the extra strength would help, and keep the once-daily ray for a clear target.

printings.label: Kir-Lanan ledge scout, racial Hit Dice only

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (4 racial HD, LA +4).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varek calls down from a shuttered ledge and offers a warning about the stairwell.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out who opened the abandoned watchtower before his wing arrives.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Dexterity +3, natural armor +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +4, grapple +8. Fortitude +3, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Weapon Focus adds +1 to claws. Flyby Attack lets Varek use one standard action during a flying move.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw +9 melee, 1d4+4 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. Full attack with two claws at +9 each.

Touch +8 or claw +9 against normal AC, with Fortitude DC 13. Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. The Kir-Lanan regains HP equal to the hit point damage dealt by the negative energy, up to its maximum HP. Ignore claw damage and Strength damage when calculating healing.

Ray of Enfeeblement, ranged touch +7. Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as Cleric 4. Turning check 1d20+1, turning damage 2d6+5.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Varek uses the ledge as cover to read the room before showing himself. If cornered, he keeps an open flight path and saves the touch for when he is injured.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · 4e level 1, built as a player character.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varek hands the party a saw marked with the patrol’s seal and asks them to escort the bridge crew.

gm.title: Role
lines: Shield officer at a contested bridge.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Get the bridge crew out before a private patrol tears down the span.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Scale, heavy shield, and longsword. The shield gives −2 to Strength-, Constitution-, and Dexterity-based skill checks. Fortitude 15, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Twelve healing surges at 7 HP.
One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to weapon attacks. Weapon Focus (heavy blade) adds +1 to damage rolls. Battle Ready adds +2 to initiative.

Combat Challenge may mark each enemy Varek attacks through the end of his next turn. The mark gives −2 to attacks that omit him. If a marked adjacent enemy shifts or makes an attack that omits Varek, he can make a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt.
Combat Superiority adds +1 to opportunity attack rolls. A hit stops movement that provoked it.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword basic attack, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Opportunity attack +8 vs. AC.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. On a hit one other enemy adjacent to Varek takes 3 damage.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard using a shield. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4. Push a target of Large size or smaller 1 square on a hit, then optionally shift into the square it left.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. One ally adjacent to the target can shift 2 squares on a hit.

Villain’s Menace, daily standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC for 2d8+4. A hit also grants +2 to attack and +4 to damage rolls against the target for the encounter. A miss grants +1 to attack and +2 to damage rolls against it for the encounter.
Hobgoblin Resilience, encounter immediate reaction, personal. When Varek suffers an effect that a saving throw can end, he makes that save immediately.
Second wind, encounter standard. Spend a healing surge and gain +2 to defenses until the start of Varek’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Uses Tide of Iron to take the bridgehead back and Covering Attack to give a worker room to escape. Saves Resilience for an effect threatening his ability to hold the crossing.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 6 from Table A–41. ECL 8 with 4 class Hit Dice.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varek arrives as the harbor clerk and offers a sketch of the missing hold. The hold in the sketch was never on the ship.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Recover a manifest before a public hearing links him to the missing cargo.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +4, grapple +7. Fortitude +7, Reflex +7, Will +5.

Damage reduction 10/+2. Spell immunity covers 1st- through 3rd-level effects and can be suppressed, as for spell resistance, to receive spells. A hit from a blessed crossbow bolt kills Varek. Alertness and Combat Casting.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Two claws +7 melee, 1d4+3 each, and a secondary bite +2 melee, 1d6+1, when making a full attack in natural form.

Alternate Form (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 18. Use the original alter self rules and choose a humanoid form. Varek can remain disguised indefinitely. His usual disguise is a human clerk.

Detect thoughts (Sp) 3/day, caster level 12, Will DC 15 to hide surface thoughts. Concentrate for up to 12 minutes. The first round detects minds, the second gives their number and Intelligence scores, and the third permits reading surface thoughts.

Sorcerer casting, caster level 4. Daily slots 6/7/4. DC 13 + spell level. Known 0-level spells are detect magic, light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, and read magic. Known 1st-level spells are charm person, command (cleric spell cast as arcane), and silent image. Known 2nd-level spell is invisibility.

Silent image creates a purely visual illusion for as long as Varek concentrates. Will DC 14 disbelieves on interaction. Invisibility lasts 40 minutes or until the target attacks. Varek must suppress his own immunity to accept it.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Varek uses detect thoughts to see who recognizes his story. He shows a false cargo hold with silent image. If confronted, he suppresses immunity before turning invisible or sends an associate away under the spell.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Hit dice · 1d10+2, plus 2 HP from Combat Conditioning

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varesh points regular traffic to the long approach so he can watch the culvert.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the passage open until the lost patrol returns.

gm.title: Traits
lines: STR and CON saves +5 and +4. Scale mail gives AC 15 and disadvantage on Stealth checks. Void ancestry grants necrotic resistance.

Diaspora heritage with maul proficiency and History. Timeless Resolve gives Varesh and his allies within 5 ft. of him advantage on saves against becoming frightened. Soldier background grants Medicine and Survival. Combat Conditioning adds 2 HP and raises healing hit die results below 2 to 2.

Last Stand. Once this build’s single hit die is spent it cannot use this reaction again until it recovers a die. When incoming damage would bring Varesh below half his maximum HP (below 7 HP), he can spend the die and heal 1d10+2 HP, applying Combat Conditioning.

Martial Action Wind Up. Bonus action with the spear in both hands. Pick a visible target within 10 ft. and add 2 damage on the first melee weapon hit against it this turn. Breath Weapon uses the same bonus action.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spear +5, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft. One-handed or thrown hit deals 1d6+3 piercing. Two-handed melee hit deals 1d8+3 piercing.
Void Breath, 2 uses per long rest. Bonus action, choose a 30-by-5-ft. line or a 15-ft. cone. Each creature makes a DC 12 DEX save, taking 1d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Varesh cases the short approach with keensense. He holds the gate with his spear and saves the breath for a group that has bunched beyond the threshold.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varik calls the porters behind him and looks for space to clear the opening.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Clear the gate mouth so the porters can move their carts through.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision, passive Insight 16 and Perception 16

gm.title: Traits
lines: Fortitude 12, Reflex 16, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor, dagger, and Toughness. Artful Dodger gives AC 17 against opportunity attacks. Extra +1 weapon talent attack with a dagger.
Resist acid 5 at level 1. Razor Storm uses Dexterity to attack.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures yet to act in round one. Once per turn under the rules update, an eligible dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage adds 2d6 Sneak Attack damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +6 vs. AC for 1d4+2 damage.
Sly Flourish, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Piercing Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. Reflex for 1d4+4.
Dazing Strike, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4 and dazes the target through the end of Varik’s next turn.
Trick Strike, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 3d4+4 and slides the target 1. On a hit against that target later this encounter, slide it 1.
Razor Storm, encounter minor. Close burst 1 against each creature, +6 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Feints to separate an intruder from the porters. Uses Razor Storm only after allies clear his immediate reach.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 4. ECL 9 (5 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Varka agrees to brighten a flame beside the safe passage.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Signal the party once the escape route opens.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4 and natural armor +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +5, grapple +8. Fortitude +6, Reflex +10, Will +4.

Fire resistance 10 and spell resistance 15. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse applies to the rapier and bite. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 on eligible hits.

Control Flame (Sp), 1/day, caster level 5. As a standard action, change an existing nonmagical fire within 10 ft. Dim it to coals or brighten it to daylight brightness and twice its normal illumination radius. The effect lasts 5 minutes. Heat output and fuel consumption stay the same.

The natural bite deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. In a full attack with a weapon, apply a −5 penalty to the bite attack and add half the Strength bonus to its damage.
Orc Blood allows the tanarukk to use or create items with orc-specific powers as an orc.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier +9 melee for 1d6+3 piercing, critical 18–20/×2. On a full attack, add bite +4 for 1d6+1, critical ×2. Bite alone +9 for 1d6+4, critical ×2.
Within 10 ft. of a nonmagical signal flame, brighten it for 5 minutes to show the group which route is open. The flame’s heat and fuel consumption stay the same.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Varka leads the way through the dim gallery and brightens the signal flame once the escape route is open. She uses the rapier and follows with a bite when a full attack is possible.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vasha will name the boat that struck the pier if someone gets the workers a public hearing.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the night dock open after a fatal accident threatens its license.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. Make two Boat hook attacks.

Boat hook. Melee attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Once per turn on a hit, a Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or move 5 ft. toward the champion.
Thrown belaying pin. Ranged attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Pulls opponents away from the object or person under guard. Stops fighting once the opponent leaves the guarded area.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vela can read the cairn marker and guide the party through the cut.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the right fork of the trail before the wind covers the tracks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +2.

Climate Tolerant (Ex) waives environmental Fortitude saves between −20°F and 140°F. It gives no protection from fire or cold damage and counts as Cold Endurance only for feat and prestige-class prerequisites.
+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Vela spends 2 skill points to read and write Common. Primitive Weapon Mastery adds +1 to shortbow and shortspear attack rolls. Her Ranger proficiencies cover both weapons.
Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Favored enemy animals adds +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, and weapon damage rolls against animals.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Shortbow +5 for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Point Blank Shot raises it to +6 for 1d6+1 within 30 ft.
Shortspear +4 melee for 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2. A longsword +3 for 1d8+2 slashing provides a comparison because it is outside the mastery list.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vela follows tracks between the cairns and reads an old Common warning marker where the route forks. She guides the party through the sheltered cut before the wind rises.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Fighter 2. Proficiency bonus +2. Exploration and defense.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vela asks for a watch while she sleeps within range of the missing survey team.

gm.title: Role
lines: Maps ruins and listens for clues in nearby dreams.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Compare a dream of a sealed passage with the actual layout.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Cartographer’s tools +4 with Intelligence through Dreamwalking

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common, Dreamspeak, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Giant.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Strength and Constitution saves +4. Chain shirt, shield, and Defense fighting style give AC 18.

Dreamwalking. While asleep Vela can touch the dreams of others within 1 mile. Today’s choice of cartographer’s tools adds her +2 proficiency bonus to applicable rolls. Sleep does not penalize her nonvisual Perception checks.
Power Nap. Sleep for 1 hour during a short rest to remove one level of exhaustion and regain one spent Hit Die on top of the regular rest benefits.
Action Surge. Take one extra action on your turn, once per short or long rest.
Second Wind. As a bonus action, regain 1d10+2 HP, once per short or long rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Rapier. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+2 piercing.
Javelin. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., 1d6+2 piercing.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vela blocks the passage with her shield while expedition members retreat. A safe hour lets her recover a spent die and scout for nearby dreams.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Verren needs someone to lead the last workers to the cross-passage.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Hold the gate long enough for the workers to clear the passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Material Plane. Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. Total armor check penalty −3. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +2, Will +0.
Cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.
Weapon Focus (longsword) is the Fighter bonus feat. When a melee attack misses because of concealment, Blind-Fight lets Verren reroll the miss chance once. His ranged attacks gain no reroll.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword +5 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Javelin +3 ranged, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.

Darkness (Sp), 1/day at CL 1 from character level. Standard action, touch one object. Shadowy illumination in a 20-ft. radius for 10 minutes, dismissible. Creatures in the area have concealment (20% miss chance), even against darkvision, including the Tiefling’s own. Ordinary lights and lower-level light spells do not brighten the area. A lightproof cover over a small object blocks the effect until removed.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Verren guides the last workers to the cross-passage and holds the gate. He can put darkness on the gate latch when a pursuer enters the straight passage. He stays close enough to use his longsword and applies his Blind-Fight reroll only to a melee miss caused by concealment.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vesh offers to reach the rope from underwater while someone watches the ferry's drift.

gm.title: Role
lines: Channel warden and submerged rescue guide.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Free the snagged ferry rope before the pull of the current tears out the bracket.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Dexterity +1 and natural armor +5, with no shield.
Racial ranks are Balance 4, Jump 3, Swim 3. Each check has the +4 racial bonus. Hold breath up to 64 rounds before drowning checks. Weapon Focus (claw).

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw +5 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing. A full attack adds a second claw at the same bonus and a secondary bite at −1 for 1d4+1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning.
Use Swim +10 to reach and release the ferry line. On a successful full-round Swim check, Vesh can go up to 15 ft.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vesh keeps both hands available for the rope and enters the water before the ferry pulls taut.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vesk has marked a door that disappeared at dusk. He needs someone to hold the last ordinary passage open while he finds it again.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find a route for a missing survey crew to reach its camp before the gates close.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Constitution save +5. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. The Archery fighting style adds +2 to sling attack rolls.
Keeper of Secrets grants advantage on Arcana checks about planes and planar travel. Vesk chose Insight proficiency.

Portal Sense reveals the direction and distance to the nearest nonmagical entrance or exit while Vesk is in a confined area. Vesk has advantage on Investigation or Perception checks to find hidden or invisible doors and magical portals.
Action Surge grants an extra action on Vesk’s turn once per short or long rest.
Vesk’s background grants Investigation, Stealth, Common, and cartographer’s tools.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 1 with two hands.

Unraveling Touch. Action, once per long rest. A creature Vesk can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it must spend its action each turn to repeat the save. A success ends the effect.
Second Wind. Bonus action once per short or long rest. Regain 1d10 + 2 HP.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: In a closed room, Vesk calls out the nearest ordinary exit. If someone blocks that route, he uses Unraveling Touch to buy time for others to get past.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vess signals the party from the guard ledge above the grate.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep the grate clear until the crew can latch it from the far side.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Hide +7 (+11 in rocky or underground surroundings)

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy steel shield +2 and natural armor +6. Touch 10, flat-footed 20. Armor check penalty −2. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +9, Reflex +0, Will +0.

Stench (Ex). Anger or fear triggers the musk. Living creatures within 30 ft. other than troglodytes make a Fortitude save or become sickened for 10 rounds. The DC is 10 + half the racial Hit Dice + the Constitution modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that individual troglodyte’s stench for 24 hours.
Poison immunity prevents the effect. Apply normal bonuses against poison to the save. Delay poison or neutralize poison removes the sickness.
Color-changing skin gives +4 on Hide checks, rising to +8 in rocky or underground surroundings.

Two claw attacks deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage each and the bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. Bonus Multiattack reduces the secondary attack penalty from −5 to −2.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fighter bonus feat Weapon Focus (javelin) adds +1 on javelin attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Javelin +3 ranged for 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, range increment 30 ft.
Club +5 in one hand for 1d6+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2. While holding the club and shield, add only the secondary bite at +3 for 1d4+1 on a full attack.
Stench is Fortitude DC 15. A creature protected against Vess by a successful save still rolls against a different troglodyte if exposed to its stench.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vess holds a javelin while watching the grate and switches to a club if a foe closes. He has the non-troglodyte crew wait beyond the range of his Stench.

gm.title: Hook
lines: The courier asks you to return a letter using the upstairs exit. Their face looks familiar, but their coat clasp is the wrong color.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find out who has been intercepting replies on the gallery route.

gm.title: Skills
lines: Bluff +10 (+30 when impersonating a seen individual with Change Shape)

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unaligned. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +3. Fortitude 11, Reflex 16, Will 15. Bloodied 9. One healing surge, worth 4 HP.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures that have not acted yet when the encounter starts. Sneak Attack adds 2d6 to one eligible hit per round with the dagger against a target granting combat advantage.
Rogue Weapon Talent adds +1 to dagger attack rolls. The printed NPC class grants trained Thievery and Bluff is the second trained skill.

Change Shape is an at-will Polymorph minor action. Assume the appearance of a Medium humanoid, including an individual you have seen. Your statistics and equipment stay the same. The form lasts until you change it or die. Someone challenging your impersonation of an individual rolls Insight against your Bluff with a +20 bonus to your roll.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger basic attack (at-will, standard). Melee 1 +5 vs. AC for 1d4+1, or ranged 5/10 +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4.
Sly Flourish (at-will, standard). Dagger melee or ranged 5/10, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+7.
Dazing Strike (encounter, standard). Dagger melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4 and dazed until the end of Vessa’s next turn.

Easy Target (daily, standard). Dagger melee or ranged 5/10, +8 vs. AC for 2d4+4. The target is slowed and grants Vessa combat advantage, with one save ending both. On a miss, half damage and grants Vessa combat advantage until the end of Vessa’s next turn.
Second wind (encounter, standard). Spend the one healing surge to regain 4 HP. All defenses gain +2 until the start of Vessa’s next turn.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vessa borrows a familiar face to carry a reply through the gallery. If recognized, they use Dazing Strike to open a route to the stairs.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vessa spotted a recent seam in the wall beside the passage door.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Find the dry exit before the water reaches the next landing.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +0. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3 to Search.
+2 racial on saves against poison and +2 racial on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
Stonecunning gives +2 Search to notice unusual stonework and permits a check within 10 ft. Trapfinding also permits her to search for other difficult traps.

Strong Swimmers gives +2 racial on Swim checks and doubles the Constitution score used to calculate breath-holding time. Seacliff dwarves use normal Swim checks and breathe air. Constitution 14 gives 56 calm rounds with the cited DMG baseline, or 28 with Stormwrack p. 11. Track exertion under the chosen procedure.

+4 dodge AC against giants while dodge bonuses apply. No racial attack bonus against orcs or goblinoids. Sneak attack +1d6 against a flanked target or one denied Dexterity to AC, if the target has no concealment.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Short sword +1 melee, 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. The piercing attack avoids the usual slashing and bludgeoning penalties underwater when she has firm footing or succeeds on her Swim check.
Search +11 for unusual stonework. Check the groove around the flooded passage door before touching the release.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vessa inspects the stonework before flooding reaches the next landing. She can slip under the water to check the passage but returns to air before trying the release.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vessa can interpret a warning from the keeper across the landing and show the party which stair is open.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Relay warnings without speaking in the passage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Chaotic good. Unarmored, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +2, Will +2. Against spells and spell-like effects: Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +4.

Spell Focus (Enchantment) adds +1 to enchantment save DCs. Sorcerer caster level 1. Spontaneous casting, five 0-level slots and four 1st-level slots per day. Carries a spell component pouch and has no familiar.

Tail poison has four doses per day from Constitution 12. The initial Fortitude save is DC 11, with no secondary effect. Table ruling for this encounter. Treat tail damage as piercing and spend one available dose per damaging tail hit. A hit that deals no damage spends no dose. Vessa can translate tail code into Common.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Trident +0 melee or +2 thrown, 1d8 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. melee reach or 10-ft. range increment. Weapon Familiarity makes the trident simple.

Tail −5 melee, 1d4 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Full attack with trident +0 and tail −5. A damaging tail hit spends an available dose and sickens the target for 2d4 rounds unless it makes a DC 11 Fortitude save.

Charm person (1st): standard action, one Humanoid within 25 ft., Will DC 15 negates, duration 1 hour. Spell resistance applies. A target threatened or attacked by Vessa or her allies gets +5 on the save. On a failure, the target treats Vessa as a trusted ally. An unusual request takes a successful opposed Charisma check. A threat by Vessa or her allies breaks the spell.
Shield (1st): standard action, personal, 1 minute. AC becomes 16 and flat-footed AC 14. Ordinary touch AC remains 12. Stops magic missile and protects against incorporeal touch.

Cantrips known: daze, detect magic, light, and mage hand. Daze takes a standard action and targets one Humanoid with 4 HD or fewer within 25 ft. The target takes no actions for 1 round unless it makes a DC 14 Will save. Spell resistance applies.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vessa is relaying silent warnings along a stair where voices carry. She translates for surface travellers. She casts shield if someone corners her, and would rather persuade a frightened humanoid to let her pass than stay to fight.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vey opens a hatch above a lower landing and asks who can carry the checkpoint lantern on the way down.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep travelers moving while the upper passage is closed.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Proficiency +2. Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. Arcana proficiency comes from Mystical Understanding.
Spell Damping gives advantage on Strength (−1) and Dexterity (+2) saves against spells. Arcane Heritage waives class prerequisites to attune to a magic item.

Spellcasting. Intelligence DC 13, spell attack +5. Two 1st-level slots per long rest. Arcane Recovery restores one expended 1st-level slot after a short rest, once per day. The spellbook also contains detect magic and comprehend languages, available as rituals without preparing them.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Ray of frost (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft. Hit 1d8 cold and reduce target speed by 10 ft. through the start of Vey’s next turn.
Light or mage hand (cantrips). Light a touched object for 1 hour, or manipulate a light object in reach of a spectral hand within 30 ft. for up to 1 minute.
Mage armor (1st level). Touch a willing unarmored creature. Its base AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours (Vey’s AC rises to 15).
Fog cloud (1st level). A 20 ft. radius sphere within 120 ft. is heavily obscured for up to 1 hour with concentration. Wind of at least 10 mph disperses it.

Grease (1st level). Cover a 10 ft. square within 60 ft. with difficult terrain for 1 minute. Creatures in it when cast, entering it, or ending a turn there must pass a Dexterity save (DC 13) or fall prone.

Feather fall (1st level, reaction). When Vey or a creature within 60 ft. falls, choose up to five falling creatures within 60 ft. They descend at 60 ft. per round for up to 1 minute and land on their feet without fall damage if they land before the spell ends.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Vey saves a spell slot for feather fall. When the upper passage closes, she guides travelers to the maintenance shaft and lowers them to the landing beneath it.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · CR 1 by Table A–31. Kyton monster class level 4, 3 HD.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Veyl offers the party a key in exchange for the name beside a scratched-out tally.

gm.title: Role
lines: Guard of a tollgate built into a stairwell.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Collect a debt from a smuggler before the gaoler checks his ledger.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lawful evil. AC includes +2 natural armor and +2 Dexterity. Touch 12, flat-footed 12. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Cold immunity. Improved Initiative and Weapon Focus (chain rake). The weapon focus also applies to a spiked chain.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Chain rake +7 melee, 1d6+3 slashing, 10-ft. reach including adjacent squares. Full attack makes two rakes at +7 each.
Unnerving Gaze (Su). Enemies within 5 ft. make a DC 12 Will save or take a −1 morale penalty on attack rolls for 1d3 rounds. Each enemy can be subject to Veyl’s gaze once per day.

Dancing Chains (Su). As a standard action, control one unattended chain within 20 ft. Veyl can add up to 15 ft. of length and grow barbs. The chain makes one attack per round at +7 for 1d6+3. Veyl climbs a controlled chain at his land speed without a check.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Veyl animates the tollgate’s hanging chain while he bargains. He uses his body chains to cover both the gap beside him and the stairs behind it.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Challenge · Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.

gm.title: Hook
lines: Vorr gestures to a stake below the waterline and offers safe crossing in exchange for a warning if an unfamiliar boat appears.

gm.title: Motive
lines: Keep strangers from blundering into the deep current or disturbing the fish traps.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Normal vision. Once-daily alarm within 10 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Neutral. HP 8 on 1d10 + 3 Constitution. Carries two stone-tipped spears. The harness leaves natural AC 5 intact. The Savage Warrior penalties apply to unfamiliar clothing and armor.

If frustrated, confused or hit for at least 8 damage at once, make a Wisdom check at −2, target 10. Failure grants +1 attack, +3 damage and +5 temporary HP and prevents using a shield or checking morale. It lasts up to five rounds. Magic can end either form. Removing the frustration can end a frustration rage. Killing the attacker can end rage from a wound.

gm.title: Actions

player.title: Applies to
