player.title: Adjustments
lines: Printed source. Appendix D, p. 225. Roll 1d20 for the anomaly.
1. Gravity fails in a 100-ft. radius for 1 hour. Unattended objects drift. Creatures float and can move as if climbing by pushing or pulling against surfaces or fixed objects.
2. The nearest creature is subject to Hideous Laughter, save DC 15. It babbles instead of laughing.
3. Creatures within 60 ft. are Stunned for 1 round, with no save.
4. The nearest creature gains Blink for 1 minute and slips through time when it vanishes.
5. In a 20-ft. radius, creatures make a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 8d6 radiant damage and Blinds for 1 round. Wood turns into glass.
6. For 1 minute, attacks that hit within 60 ft. show a vision of the target dying from the hit.
7. Creatures within 30 ft. are subject to Irresistible Dance, save DC 15.
8. Part of the surroundings becomes a delerium elemental appropriate to its element.
9. The GM chooses or randomly determines an extraplanar creature. It stays for 1 hour and is friendly to whoever triggered the anomaly.
10. Humanoid corpses within 120 ft. rise as hostile Haze Husks.
11. The shadows of 1d6 random creatures come alive and attack their owners. Destroying a shadow leaves its owner without one for 24 hours.
12. Creatures within 60 ft. become Invisible for 1 minute, ending for each creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
13. The nearest creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save against 8d8 necrotic damage, halved on success. The next three nearest creatures within 60 ft. each heal the damage it took.
14. Hypnotic Pattern appears, save DC 15. Those Incapacitated by it weep.
15. Black Tentacles appears in the area for 1 hour, escape DC 15.
16. Objects within 60 ft. animate for 1 hour as under Animate Objects. They speak and remain nonhostile.
17. The nearest creature becomes an awakened shrub for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 HP, with no save.
18. Up to six random creatures within 120 ft. are subject to Slow for 1 minute, save DC 15.
19. One random creature within 60 ft. gains Haste for 1 minute.
20. A bowl of flowers and an aquatic mammal appear 100 ft. overhead.

player.title: Adjustments
lines: Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.

Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.

Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.

A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.

Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

lines: Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.

A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.

Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.

An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.

The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

lines: Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.

Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.

Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.

player.title: Adjustments
lines: Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.

Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.

Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.

player.title: Adjustments
lines: Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.

Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.

Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.

Soulsight. Within the creature’s listed radius, it perceives creatures other than Constructs and Undead. This counts as seeing them for its features. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.

player.title: Adjustments
lines: Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.

Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.

Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.

A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human and Incarnum subtypes. No racial ability score adjustments. Base land speed 30 ft. The Human subtype makes Azurins count as human for applicable effects. The Incarnum subtype supplies no shared abilities or defenses.
Gain one bonus feat at 1st level. Azurin traits do not grant the human bonus skill points.

The racial essentia pool increases permanently by 1. This creates a pool of 1 if the character has no other source. An essentia pool supplies points to invest in eligible feats, soulmelds, and abilities.

Normal capacity per investment is 1 at levels 1–5, 2 at 6–11, 3 at 12–17, and 4 at 18–20. Soulmeld investments can be reallocated as a swift action. Incarnum feat investments are normally set once per day and locked for 24 hours.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages can be any nonsecret language. Favored class Soulborn. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Twelve-level monster class. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Goblin, Infernal, and Worg. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Barghest.

Begins with a 1d6 bite, +2 natural armor, and Feed. After slaying a humanoid, consume its body and life force as a full-round action for a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution for one day. Resurrection needing a body fails. Wish, miracle, and true resurrection each have a 50% chance to fail.

At level 2 gains 1d4 claws and scent 10 ft. A standard action shifts into wolf or goblin form. In wolf form, move at 60 ft., gain +4 circumstance to Hide, and use pass without trace as a free action. Scent increases at levels 5 and 8.

Levitate, misdirection, and project image each begin at 1/day at level 3, increase to 3/day at level 6, and become at will at level 11. Charm monster, charm person, dimension door, and emotion each are 1/day from level 7. Caster level equals class Hit Dice. Save DC 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier.
DR 5/+1 begins at level 5 and becomes DR 10/+1 at level 12. Finishes at ECL 12, CR 4, 6d8 Hit Dice, BAB +6/+1, base saves +5/+5/+5, and +6 natural armor.

Razor Storm is an encounter minor action, close burst 1 against every creature in the burst, including allies. Chosen ability +2 vs. Reflex deals 1d6 + Dexterity modifier. At levels 11 and 21 the racial attack bonus increases to +4 and +6 and the dice to 2d6 and 3d6.
The Improved Razor Storm feat can substitute a close burst 2, with d8s instead of d6s plus ongoing 5 damage, save ends. Ongoing damage increases to 10 and 15 at levels 11 and 21.

lines: Medium Humanoid. The Astral Plane is the Buomman homeland. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype when away from the Astral Plane. Land speed 30 ft. +2 Wisdom, −2 Charisma.

Silent Spell removes the verbal component using a slot one level higher and cannot modify Bard spells. Nonverbal Spell substitutes another sound, such as song, and still fails within magical silence. Spells without verbal components are unaffected by Nonverbal Spell.

lines: Medium deerlike humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft. Constitution +2. Proficiency in one of Athletics, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

Surge of Vigor. When an attack inflicts more than half your current HP in damage, immediately regain 1d12 + your Constitution modifier HP. This can trigger when the hit takes you to 0 HP. Once per long rest.
Grove cervan. Dexterity +1 and walking speed 35 ft. Long jump 30 ft. and high jump 15 ft. with or without a running start. Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

Pronghorn cervan. Strength +1. Double carrying capacity and push, drag, and lift limits. Antler unarmed strike deals 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward an opponent, the charge costs a bonus action and adds 1d6 piercing. A Large or smaller target makes a Strength save at DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. On failure, push it 10 ft. away into a space you choose.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Shapechanger subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The edition gives no racial ability adjustments, racial Hit Dice, or level adjustment.
+2 racial on saving throws against sleep and charm effects.
+2 racial on Bluff, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks.

Minor Change Shape (Su) is an at-will full-round action that physically alters the Changeling’s body, including facial features, skin color and texture, and size within the limits of disguise self. Clothing and possessions keep their appearance.

Within the disguise self limits, height can vary by up to 1 ft. and build can vary while keeping the same basic body plan. The new appearance retains the Changeling’s game traits. Wizards’ 3.5 FAQ gives the appearance of a Warforged as an example.
Minor Change Shape grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks when used to create a disguise. The form lasts until another change. True seeing reveals the natural form, and death restores it.
In this printing, Changelings can copy a dragonmark’s appearance. Their ancestry does not develop dragonmarks or confer their powers.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Halfling, and Terran. Favored class Rogue.

lines: Small Humanoid (Gnome), also called imago. Base land speed 20 ft. +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, −2 Strength.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Monstrous Humanoid. +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, −4 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. from the creature type.
Small size gives +1 on attack rolls and to AC, +4 on Hide checks, and three-quarters the carrying capacity of a Medium creature.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.

lines: Motive. Recover a missing collection ledger.

Dusk Corvum appraiser, Rogue 2 · Provisional CR 1/2. · Medium Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Crowlike birdfolk with dark, often iridescent feathers.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
Learned. Gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.
Appraising Eye. Spend an action examining an object to learn its magical properties, how to activate it, and an estimated market price. Regain the use after a short or long rest.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Dusk Corvum. Dexterity +1, Insight proficiency, and advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Kindled Corvum. Charisma +1 and proficiency in Deception or Persuasion. Gain advantage on Charisma checks to convince someone of your expertise in your Learned subject. Learn one language and one tool proficiency, and recall sights and sounds from the last month exactly.

AC 16 · HP 16 (2d6+4, plus 2 HP while attached) · Speed 30 ft.

Motive. Keep unscheduled visitors away from the sealed lower gallery.

AC 17 · HP 21 (2d10+4, plus 2 HP while attached) · Speed 30 ft.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Aberration. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Proficient with all simple weapons and any weaponlike symbiont used. Armor proficiencies come from class.

Personal Symbiont (Ex). At first level choose a breed leech, crawling gauntlet, or throwing scarab. At 5th level stormstalk and winter cyst become options, at 10th spellwurm and tentacle whip, and at 15th tongue worm. Earlier choices remain available.
Growing a new personal symbiont replaces the old one. A lost personal symbiont takes 2d4 days to regrow once the original has died. This ability applies only to the personal symbiont.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Common is automatic. Daelkyr is the bonus language. Favored class Rogue. No racial Hit Dice, ability score adjustments, or level adjustment.

gm.title: Original NPC · Rell Ashgate
lines: Motive. Get the last passenger across before someone cuts the ferry rope.
Hook. Rell wants the crossing kept open. He offers to go below the water to retrieve a slipped mooring.
Bearfolk-heritage Darakhul ferryman, Barbarian 2 · Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR · Medium Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Constitution +1 and darkvision 60 ft. Choose a heritage for size, speed and added traits.

Imperfect Undeath. Humanoid affected by effects that specifically target undead. Normal healing works. Ordinary resurrection returns a Darakhul. True Resurrection or Wish can return the original living form.

Hunger for Flesh. Eat 1 lb. of raw meat every 24 hours or gain one exhaustion level. While hunger exhaustion remains, healing and recovery from exhaustion are blocked until spending at least an hour eating 10 lb. of raw meat.

Powerful Jaw. Bite unarmed strike for 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing. Sunlight Sensitivity gives disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception if the character, target or subject is in direct sunlight.

Undead Resilience gives necrotic and poison resistance, disease immunity and advantage on saves against charm or poison. A short rest removes one exhaustion level if at least 1 lb. of raw meat was eaten within 24 hours, subject to Hunger for Flesh.
Undead Vitality. No breathing. Six hours of semiconscious dormancy give the sleep benefit of eight human hours. Perception checks during dormancy have disadvantage.

Common heritage rules grant Darakhul, Umbral and the heritage language. Bearfolk Heritage adds Strength +2 and Common for a mortal-land origin or Umbral for a Shadow Realm origin. Medium, speed 30 ft. Jaws of Death raises bite damage to 1d6 + Strength. Undead Fortitude lets a survivor of a drop to 0 HP drop to 1 instead once per long rest.

Shadow Goblin Heritage adds Dexterity +2 and Goblin and Umbral. Small, speed 30 ft. Dark Deed is an action against a visible target within 30 ft. that can see and hear the Darakhul. On a failed Wisdom save against DC 10 + Charisma modifier, it is frightened of the Darakhul through the end of its turn.

gm.title: Original NPC · Oru Breakwater
lines: Motive. Reach the stranded gatherers before the tide closes the cave.
Hook. Oru can listen for movement through the flooded cave mouth.
Darfellan sea-cave guide, Barbarian 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0). · Medium Humanoid (Darfellan)
AC 13 · HP 15 (1d12+3) · Speed 30 ft., swim 40 ft.

gm.title: Original NPC · Tava Ebbgate
lines: Motive. Guide the rope team safely across the channel.
Hook. Tava has found a rock ledge where the team can get out of the water.
Darfellan shoal guard, Fighter 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0). · Medium Humanoid (Darfellan)
AC 13 · HP 12 (1d10+2) · Speed 20 ft., swim 40 ft.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Darfellan). +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity. Land speed 20 ft., swim speed 40 ft. LA +0 and advancement by character class.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.

Hold Breath (Ex) allows 8 × Constitution score rounds. A standard action uses one extra round of that budget. When it runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and rising by 1 per previous check. A failed check starts drowning. Darfellans breathe air.

Natural bite deals 1d6. When the bite is the sole primary natural weapon, add 1½ times the Strength bonus. An armed full attack can add one secondary bite at −5 to the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage. Extra attacks from base attack bonus apply only to the primary weapon.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.
Darfellan is automatic. Aquan and Common are bonus languages. Favored class Barbarian.
Page 144 adds a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks with marine mammals in its combat text. The p. 37 and p. 144 player trait lists omit this bonus.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Apply Elf; add +1 Charisma and expand darkvision to 120 feet.
Sunlight sensitivity affects attacks and sight-based Perception. Gain rapier, shortsword, and hand crossbow proficiency.
Dancing lights at will; faerie fire at level 3 and darkness at level 5, each once per long rest. Spellcasting uses Charisma.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium human subrace. +2 Intelligence and −2 Dexterity. Land speed 30 ft. No racial Hit Dice or positive level adjustment listed.
Low-light vision doubles human sight distance in poor illumination and preserves color and detail.

Spell Clutch (Su). Once per day, use a standard action to prepare again one 1st-level spell you previously prepared and cast. Cast the spell separately when needed. The supernatural activation does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Common and Roushoum are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Terran, and Undercommon, or by region. The Deep Imaskar region lists Abyssal, Aquan, Celestial, Draconic, Terran, and Undercommon. Favored class Wizard.
Ability scores follow the racial traits on p. 9. The summary table on p. 6 instead lists a Strength penalty.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +6 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Maximize the first racial die and roll later dice, including the first class die.
Racial skill points are five times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Climb, Intimidate, Jump, Listen, Sense Motive, and Spot.

Primary horn deals 1d6 plus Strength and has a ×3 critical. Two secondary claws deal 1d4 plus half the Strength bonus each and take −5 to hit. A weapon full attack can add one secondary horn or one secondary claw.
Goblin, Undercommon, and Common are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 6 before class levels.
This is the March 2003 player profile. The later 3.5 conversion of the encounter monster lists Humanoid (Goblinoid), LA +3, and an alternate attack routine.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Monstrous Humanoid. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. from the creature type. +2 natural armor.
+4 Dexterity and +2 Constitution, derived from the Monster Manual’s sample ability scores. Apply the Wisdom and Charisma adjustments from Madness separately.

Madness (Ex) gives −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma, uses Charisma in place of Wisdom on Will saves, and grants immunity to confusion and insanity effects. Miracle or wish can restore sanity, reversing those ability adjustments and ending the trait.
Vulnerability to Sunlight (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage per hour in sunlight. Constitution 0 is fatal. Recover 1 point per 24 hours spent underground or otherwise sheltered from sunlight.
+4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Racial spell-like abilities, CL 3. At will, darkness and ghost sound. Once per day each, daze and sound burst. Save DCs use Charisma.
Racial Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits under the Rogue rules. Poison Use (Ex) protects the derro from accidentally poisoning itself while handling poison.
Three racial Hit Dice (3d8) grant BAB +3, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +3, and two feats. Favored class Sorcerer.

Underdark lists LA +1 and ECL 4. Its adventurer section includes derro with Madness, which this profile retains. The Monster Manual lists LA +2 specifically for a sane derro, giving ECL 5 before class levels under that rule.

gm.title: Original NPC · Selian Dawnledger

Deva archive negotiator, Invoker 1 · Level 1 Invoker NPC. Uses 4e character math. · Medium Immortal humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Intelligence +2 and Wisdom +2. Speak Common and two other languages. History and Religion each gain a +2 racial bonus.
Immortal Origin counts as immortal for effects that check origin. Astral Majesty adds 1 to every defense when the attacker is bloodied.
Astral Resistance reduces necrotic and radiant damage by 5 plus half your level.
Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes is an encounter power that takes no action. After making an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check, add 1d6 to that roll if desired.

lines: Replace the Tiefling spell package. Know vicious mockery; gain charm person at level 3 and enthrall at level 5, each once per long rest. Use Charisma.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider with the Native and Chaotic subtypes. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and no racial ability score adjustments. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice. LA +1.
Gain +2 racial on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects. The Chaotic subtype counts for alignment-dependent effects, and attacks overcome damage reduction as chaotic-aligned.
Gain +2 racial on Intimidate against animals and humanoids. Take −2 on Diplomacy, Handle Animal, Perform, and Sense Motive.
Weapon Familiarity treats the trident as a simple weapon.

The tail is a secondary natural attack at −5, with 1d4 base damage. Its injury poison takes a Fortitude save at DC 10 + half total HD, rounded down, + Constitution modifier. The initial effect is sickened for 2d4 rounds. There is no secondary damage. The Compendium gives 3 + Constitution modifier doses per day.
A sickened creature takes −2 on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

Automatic languages are Diabolan and Diaboli tail code. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal. The visual code takes about twice as long as speech. A viewer can recognize the use of a code with a DC 10 Intelligence check. Anyone can learn it, and only a tailed speaker can produce it.
Favored class Sorcerer. Bare, common, and hirsute Diaboli share the same rules.

gm.title: Original NPC · Rivet
lines: Motive. Get a new guide chain down to the stranded hoist platform.
Hook. Rivet can descend with a line while the party controls the hoist brake above.
Diopsid scree hoist watch, Barbarian 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1). · Medium Monstrous Humanoid

gm.title: Original NPC · Tongs

Diopsid iron gantry guard, Fighter 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1). · Medium Monstrous Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +2 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Carapace gives +4 natural armor. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not affect Diopsids.
Bioluminescence can be lit or doused at will as a free action. It sheds light in a 10-ft. radius and shadowy illumination for 20 ft. beyond that.
Wings can be unfurled as an immediate action to descend at 60 ft. per round without falling damage. They grant no flight. A paralyzed, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated Diopsid cannot use them.

Two strong primary arms and two weaker supporting arms. With the lower arms available for support, wield a weapon up to one size category larger without the normal size penalty. A Large longsword can be held by one primary arm and steadied by its matching lower arm.

Using all four hands, wield two two-handed weapons as a pair. Each gets full two-handed damage, including 1½ times a positive Strength modifier. Use the ordinary two-weapon attack penalties for a non-light off-hand weapon.

When a primary hand carries an item, an extra weapon used in a lower arm adds only half a positive Strength modifier. Each extra light weapon imposes −4 on all attacks, or −8 if the extra weapon is one-handed. The lower arms alone cannot wield a two-handed weapon. A lower-arm shield applies its armor check penalty to attacks and skill checks even if proficient.
Limb Symmetry waives the Dexterity prerequisite for feats with “two-weapon” in their name. Other prerequisites still apply. One free hand is enough for somatic components.

Light armor has no additional racial penalty. Medium armor imposes −2 Dexterity and heavy armor imposes −4 Dexterity. All armor must be custom-made and priced as one size larger. Diopsids do not need sleep and are immune to sleep effects.

Common and Diopsid are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarf (Dwarven), Orc, Terran, and Undercommon. The native language uses light signals, including darkvision-only flashes. Spot detects the exchange in place of Listen. Those without bioluminescence can learn to understand and translate it.
Favored class Barbarian. LA +1. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice.

gm.title: Original NPC · Elian Voss
lines: Investigates witnesses who vanish between planes.
Motive. Identify what is unsettling the boundary beneath an abandoned wayhouse.
Hook. Elian asks the party to stand by his departure point while he checks whether the wayhouse has an Ethereal reflection.
Disembodied missing-person investigator, Divination Wizard 3 · Wizard 3. Proficiency bonus +2. Control and planar escape. · Medium Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity. Choose the appearance and size of the humanoid you were before the accident. You weigh one-quarter of your former weight and have a 30-ft. walking speed. The origin grants no other traits.

Fade Away. As an action, enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute. You can move, hear, and see in grayscale. The Material Plane and anything on it cannot affect you and you cannot affect them. End the effect early as a bonus action. On return, use the nearest unoccupied space to the point where you disappeared. Recharges on a long rest.
Planar Outcast. Cast feather fall on yourself once per day. At level 3, cast blur once per day. At level 5, cast blink once per day. Intelligence governs these spells.
Arcane Origins grants Arcana proficiency. Speak, read, and write two languages of your choice.

gm.title: Original NPC · Safa Crosswind
lines: Airborne guide who clears a landing.
Motive. Keep a cliffside rescue route open until the last porter crosses.
Hook. Safa gives the party a head count by telepathy while watching the cliff from above.
Djinni crosswind guide, monster class 4 · CR 2, ECL 4 (2 class HD). · Medium Outsider (Air, Chaotic, Good)
AC 14 · HP 13 (2d8+4) · Speed 20 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Thirteen-level monster class. Begins with +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, land speed 20 ft., perfect flight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and telepathy to 100 ft. with creatures that have a language. Speaks Auran, Celestial, Common, and Ignan. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Djinni.

Acid resistance starts at 5 at level 2, rising to 10 at 5th, 15 at 8th, 20 at 11th, and immunity at 13th. Air Mastery applies a −1 circumstance penalty to airborne foes' attack and damage rolls. Self-only invisibility is at will from level 3.
At level 4 gains a 1d4 slam that adds 1½ times the Strength bonus and uses iterative BAB attacks, plus whirlwind 1/day. Whirlwind rises to 3/day at level 8 and at will at level 12.

Plane shift begins at level 5 with two solo trips per day. Passenger capacity grows to one at level 7, three at level 10, and six at level 12 when plane shift becomes at will. Other daily spell-like powers arrive at 6th and 9th level. Their caster level is Hit Dice from class levels +13.
Flight reaches 60 ft. (perfect) at level 7. Large size with 10-ft. reach starts at level 9. Finishes at ECL 13, CR 5, 7d8 Hit Dice, BAB +7/+2, and base saves +5/+5/+5.

gm.title: Original NPC · Vessa Hallow
lines: Motive. Find out who has been intercepting replies on the gallery route.
Hook. The courier asks you to return a letter using the upstairs exit. Their face looks familiar, but their coat clasp is the wrong color.
Doppelganger courier liaison, Rogue 1 · Level 1 skirmisher, 100 XP. · Medium Natural Humanoid (Shapechanger)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium. +2 Intelligence and +2 Charisma. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common. Racial skill bonuses are +2 Bluff and +2 Insight.

Change Shape is an at-will Polymorph minor action. Assume the appearance of a Medium humanoid, including an individual you have seen. Your statistics and equipment stay the same. The form lasts until you change it or die. Someone challenging your impersonation of an individual rolls Insight against your Bluff with a +20 bonus to your roll.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

gm.title: Original NPC · Sethra Spoke
lines: Motive. Protect her retirement fund by collecting a late payment without putting a family out of its home.
Hook. Sethra holds the witnessed signature on the guarantee but will wait if the players can provide collateral of equal worth.
Ward tender · Provisional CR 1/2 (100 XP) · Medium Humanoid

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Languages are Common and Draconic.
Use the 2014 dragonborn traits. This variant replaces the base ability increases and removes its ancestry damage resistance.
Ability scores increase by 2 Intelligence and 1 Charisma.
Forceful Presence. Take advantage on one Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check. It recharges on a short or long rest.
Choose an ancestry. For Dexterity saves, use a line for black, blue, brass, bronze and copper, or a cone for gold and red. Green, silver and white use a cone with a Constitution save.

Black and copper deal acid, blue and bronze deal lightning, brass, gold and red deal fire, green deals poison, and silver and white deal cold. The line is 5 ft. wide and 30 ft. long. The cone extends 15 ft.
Breath Weapon. Spend an action and use the area and save for your ancestry. The DC is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.
Damage is 2d6 at level 1, 3d6 at level 6, 4d6 at level 11 and 5d6 at level 16. A successful save halves it. Recharge on a short or long rest.

player.title: Species traits
lines: As a Dragonborn, you have these special traits.

Draconic Ancestry. Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.
Draconic Ancestors: Black, Acid; Blue, Lightning; Brass, Fire; Bronze, Lightning; Copper, Acid; Gold, Fire; Green, Poison; Red, Fire; Silver, Cold; White, Cold.

Breath Weapon. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
Damage Resistance. You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Draconic Flight. When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

player.title: Species traits
lines: For the Rite of Rebirth, Bahamut calls a willing, non-evil subject of Intelligence 3 or higher. The rite takes 24 hours of fasting and meditation followed by 24 hours of sleep in a symbolic egg. The egg costs 100 gp and requires metallic dragon scales. An interruption restarts the rite.

Retain original type, subtypes, racial Hit Dice, racial ability adjustments, size, powerful build if present, base speed and other movement modes, languages already known, favored classes, and level adjustment. Add Dragonblood under the subtype rules, +2 Constitution, −2 Dexterity, Draconic, and favored class Fighter. Continue to count as the original race and as a dragon for race-related effects.

Other former racial traits go away, including racial bonus feats, extra racial skill points, and special movement perks such as a dwarf’s full armored speed. Remove lost bonus points from ranks. Recheck feat and prestige-class prerequisites. The rite permits one eligible feat swap for a first-level-only Dragonblood feat. Dragonborn Paladins may multiclass and later resume Paladin.

The dragonborn emerges as an adult and loses former age adjustments. The new middle, old, and venerable ages are 200, 300, and 400 years. Add 2d% to 400 years for maximum age. Gain +2 dodge AC against creatures of the Dragon type and immunity to dragons’ frightful presence. Choose one permanent aspect: Heart, Mind, or Wings.

Heart grants a line 5 ft. per Hit Die (maximum 100 ft.), usable once every 1d4 rounds. Damage is 1d8 plus 1d8 per three Hit Dice. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire each time. Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice, rounded down, + Constitution modifier halves damage.

Mind grants immunity to paralysis and magic sleep, low-light vision, darkvision 30 ft., and +2 racial to Listen, Search, and Spot. Darkvision reaches 60 ft. at 6 HD, 90 ft. at 9 HD, and 120 ft. at 12 HD. Low-light range rises to three times human at 9 HD and four times at 12 HD. Blindsense 30 ft. starts at 15 HD.

Wings grants +10 racial to Jump and gliding at 30 ft. with average maneuverability. Glide 20 ft. forward per 5 ft. descended and take no falling damage while gliding. No hovering or gliding with a medium or heavy load. If helpless or unconscious in midair, the wings cause a slow descent and reduce falling damage to 1d6.

Wings flight starts at 6 HD, 30 ft. with average maneuverability. Flight requires a light load and no fatigue or exhaustion. Fly safely for Constitution modifier rounds in a row (minimum 1). Extend a flight up to twice that safe duration and become fatigued at the end. More than 10 minutes of powered flight in a day also causes fatigue. Gliding can separate powered flights. Powered flight stops causing that fatigue at 12 HD.

While flying, a dive attack functions as a charge with at least 30 ft. of travel and 10 ft. of descent. The dive requires a piercing weapon and deals double damage on a hit. Running in flight requires a straight line.

lines: A Small Monstrous Humanoid with the Psionic subtype. Charisma +2, Strength −2, Wisdom −2. Base land speed 20 ft. and darkvision 60 ft. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person do not apply.
Small size gives +1 to AC and attack rolls, +4 to Hide, −4 to grapple, smaller weapons, and three-quarters of a Medium creature’s carrying capacity.
Chitin grants +3 natural armor and energy resistance 5. Choose a caste at character creation. The resistance stacks with energy resistance from other effects.
Naturally Psionic grants 1 bonus power point at 1st level. Manifesting powers requires a separate source, such as a psionic class.

Racial Energy Ray is a psi-like ability usable once per day. It matches the caste’s energy resistance. Manifester level equals half the character’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum 1. It costs no power points and automatically augments to that manifester level.

Scent reaches 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double that distance and overpowering odors triple it. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., scent pinpoints the source.

Favored class Wilder. Level adjustment +1. A first-level Dromite has ECL 2.

lines: Medium Fey with the Incarnum subtype. +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision doubles human range with color and detail.

Effects that specifically target humanoids, such as charm person, cannot target a Duskling. The species chooses a fixed home plane at character creation with DM approval. On the Material Plane it has the Extraplanar subtype.
The Incarnum subtype marks eligibility for targeted effects. The permanent racial essentia pool increases by 1, or starts at 1 if the character has no other source.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
Normal capacity per investment is 1 at character levels 1–5, 2 at 6–11, 3 at 12–17, and 4 at 18–20.

Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages are Elf (the book’s name for Elven), Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling. Favored class Totemist. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives a +10-ft. enhancement bonus to base land speed with up to medium armor and a medium load. Each point also gives +2 insight on initiative checks, regardless of armor or load. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.

The optional d10 Barbarian substitutions at 7th and 11th level grant Incarnum Defense and Incarnum Rage respectively. Defense replaces Barbarian damage reduction and gives DR 1/— plus resistance 1 to each energy type per point. Incarnum Rage replaces Greater Rage and grants 2 essentia during rage. Greater Rage then replaces Mighty Rage if reached.

player.title: Species traits
lines: A Dvati character has two identical bodies sharing one soul. Each is a Medium Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and darkvision 60 ft. The species has no racial ability adjustments or racial Hit Dice. LA +1 applies to the one character.

Both twins use the same level, classes, feats, skill ranks, and XP total. The pair counts as one PC for XP. The two bodies move and act separately, within the restrictions on their shared abilities and spellcasting.

Roll each Hit Die once. Each twin adds half the die result and the full Constitution modifier to their own hit points. Track damage and healing on each body. Both save and take damage separately when caught in an ordinary area effect.

Class uses and spell slots are one shared pool. Both twins normally take the casting actions together, with one providing materials. One twin can cast alone if the other takes no actions during the casting. Even a free action by the other twin ruins the attempt and loses the spell.

Personal spells affect both twins when they share a plane, or only the caster when on different planes. Ordinary touch spells affect the twin touched. Spell Conductor can shift an ongoing harmless touch spell to the other twin on the same plane as a move action. The pair can transfer a spell it casts as part of casting, and the text disallows transferring spells used by others.

Most effects stay with the body affected. A mind-affecting spell or ability affecting one twin affects both. If a single such effect targets both at once, use one save. Negative levels and levels lost through return to life apply to both. Use one save to remove a negative level.

Pair telepathy works across any distance and across planes. The twins do not share senses. A full-round action reveals the other twin’s current hit points and mental state, plus their direction and distance when on the same plane.

If a twin dies, each elapsed day deals 1d4 Constitution and Wisdom damage to the survivor and adds a cumulative −1 to attacks, skill checks, and saves. This damage and penalty cannot be removed while the survivor lives and their twin is dead. Both vanish immediately upon the missing twin’s return to life.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Common and Dvati are automatic. Any bonus language is eligible. Speaking Dvati takes two simultaneous speakers. Favored class Bard.

lines: As a Dwarf, you have these special traits.

Dwarven Toughness. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

Stonecunning. As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

lines: Orecutter dwarf. Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Darkvision 60 ft.

Stone Walk (Su) allows passage through stone and earth as though through air. The Urdunnir can bring up to twice their body weight. The Urdunnir and any passengers must hold their breath within the material.

Stone Shape (Sp), at will, caster level 8. Standard action, touch, up to 18 cu. ft. of stone, instantaneous, no save or spell resistance. Makes rough forms. A shape with moving parts has a 30% failure chance.
Shape Metal (Sp), at will once per round, caster level 8. Full-round action, touch, up to 5 cu. ft. of metal, instantaneous, Fortitude negates and spell resistance applies.

Shape Metal can reduce a touched armor’s protection by 1d6 (half for mostly nonmetal armor). Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. Touching an unwilling creature or an item it holds requires a melee touch attack and normally provokes from that defender.
Automatic Dwarven and Undercommon. The Urdunnir region offers Alzhedo, Beholder, Common, Draconic, Elven, Giant, Gnome, or Terran as bonus languages.

In the 3.5 Realms, PCs also speak Common. Oldonnar lists Dwarven as its regional automatic language and Draconic, Giant, Terran, and Undercommon as regional bonus choices. This profile keeps the original racial Undercommon grant.
Favored class Expert. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 5 at one class level.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Winged elves from Aeryl who speak Aeryla, an Elvish dialect. Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity and −2 Constitution. Infravision extends 60 feet and daylight vision can distinguish details over a mile away. Starting characters gain no initial Legacy.

Fly 18 at maneuverability B while carrying up to half body weight, or C with a load up to body weight. Leather, studded leather and glassteel elven chain are compatible with flight. Ee’aar never use shields. Check Constitution hourly during flight, with a −1 for carrying more than half body weight, +4 while gliding in favorable wind and −1 per 5,000 feet above the first 5,000. Ceiling 20,000 feet. Failure requires half an hour of rest per two hours of prior flight.

Wing AC is 9 improved by Dexterity. Back attacks target the wings. A flank miss can hit if it beats wing AC, and a frontal attack can target the wings if the attacker is taller. At 50% HP lost only gliding is possible. At 75% lost gliding also ends. A standing jump reaches 10 feet. A qualifying fire hit or failed save ignites the wings unless extinguished in 1d4 rounds. Burned wings cause 2d6 additional damage and ground the character for one month.

Gain +1 to attack with a shortsword, bolas or lasso, and 30% resistance to sleep and charm spells. An adult carries a chest light that can be switched on, off or made to flicker at will. Enclosed confinement calls for a daily Wisdom check. Failures cause distress until open air. Five failures in one confinement require heal or cure disease.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 15, priest 12, thief 8, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Allowed combinations pair two of fighter, wizard and priest. The PC rules forbid longbows and make medium or large slashing weapons ineffective.
Ee’aar thieves apply −5 Open Locks, +5 Find/Remove Traps, −5 Hide in Shadows, +15 Detect Noise and −20 Climb Walls. These are percentage-point adjustments.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium outsider at entry with the Evil, Fire, and Lawful subtypes. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, a 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., and telepathy with creatures that have a language within 100 ft.
Fire immunity. Apply −10 to saves against cold attacks and double damage when cold offers no save.

Proficient with simple and martial weapons. The slam starts at 1d4 plus 1½ times the Strength bonus and explicitly gains iterative attacks from BAB. Heat starts at level 2 and adds fire damage on a slam hit, on a successful grapple, and each round a hold is maintained.
Level 2 grants +2 natural armor, detect magic 1/day, and enlarge 1/day. Level 3 grants another +2 Strength and produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Spell-like caster level is class HD +8.

At level 4 the Efreeti can fly 40 ft. with perfect maneuverability and use invisibility 1/day. The class later grants plane shift, gaseous form, polymorph self, wall of fire, permanent image, and wish. It becomes Large with 10-ft. reach at level 10.
Auran, Common, Ignan, and Infernal are automatic languages. The preferred progression is Efreeti. The class ends at ECL 19 with 10d8 Hit Dice and a printed CR of 8.

lines: Medium Aberration with the Psionic subtype. Charisma −2, land speed 30 ft., and no darkvision. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person do not apply.

Naturally Psionic grants 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Manifesting powers requires a separate source, such as a psionic class. The 2006 errata confirms 2 points for the creature chapter’s Elan as well.
Resistance (Su). Spend 1 power point as an immediate action for a +4 racial bonus on all saving throws until the beginning of your next action.
Resilience (Su). Spend power points as an immediate action when about to take damage. Reduce the incoming damage by 2 HP per power point spent.
Repletion (Su). Spend 1 power point to go without food or water for 24 hours. Use the core standard-action default for supernatural abilities.
An immediate action uses your swift action on your turn or on the following turn if used outside your turn. You cannot take one while flat-footed.

A four-hour daily trance provides the benefit of eight hours of human sleep. The 2006 errata removes maximum age. The aging thresholds remain 200 years for middle age, 400 for old, and 1,000 for venerable.
Elans emerge from a psionic ritual undergone by adult humans. A new Elan retains basic memories and personality and starts again as a 1st-level character with new classes and skills.
Automatic language Common. Bonus languages may include any nonsecret language. Favored class Psion. Level adjustment +0.

player.title: Species traits
lines: As an Elf, you have these special traits.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Elven Lineage. You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Elven Lineages (level 1 benefit; level 3 spell; level 5 spell):
Drow: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet. You also know the Dancing Lights cantrip. Level 3: Faerie Fire. Level 5: Darkness.

High Elf: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list. Level 3: Detect Magic. Level 5: Misty Step.
Wood Elf: Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip. Level 3: Longstrider. Level 5: Pass without Trace.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).
Fey Ancestry. You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
Keen Senses. You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.
Trance. You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Bull-headed, feather-winged folk of Eshu who speak Nimmurian. Most stand 6–7 feet tall. Those over 7 feet count as Large. Ability adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity. Daylight vision can distinguish details up to half a mile away.

Natural AC 6. Most light armor gives AC 5. The horns deal 1d4+1 damage. At 1st level an Enduk takes a mace or club proficiency. Proficiency with other piercing or slashing melee arms waits until level 3, with a flight-lance exception. Both longbows and shortbows are forbidden, and medium or large slashing weapons are unwieldy.

Fly 12 at maneuverability C with a load up to body weight, or D up to twice body weight. Flight requires bronze plate or lighter and has a 10,000-foot ceiling. After three turns of flight, check Constitution each turn. Failure requires one turn of rest per three turns already flown.

Gliding replaces flight after losing at least half normal HP, and ends at 75% HP loss. Fire exposure calls for immediate extinguishing for 1d4 rounds. If feathers burn, take 2d6 additional damage and lose flight for one month. Enclosed spaces cause no special hindrance.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 12, unlimited priest, thief 8, bard 9 and optional psionicist 8. Fighter/priest, fighter/psionicist and priest/psionicist are available, with twice the ordinary chance of a wild talent when psionics are in play.
Enduk thieves apply −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise, −20 Climb Walls and +10 Read Languages. These are percentage-point adjustments.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. black-and-white darkvision. Full ancestry gives +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma.
Full ancestry gives +2 natural armor. Cold resistance 5 applies to both mundane and magical cold damage.

Two racial Hit Dice give 2d8, BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, and Will +3. One racial feat and 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier) skill points. Racial class skills are Climb, Hide, Jump, Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
Racial proficiency covers simple weapons. Armor and shield proficiency come from other sources, such as class.
The full ancestry has two claws dealing 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each. In a full attack with a manufactured weapon, a free claw can be used as a secondary attack.

Powerful Build counts size as one category larger when advantageous on opposed checks with size modifiers and against size-dependent special attacks. It enables weapons one size larger and preserves actual space and reach. It stacks with size changes that preserve the trait.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
The language entry gives Gol-Kaa. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +2 gives ECL 4 with the two racial Hit Dice before adding class levels.
The optional four-level Feral Gargun monster class starts with +2 Strength, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., Cold resistance 5, Goliath Blood, and Mountain Movement.
Monster-class level 1 gives 1d8, BAB +1, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +2 and Will +2, one feat, and two 1d4 claws. Level 2 adds +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +1 natural armor, and Acclimated.

Monster-class level 3 adds the second 1d8, BAB +2 total, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3 and Will +3, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws. Level 4 adds +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity and brings natural armor to +2 total.

Skill points for the progression are (2 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 at 1st level and (2 + Intelligence modifier) at 3rd. The four levels incorporate level adjustment. Complete the progression before multiclassing. Table 4–4 lists CR 1, 1, 2, and 2.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider (Native). +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, −2 Constitution. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.

Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
+2 racial bonus on Bluff, Hide, Listen, Search, and Spot.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.

The original 2003 player rules for D&D 3.0 use at-will alter self (Sp) for an indefinite humanoid form. This 3.5 adaptation uses Change Shape from the 2004 conversion of the earlier monster. True seeing reveals the natural form, and Change Shape cannot assume a templated form.

Choose four Demonic Abilities total. Options are charm person, clairaudience/clairvoyance, darkness, detect thoughts, dimension door, enervation, suggestion, DR 10/magic, fire resistance 10, +2 racial on saves against electricity, or +2 racial on saves against poison.
Each selected spell-like ability is usable once per day, with caster level equal to character level and Charisma-based save DCs.
Choose at most one of DR 10/magic, dimension door, and enervation. Taking one raises LA from +2 to +3. The original 2003 DR option was 10/+1. The player entry has no racial Hit Dice.
Common, Elven, and Abyssal are the languages named in the book. The language section also describes learning Gnoll, Goblin, Sylvan, and Draconic. Favored class Sorcerer.

lines: As a Goliath, you have these special traits.

Cloud’s Jaunt (Cloud Giant). As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Fire’s Burn (Fire Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

Frost’s Chill (Frost Giant). When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Hill’s Tumble (Hill Giant). When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.
Stone’s Endurance (Stone Giant). When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.
Storm’s Thunder (Storm Giant). When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

Large Form. Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you’re in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
Powerful Build. You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Powerful Build treats a Half-Giant as one size category larger when a size modifier to an opposed check is advantageous, such as grapple, bull rush, or trip. Racial Stomp is a psi-like ability usable once per day at half Hit Dice in manifester levels, rounded down, minimum 1. Standard action, 20-ft. cone-shaped spread along the ground. A grounded creature that fails its Reflex save falls prone and takes 1d4 nonlethal damage per racial manifester level. A success negates both effects. Save DC 11 + Charisma modifier. Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full-round action and provokes attacks of opportunity. It follows the D&D 3.0 Polymorph Other spell with the exceptions below.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Dog hybrid. Constitution +2. +4 Wilderness Lore when tracking by scent.
Dog animal form. Small, walk 40 ft., AC 15. Str 13, Dex 17, Con 15. Natural attack damage: bite 1d4+1.
Table 1–3 prints AC 14. The 2002 errata corrects it to 15 (+1 size, +3 Dexterity, +1 natural). The tracking bonus does not itself supply a Scent feat or ability.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The entry lists no ability adjustments, racial Hit Dice, or level adjustment.
Luminous Sigils (Su) orbit the head and give candlelight. Douse them as a standard action to suspend power sigil bonuses and word abilities. Restore them as a free action.
Sigils are insubstantial and disappear into matter they touch. A change of form keeps the sigils if the new form preserves the Illumian’s supernatural abilities.

Glyphic Resonance (Ex) applies when a spell’s name includes glyph, rune, sigil, or symbol. If the Illumian’s character level is below the spell’s caster level, take a −4 racial penalty on its saves. At or above that caster level, gain immunity to the spell.

Power Sigils (Su) grant one choice at 1st level for a +1 bonus. Page 54 gives a second distinct sigil at 2nd level in any class, raising both bonuses to +2. On p. 87, Bloodwing Zhaolei is a Bard 1/Fighter 1 with two +2 sigils and the Vaulaesh word. Spot DC 10 distinguishes a power sigil and Knowledge (arcana) DC 15 identifies it.

Aesh adds to Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks. Hoon adds to Constitution and Wisdom checks and skills based on either ability. Naen adds to Intelligence checks and Intelligence-based skill checks.

Uur adds to Dexterity checks and Dexterity-based skill checks. Vaul adds to Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks. Krau adds to caster level for spells and spell-like abilities, capped at character level.
Illumian Words (Su) come from combining two power sigils. When a word calls for an unprepared spell slot, a slot that holds a prepared spell is ineligible.
Aeshkrau and Uurkrau allow Strength and Dexterity respectively to determine bonus spells for a high ability score in any or all of the Illumian’s spellcasting classes.
Aeshoon spends a turn or rebuke attempt as a swift action, twice per day, to add the Wisdom bonus to damage with Weapon Focus weapons until the next turn begins.
Aeshuur grants a +2 dodge bonus to AC against a target damaged by the Illumian’s sneak attack or critical hit, until the Illumian’s next turn begins.

Hoonkrau uses a swift action and a turn attempt to add 1d8 healing to cure spells, or a rebuke attempt to add 1d8 damage to inflict spells. The effect lasts through the end of the next turn. Use twice per day.
Hoonvaul spends a spell slot as a swift action, twice per day, to add its level to turning checks and turning damage and to a smite attack’s attack and damage rolls until the next turn begins.
Naenaesh can leave up to two slots empty during preparation. Until the next preparation, those slots stay empty and other spells prepared at their levels can be cast with Still Spell.

Naenhoon uses a swift action, twice per day, to apply a metamagic feat the Illumian has. Spend turn or rebuke attempts equal to the feat’s level adjustment. Casting time, spell slot, and effective spell level stay the same. Heighten Spell changes the effective level and costs one turn attempt per level added, up to spell level 9.

Naenkrau can leave up to two slots empty during preparation, at different levels if choosing two. Other spells of those levels gain +1 to their save DC, including spells from other classes. The slots stay empty and the bonus lasts until next preparation.

Uurhoon spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day. For one minute per slot level, apply the Wisdom bonus as an insight bonus to Reflex saves and the Dexterity bonus as an insight bonus to caster level checks against spell resistance.

Uurnaen can leave one 1st- or 2nd-level slot empty during preparation. Until next preparation, the slot stays empty and its level gives an insight bonus on attack rolls for unarmed strikes and sneak attacks.
Vaulaesh spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day. Its level is an insight bonus to AC and to Weapon Focus weapon damage until the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Vaulkrau spends a slot as an immediate action, twice per day. Its level is an insight bonus on the next save made before the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Vaulnaen uses an available slot twice per day to cast any prepared spell of the same level spontaneously, at the caster level of the class that prepared it.
Vauluur spends a slot as a swift action, twice per day, to add 1d6 per slot level to unarmed strike damage and sneak attack damage until the Illumian’s next turn begins.
Final Utterance (Ex) releases audible Illumian syllables at death for 1 round per Hit Die, even if the body is destroyed. Anyone within earshot can hear it.
+2 racial bonus on saves against spells with the shadow descriptor.
Superior Literacy means every Illumian is literate and Speak Language is always a class skill. Common and Illumian are automatic. Any nonsecret language may be taken as a bonus language.
Favored class Any. Exclude the highest class when figuring multiclass XP penalties. An Illumian monk or paladin can return to that class after multiclassing.

At 4th level gains self-only invisibility at will and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Higher tiers add regeneration, daily suggestion, weekly commune, and fast healing. At 7th level the class has 3d8 Hit Dice, ECL 7, and CR 2.
Sting applies Dexterity damage. Its Fortitude DC is 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier + 2. The table raises the dice as the class progresses.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with a 30-ft. base land speed and no racial ability adjustments. The Expanded Psionics Handbook gives the Psionic subtype to creatures with racial psi-like abilities.
+2 racial on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and abilities and against possession.
+2 racial on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks. +2 racial on Disguise when impersonating a human.
Kalashtar sleep. They are immune to dream, nightmare, and other effects that rely on their ability to dream.
Naturally Psionic adds 1 extra power point per character level to the character’s reserve, even without taking a psionic class.

Racial Mindlink (Ps) 1/day is separate from the power point reserve. Resolve it as a Wilder of half the Kalashtar’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum manifester level 1. It grants no general manifester levels.

With the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use its Mindlink rules. At manifester level 1, use a standard action to link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 25 ft. for 10 minutes. The willing target gets no saving throw. Power resistance applies as harmless. Treat it as mind-affecting.

With psionics rules, initial range is 25 ft. + 5 ft. per two manifester levels, and duration is 10 minutes per manifester level. Resolve psi-like augmentation as if power points equal to its effective manifester level were spent, without deducting from the reserve. Mindlink costs 1 point before augmentation. One extra point adds a target within 15 ft. of another target. Four extra points allow a link with an unwilling target (Will negates, DC 11 + the Kalashtar’s Charisma modifier for racial Mindlink).

Without the Expanded Psionics Handbook, use the setting book’s fallback. Link with one willing creature of Intelligence 3 or higher within 30 ft. for 1 round per character level. There is no saving throw or spell resistance. The ability is mind-affecting.
Once formed, either link carries telepathic communication across any distance on the same plane without requiring a shared language. The bond conveys no influence or control.

Common and Quor are automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic and Riedran. Favored class Psion. The setting entry lists no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment. Its original setting rules give Kalashtar no dragonmarks.

lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Wisdom. Darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor, and +4 racial Hide. Space and reach 5 ft.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.

Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor.

Four racial Hit Dice (4d8) give BAB +4, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, and Will +4, plus two chosen feats. Racial skill points are seven times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Escape Artist, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Use Magic Device.

Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. The Kir-Lanan regains HP equal to the hit point damage dealt by the negative energy, up to its maximum HP. Ignore claw damage and Strength damage when calculating healing.
Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as an evil Cleric of a level equal to the Kir-Lanan’s total Hit Dice.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Common and Kir-Lanan are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 8 before class levels.

lines: Medium Monstrous Humanoid (Aquatic). +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +6 natural armor.

Lightning Bolt (Su). Two or more kuo-toa clerics (whips) stay within 30 ft. of one another to build a bolt every 1d4 rounds and join hands to release it. It deals 1d6 damage per whip. Reflex halves at DC 11 + highest participating Wisdom modifier + number of whips.

lines: +1 Strength and +1 Wisdom. Medium. Walking and swimming speeds 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and can breathe air and water.

lines: Starts as a Medium outsider with 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., poison immunity, and a +4 racial bonus on Survival. Starts with +2 Wisdom and +2 Charisma. Speaks Abyssal, Celestial, Common, and Infernal.

The 13-level monster class grants chaotic and good subtypes, proficiency with simple and martial weapons, and gradually improves natural armor. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. Fire resistance starts at class level 4.

From class level 2 a lillend casts spells and uses bardic music as a bard of half its monster class level. At level 3 it gains darkness, hallucinatory terrain, knock, and light once per day each. At level 5 it gains charm person, speak with animals, and speak with plants once per day each. These spell-like abilities use its effective bard level +4 as caster level.

The tail slap begins at level 3. At level 5 a tail hit against a creature no larger than the lillend can start a grapple and constrict. Constricting occupies its lower body, so it cannot take move actions while maintaining the hold.
Flight begins at class level 6 at 70 ft. with average maneuverability. Large size and 10-ft. reach arrive at level 8.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.

lines: Medium Outsider native to the Positive Energy Plane. Gains the Extraplanar subtype when away from its native plane. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +4 Wisdom.

Two outsider Hit Dice provide 2d8, BAB +2, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +3. Racial skill points equal five times (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Concentration, Diplomacy, Heal, Knowledge (the planes), Listen, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot. Body of Light (Su) sheds white light to 5 ft. and grants immunity to death spells and magical death effects, energy drain, and negative energy. Positive-dominant planes still grant fast healing but give no temporary HP to a Lumi. Magical darkness can conceal its light.

Clear Vision (Ex) prevents blindness and dazzling, and grants immunity to direct light attacks such as searing light. Darkness and fog can still conceal opponents. A sun blade deals only nonlethal damage.
Floating Head (Ex) prevents strangulation, suffocation, and vorpal decapitation. Attackers receive no flanking bonus. The head stays a few inches above the shoulders and can rotate in place.
Spell-like abilities at caster level 3. At will, disrupt undead and light. Three times per day each, cure light wounds and glitterdust. Glitterdust save DC is 12 + Charisma modifier.

Common and Lumi are automatic. Bonus languages Abyssal, Celestial, Dwarven, and Infernal. Favored class Cleric. Lumi clerics channel positive energy regardless of alignment, worship Light, and may choose Law, Sun, or War domains. Level adjustment +2, ECL 4 before classes.
