player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, dog-headed humanoid with base AC 10, infravision 60 feet, and keen hearing and scent. Strength and Constitution +1, Intelligence and Wisdom −1. Raw Strength and Constitution must be at least 8.

Automatically gain Blind-fighting. Tracking uses half Wisdom rounded up, full Wisdom if learned through slots, or Wisdom +6 as a ranger. Detect Noise begins at 35%, adding 2 percentage points per level after 1st. Thieves can invest skill points in it.

A save at +4 can detect the presence of an invisible or ethereal being. Check as soon as one approaches to within 10 feet, then each round it stays that close. The save alone gives neither exact position nor a way to affect an ethereal creature.

Recognize werewolves in any form 99% of the time and other lupins in unusual forms 15% of the time. Identify a familiar species by scent automatically or a familiar individual with an Intelligence check. Masking odors can impose −1 to −4.

Take −2 on saves against sound or odor attacks. Swallowed wolfsbane acts as Type J poison, fatal on failure and inflicting 20 HP on a successful save. Injected wolfsbane acts as Type P, halving ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed save. Natural bite deals 1d4, speed 3, with a proficiency slot needed to avoid the nonproficiency penalty.

Class limits through fighter 13, unlimited ranger, wizard 12, cleric 15, druid 13, thief 13, and bard 9. No paladin. Lupin or Renardois is the native-language choice. Common is suggested as an additional starting language.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Maenad and Psionic subtypes. Base land speed 30 ft. No racial ability-score adjustments.
Naturally Psionic grants 2 bonus power points at 1st level. Manifesting powers requires a separate source, such as a psionic class.
Racial Energy Ray is a sonic-only psi-like ability, usable once per day and accompanied by a scream. Manifester level is half the Maenad’s Hit Dice, rounded down, minimum 1. It costs no power points.

The ray takes a standard action and hits with a ranged touch attack. Range is 25 ft. plus 5 ft. per two manifester levels. It allows no saving throw. Power resistance applies. Roll one d6 per manifester level and subtract 1 per die. The sonic ray ignores object hardness.

Outburst (Ex) is usable once per day for up to 4 rounds. Add +2 Strength and apply −2 Intelligence and Wisdom while it lasts. The entry leaves the activation action unstated. The example NPCs use a standard action, following the original 3.5 default for activated extraordinary abilities.
Automatic languages Common and Maenad. Bonus languages Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Goblin. Favored class Wilder. Level adjustment +0.

player.title: Species traits
lines: The standard PC is an Um-Shedu manscorpion whose sunlight curse was lifted after aiding the Enduks. The DM can allow a redemption-seeking character who still bears the curse.

Ability adjustments are +1 Strength and Constitution and −1 Intelligence and Wisdom. Um-Shedu adjust effective Charisma by −1 with other humanoids and −4 with demihumans or humans. Nimmurian is the usual language.

Natural AC 7 and infravision. Body armor rated 7 or worse gives AC 6. For armor rated 6 or better, improve its AC by 1. Shields and Dexterity modify normally. They cannot swim. Choose bonus Artistic Ability or Charioteering. Astronomy and Astrology are unavailable at character creation.

The Um-Shedu sting uses sleep venom. A target failing a poison save is woozy for one round, then sleeps for 2d8 rounds. Neutralize poison can awaken the target early. The save penalty is −1 per three character levels, capped at −4. Um-Shedu are immune to other manscorpions’ venom and gain +2 on other poison saves.

Class limits are fighter 12, wizard 12, priest 12, thief 7, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Fighter/thief, fighter/priest and fighter/psionicist are available. Starting priests serve Idu or Ilsundal. Wizard specialization is unavailable.
Manscorpion thieves apply +5 Open Locks, −20 Move Silently, −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise and −25 Climb Walls. These are percentage-point adjustments.

Scroungecraft. Gain tinker’s tools proficiency. With suitable material, spend 10 minutes to improvise a tool or piece of adventuring gear worth up to 30 gp. Tools and expendable items are useful for one use. Other items generally last 1 hour.

With proper materials, start before the temporary item fails and spend 8 hours to make it permanent. Scroungecraft can also repair equipment, with available materials and repair durability at the GM’s discretion.

lines: Large Construct native to Acheron, 10-ft. space and reach. Speed 40 ft., cannot run. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision under revised Construct traits. No Constitution score. Racial adjustments derived from the printed base scores are +10 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and +2 Charisma.

Two racial construct Hit Dice, 2d10 plus 30 HP for Large size, BAB +1, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +0. +7 natural armor and one slam for 1d8 before Strength. Applies standard Large attack, AC, Hide, and grapple modifiers.

Construct defenses include immunity to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, magical death effects, necromancy, and Fortitude effects that cannot affect objects. Immune to critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, ability drain, and energy drain. Destroyed at 0 HP.

Pulverize (Su), 3/day as a standard action. Remove an object’s hardness for 1d4 rounds, Fortitude DC 18 negates. Affect up to a 10-ft. cube of its volume. Unattended nonmagical objects get no save. An object held, worn, or carried by a creature requires a melee touch attack that does not provoke.

Rapid Repair (Ex) restores 1 HP per full hour of rest while at 1 HP or more. An assistant with a DC 15 Craft (stonemasonry) check raises that rate to 2 HP an hour. Rapid Repair cannot regrow or reattach body parts.

Spell resistance 14 + class levels. Uses outsider skill points for its construct Hit Dice, for five times (8 + Intelligence modifier) racial skill points. +4 racial bonus to Craft (stonemasonry) and Knowledge (architecture and engineering), and Alertness as a bonus feat.
Common, Draconic, and Giant. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +3 and ECL 5 before class levels. Optional stone or metal grafts follow the separate rules in Appendix 2.

lines: Small Humanoid with −2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, and a 30-ft. land speed. A Mephling gains the Extraplanar subtype away from its own ancestral Elemental Plane. It has no elemental subtype.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of the normal lifting and carrying limits for its Strength. It uses Small weapons.

Breath Weapon. A 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 damage to each target, Reflex half (DC 10 + half the Mephling’s Hit Dice + its Constitution modifier). One use per day, plus one per four levels attained. With multiple daily uses, wait 1d4 rounds between uses. The core breath weapon rules supply a standard action and no attack roll.

A Mephling casts spells with its ancestry’s matching elemental descriptor at +1 caster level. Common and its matching elemental language are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.
Air. +2 Dexterity, fly 10 ft. (perfect), dust-and-grit breath deals piercing damage. Automatic Auran. Favored class Bard.

lines: Medium Aberration. +2 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +8 Intelligence, +6 Wisdom, +6 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +3 natural armor.
Four primary tentacle attacks deal 1d4 bludgeoning each before Strength.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.

Eight racial Hit Dice (8d8) grant BAB +6, base Fortitude +2, Reflex +2, Will +6, and three feats. Racial skill points are 11 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Bluff, Concentration, Hide, Intimidate, Knowledge (any), Listen, Move Silently, and Spot.
Common and Undercommon are automatic. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Infernal, and Terran.
LA +7. ECL 15 before class levels and ECL 16 with one class level. Favored class Wizard.
Uses the Monster Manual’s innate spell-like abilities. The Expanded Psionics Handbook presents a separate power-point variant.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Strength +2 and choose Constitution +2 or Wisdom +2. Speak Common and one other language. Nature and Perception each gain a +2 racial bonus.

Vitality grants one extra healing surge. Ferocity gives a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt when you drop to 0 HP or fewer. Heedless Charge grants +2 racial AC against opportunity attacks provoked while charging.

Goring Charge is an encounter standard action. Charge and use a horn strike in place of the usual basic attack. Pick Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity. Add 4 to that ability modifier to attack AC, rising to 6 at level 11 and 8 at level 21. On a hit, deal 1d6 plus the selected ability modifier and knock the target prone. The damage dice rise to 2d6 at level 11 and 3d6 at level 21.

Advantage on checks to navigate or retrace a route. Proficiency with navigator tools and water vehicles.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype and a 30-ft. base land speed. +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, −4 Charisma. Level adjustment +0.
Low-light vision extends to twice human distance in dim light and retains color and detail.

Emulate Race (Ex) automatically satisfies the racial requirement of a magic item for any humanoid race. A Mongrelfolk trained in Use Magic Device gets a +4 racial bonus on checks to emulate a nonhumanoid race.
Sound Imitation (Ex) reproduces any voice or sound the Mongrelfolk has heard. A listener detects the imitation with a DC 16 Will save.
Diffuse Blood gives +2 racial on saves against spells that target or exclude a particular race when the race named by the spell is human, halfling, dwarf, elf, gnome, goblin, or orc.
Immune to sleep spells and similar magical effects. +1 racial on saves against enchantment spells and effects, illusion spells and effects, and poison.
+1 racial on Appraise, Climb, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. +4 racial on Hide and Sleight of Hand.

Tireless needs only 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours to take an extended rest.
Incredible Toughness is an encounter power at the start of your turn and costs no action. End any ongoing damage or dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition currently affecting you.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Humanoid. Wisdom +2, walk 30 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft. Choose Acid Cap, Favored, or Morel to determine size and additional traits.
Fungoid Form grants advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. Hardy Survivor grants proficiency in Survival.
Speak, read, and write Mushroomfolk and either Common or Undercommon.

Acid Cap is Medium, adds Strength +1, and grants acid resistance and Athletics proficiency. When a melee weapon attack hits you from within 5 ft., you can react to deal acid damage equal to half your level rounded up to the attacker. Uses equal your Constitution modifier, minimum one, per long rest.

Favored is Medium, adds Charisma +1, and grants Persuasion proficiency. You know Spare the Dying and can cast Bless from level 3 once per long rest. Both use Charisma. Restful Spores add your proficiency bonus to HP recovered with Hit Dice at the end of a short rest by you and friendly creatures within 30 ft. Each beneficiary can receive that bonus once per long rest.

Morel is Small, adds Dexterity +1, walks 35 ft., and gains Stealth proficiency. After adjusting coloration for at least a minute in a setting rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

+2 racial on Listen, Spot, and Survival.

Human Blood treats the Neanderthal as human for race-based effects and human-only items. The profile gives no human bonus feat or skill points.
Illiteracy. A Neanderthal can spend 2 skill points to read and write all spoken languages. Taking a nonbarbarian class preserves illiteracy unless the class is Wizard.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider from Limbo. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype when away from Limbo. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., no racial ability adjustments. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and dominate person cannot target a Neraph.

Neraph Camouflage is an extraordinary ability. Declare it on one charge attack or thrown-weapon attack per enemy per encounter. Those options share the one use against that enemy. The target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC against that attack, with ordinary consequences such as eligibility for sneak attack.
Leap gives +5 racial on Jump. Chitinous skin gives +2 natural armor. Gain +2 racial on Spot and Search.

Weapon Familiarity treats the annulat as a martial weapon. Neraphim are proficient with it through the Outsider type. A proficient thrower reduces a target’s existing cover bonus to AC by 2. Total cover still prevents the attack. The annulat has a 30-ft. range increment, 1d6 slashing at Medium or 1d4 at Small, and critical 19–20/×2. A Medium annulat costs 30 gp and weighs ½ lb.
Automatic languages are Neraph and Slaad. Bonus languages are Common, Celestial, and Abyssal. Favored class Ranger. LA +0. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice.
Neraphim are distinct from slaadi. They have coarse red skin, a broad toadlike head, and chitinlike patches. The optional Neraph Charge and Neraph Throw feats are separate from the racial ability.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Varoot playable profile. Medium Outsider native to the Plane of Mirrors. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor. Adjustments derived from the Varoot stat block are +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +4 Wisdom, and +6 Charisma.

Resistance 5 to cold, electricity, and fire. Takes 50% extra sonic damage. Reflective spell resistance equals 12 + class levels. Targeted spells stopped by this resistance reflect to their caster. Immune to gaze attacks, which likewise reflect to their source.

Mirror Jump (Su), at will. As a standard action, touch a mirror and exit through another mirror up to 1 mile away. A suitable highly reflective surface that is not a mirror has a 30% chance to work for entry only. If there is no mirror in range, travel on the Plane of Mirrors and emerge at a random mirror portal.
At caster level 12, disguise self 3/day (printed as change self), and mirror image 1/day. Gains bonus Exotic Weapon Proficiency with the shard dagger and shard longsword.

Speaks Common and its own language of mirror sounds. Favored class Rogue. Replace the Varoot’s single racial Hit Die with its first class level. Level adjustment +3, ECL 4 at first class level. Kalareem and Sillit have different player adjustments.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Ratlike humanoid with a long muzzle, prominent incisors, rough fur, and a mostly bare tail. The printed setting describes Nezumi in Rokugan and the Shadowlands.
Medium. Base land speed 40 ft. Constitution +2, Charisma −2.
Low-light vision extends useful vision to twice the human distance in dim conditions while retaining color and detail.
Racial +2 to Hide and Move Silently. Racial +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Immune to acquiring a Shadowlands Taint score and to ill effects of direct Shadowlands exposure. Cloud of Taint and special attacks from Shadowlands creatures can still harm a Nezumi.
Claw or bite deals 1d4 normal damage as an unarmed strike. Choose one of these unarmed attacks per round.
Keen Scent permits the optional Scent feat at Wisdom 11 or higher. It does not grant that feat automatically.

With Scent, detect a presence as a free action within 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double these ranges and overpowering odors triple them. Finding direction costs a move-equivalent action. Pinpoint within 5 ft.

With Scent, follow a trail using Wisdom. A fresh trail is usually DC 10 and the DC rises by 2 per hour. Scent and group size can modify it. Surface and visibility penalties do not apply. A Nezumi can recognize familiar odors. Water can erase a trail. Strong masking odors hamper detection and identification and raise the base tracking DC to 20. Other tracking rules follow the Track feat.
Automatic languages Rokugani and Nezumi. Bonus languages Bakemono and Shadowlands. Favored class Rogue.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small aquatic fey that breathes air and water. Walks 20 ft., swims 30 ft., and has low-light vision. Starts with −4 Strength, +4 Dexterity, and +4 Charisma. Speaks Aquan, Common, and Sylvan.

Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls and +4 on Hide checks. Lifting and carrying limits are half those of a Medium character. Nixies gain racial bonuses of +2 on Search, Spot, and Listen, +5 on Hide in water, and +8 on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. They can take 10 on Swim checks.
The four-level monster class grants proficiency with simple weapons and the short sword. It grants no armor or shield proficiency.

Water breathing starts at level 1, once daily at caster level equal to class level +2. Charm person starts at level 2, once daily at caster level equal to class level. It reaches three uses per day at level 4. Dodge arrives at level 3 and spell resistance 16 at level 4.

Powerful Build. Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

A Friendly Ear. After speaking with a nonhostile creature for at least 1 minute, you can ask for a Wisdom save at DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On failure the creature is charmed by you for 1 hour and you learn one fact it knows about the topic, chosen by the DM. The creature remains unaware of the attempt either way. Recharges on a short rest.
Speak, read, and write three languages of your choice.

player.title: Species traits
lines: As an Orc, you have these special traits.

Adrenaline Rush. You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
Relentless Endurance. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

lines: The Phanatons of Jibarú: Phanatons as PCs

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small furred humanoid with a grasping ringed tail and gliding membranes. No infravision. Natural AC 9, improved by a racial 2-point bonus before Dexterity. +2 on all saving throws.
Strength −2 and Intelligence −1. Dexterity +2, or Dexterity and Wisdom +1 each for shamans. The PC section requires Dexterity 16, despite the general table listing a minimum of 6.

Glide 50 feet per round, with maximum horizontal range equal to three times the starting height. Reduce range by 20 feet per 100 coin-weight carried. Armor or shield use prevents gliding. While gliding, the character cannot fight, use somatic spell components, or perform tasks that need two hands.

At 3rd level, favorable winds allow level flight or a climb of 10 feet per 60 feet of travel in normal winds, or per 30 feet in strong breezes. High winds prevent controlled flight. At 7th level, use pass plant once per day.
Charisma is reduced by 1 with most other humanoids and by 2 with humans and non-elven demihumans. Treat Charisma as 3 when dealing with araneas. Speak Jibar, which uses gestures and vocalizations.

Class limits through fighter 9, ranger 10, mage 8, priest 10, druid 13, thief 15, bard 8, and optional psionicist 7 per Table 1.7. The character prose omits bard. Multiclass choices are fighter/thief, ranger/priest, and fighter/psionicist.

Margreve Within. Meet daily food needs through ordinary food or 30 minutes of direct sunlight. Resist poison damage and roll saving throws against poison with advantage.
Margreve Without. Choose a plantlike feature, such as cracked bark skin or creaking wooden joints, or agree on another feature with the GM.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Fey. Strength −4, Dexterity +8, Intelligence +6, Wisdom +4, Charisma +6. Walk 20 ft., fly 60 ft. with good maneuverability. Low-light vision. +1 natural armor and +2 racial bonus to Listen, Search, and Spot.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.

Magic-followers paint or dye their fur and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Hide checks in shadowy areas. Beast-followers leave their fur white and fight with natural weapons. The original entry describes classed quaggoths as never gaining spellcasting.
Three racial Hit Dice (3d8) grant BAB +3, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +3, and two feats. The updated racial skill list has Climb, Hide, Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Quaggoths speak a dialect of Undercommon. LA +2, so ECL 5 before class levels. Favored class Barbarian.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. lines: Medium Humanoid with the Raptoran subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. The playable entry gives no racial ability-score adjustment or level adjustment.
Wing-Aided Movement gives +10 racial bonus to Jump checks. +2 racial bonus to Climb and Spot. Low-light vision reaches twice human distance in dim light and retains color and detail.

Gliding (Ex) uses 40-ft. speed and average maneuverability. Descend 5 ft. per 20 ft. traveled forward. Gliding prevents falling damage and never allows hovering. A medium or heavy load prevents gliding.
If unconscious or helpless in midair, the wings stiffen and unfold. The Raptoran descends in a corkscrew and takes only 1d6 falling damage regardless of distance.
At 5 Hit Dice, Flight (Ex) grants a 40-ft. fly speed with average maneuverability. A medium or heavy load, fatigue, or exhaustion prevents powered flight.

At 5–9 Hit Dice, fly safely for a number of consecutive rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1. You can fly for up to twice that many rounds, becoming fatigued at the end of the flight. You also become fatigued after more than 10 minutes total powered flight in a day. Glide before, after, or between rounds of powered flight.

At 10 Hit Dice, keep the 40-ft. average fly speed and fly with no more exertion than walking or running. The playable text leaves the daily cutoff implicit, while several 10+ HD sample NPCs still list fatigue after 10 minutes.

Once powered flight is available at 5 Hit Dice, it permits a straight-line run and a diving charge with a piercing weapon. The dive must move at least 30 ft. and descend at least 10 ft. A hit deals double damage.
Pact with Wind Lords gives +1 caster level when casting air-descriptor spells. Unerring Direction senses north even underground on the Material Plane.

A footbow is a martial weapon for a Raptoran, with a 110-ft. range increment. Grip it with the feet and draw with one hand for the usual Strength bonus, or draw with both hands to apply 1½ times the bonus. The bow’s Strength rating caps the bonus before the multiplier. On the ground, fire from a prone position at −4 to the attack roll.
Common and Tuilvilanuue are automatic. Bonus languages Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Sylvan. Favored class Cleric.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Reptilian subtype. +2 Dexterity, −2 Strength. Base land speed 30 ft. The racial traits grant no essentia pool. Gaining an essentia pool from a class or feat adds the Incarnum subtype.
Racial Knowledge treats all Knowledge checks as trained, even without ranks. Its +1 competence bonus on Knowledge and bardic knowledge checks increases by +1 per two soulmelds currently shaped.
+2 racial bonus to Bluff and Diplomacy.
Racial Aid gives +3 to the roll of another Rilkan when you successfully aid them. Use the ordinary bonus when aiding a creature of another species.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages can be any nonsecret language. Favored class Incarnate. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.
Rilkans resemble humans with bands of pebbly scales on the neck and forearms. The book describes single-color bands in males and patterned multicolor bands in females.
Choose the optional Rilkan Rogue substitutions at Rogue 1, 3, and 10 independently. Each uses a d6 Hit Die and adds Speak Language as a class skill at that level.
Rogue 1 keeps trapfinding and trades 1st-level sneak attack for Improved Flanking. Sneak attack begins at Rogue 3 and stays 1d6 below the standard progression if this substitution is taken.
Improved Flanking gives the Rilkan Rogue +4 to attacks when flanking in place of the usual +2. Other Rilkans flanking that same foe also get +4. Allies of other species use the usual flanking bonus.

The Rogue 3 substitution grants bardic knowledge and a bonus feat. It replaces trap sense and prevents gaining it from later rogue levels. Use rogue level plus Intelligence modifier for bardic knowledge, and apply Racial Knowledge. The feat choices are Deceitful, Diligent, Investigator, Negotiator, and Persuasive.

Rogue 10 can replace that level’s special ability with Fortunate Reflexes. Reroll a failed Reflex save unless the original die was a natural 1, and keep the new result. Taking this option gives up improved evasion from rogue levels.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. and swim speed 30 ft. The printed entry gives no racial ability-score adjustments or level adjustment.
Low-light vision reaches twice human distance in dim light and retains color and detail. A +2 racial bonus applies to Escape Artist.

The ordinary swim-speed rules grant +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards, permit taking 10 even when threatened or distracted, and allow a straight-line run while swimming.

Hold Breath (Ex): Sea Kin breathe air and can hold their breath for 8 × their Constitution score in rounds. Each standard or full-round action while submerged spends one extra round of breath. Once the budget runs out, make a Constitution check each round, starting at DC 10 and increasing by 1 each round. A failed check starts drowning.

Water Dependency: immerse the entire body in water at least once a week. After a week without immersion, check Constitution daily at DC 10 + 1 per additional day. On a failed check, take 1 Constitution damage. Once fully immersed, restore 1d4 Constitution per hour while remaining in water. The printed requirement specifies water without a salinity qualifier.
Weapon Familiarity treats tridents and nets as simple weapons. Common is automatic. Bonus languages Aquan, Elven, and Sahuagin. Favored class Druid.

lines: Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. retains its value in medium or heavy armor and with medium or heavy loads. Darkvision 60 ft. LA +0.

lines: Medium. +2 Charisma and either +2 Dexterity or +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, darkvision, Common and one other language. +2 Arcana and +2 Stealth.
Fragile Mortality removes one healing surge from your normal total. Practiced Sneak grants Stealth training. Shadow Origin applies to effects keyed to creature origin.
Master of Shadows lets you replace a class utility choice above 1st level with a Shade utility of the same or a lower level.
One with Shadow is an at-will standard action. Through the end of your next turn, ordinary cover or concealment is enough to attempt to hide, and cover from allies can help you become or stay hidden.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small. Walk 30 ft. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +1. Darkvision 60 ft.
Quick Wit grants Deception and Insight proficiency. Shadow Camouflage gives advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) to hide in dim light or darkness.

Stink Eye. As an action, target a creature you can see within 30 ft. that can see and hear you. It makes a Charisma save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On a failure its next ability check, attack roll or saving throw before your next turn starts has disadvantage.

Sunlight Sensitivity gives disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception if you, the target or what you seek to see is in direct sunlight. Unseelie Blessing grants advantage on saves against charm and prevents magical sleep.
Speak, read and write Goblin and Umbral.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider from the Plane of Shadow. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype away from that plane. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person cannot target a Shadowswyft.
+2 Dexterity, −2 Constitution. Land speed 40 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision.
Light Blindness is extraordinary. Abrupt exposure to bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds the Shadowswyft for 1 round. Afterward, it remains dazzled while in the affected area.
Dazzled imposes −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks. Use the normal Blinded condition for the first round.
+2 bonus on initiative checks. +4 racial bonuses on Hide and Move Silently.
Automatic languages are Shadowswyft and Common. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Celestial, and Elven. Favored class Rogue. LA +1. The player profile adds no racial Hit Dice.

lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Strength +2, Dexterity −2, Intelligence +2, Charisma −2. Base land speed 30 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft. in black and white. +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Shadow Affinity (Ex) gives +2 racial bonus to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot in darkness or shadowy illumination.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. Its penalty applies to attack rolls only.
+1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs and half-orcs. The bonus and the light penalty both apply if both conditions are present.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Orc. Favored class Wizard. Level adjustment +1.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Intelligence +2 and choose Wisdom +2 or Charisma +2. Speak Common, Deep Speech, and one other language. Gain +2 racial bonuses to Arcana, Endurance, and a third skill.
Telepathy works within 5 squares with creatures that have a language. Crystalline Mind gives resist 5 psychic, increasing to 10 at level 11 and 15 at level 21.

A living construct needs no food, drink, breath, or sleep and skips Endurance checks against starvation, thirst, and suffocation. An extended rest still takes six hours. Immortal Origin counts as immortal for origin effects.
Shard Swarm is an encounter move action. Each enemy in close burst 1 grants combat advantage to you through the end of your next turn. Then teleport half your speed.

lines: Medium lizard kin, usually six to seven feet tall. Tough scales provide natural AC 5. Swimming is a bonus nonweapon proficiency. Speak Shazak, a language closely related to Malpheggi.
Strength +1 and Wisdom −1. Before adjustments, Strength 8–18, Constitution 6–18, Intelligence 3–17, and Charisma 3–16. Dexterity and Wisdom range from 3 to 18.

Class limits through fighter 12, wizard 7, priest 10, thief 11, bard 8, and optional psionicist 9. Fighter/thief and fighter/psionicist are the two multiclass combinations. The home culture restricts access to kits.
Thieving adjustments are −5 percentage points to pick pockets, open locks, climb walls, and read languages, and +5 each to move silently, hide in shadows, and detect noise.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Shapechanger subtype. Base land speed 30 ft. +2 Dexterity, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma. The setting entry gives no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment.
Low-light vision doubles human range and preserves color and detail. +2 racial on Balance, Climb, and Jump.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Sylvan. Favored class Ranger.

Shifting (Su) is a free action once per day. It lasts 3 rounds + the current Constitution modifier, counting an increase from shifting. Each shifter feat adds one round per use, and each pair of shifter feats adds one daily use.
Choose one of the six original traits at character creation. Its active benefits apply while shifting. Shifting is innate and cannot be transmitted by bites or claws.
Beasthide gives +2 Constitution and a +2 natural armor bonus to AC.
Cliffwalk gives +2 Dexterity and a climb speed of 20 ft.
Longstride gives +2 Dexterity and +10 ft. to base land speed.

Longtooth gives +2 Strength and a bite with a printed base die of 1d6 and +1 damage per four character levels. Bite once per round. When paired with a weapon, the bite is a secondary natural attack with −5 on the bite attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.

Razorclaw gives +2 Strength and two primary claws with printed base damage 1d4 +1 per four character levels per claw. Use one claw as a standard action or both as a full attack. Each claw attacks at most once per round. In the first printing, using a claw as a light off-hand weapon with a manufactured primary weapon applies −2 to all attacks that round.
Wildhunt gives +2 Constitution and scent while shifting. Outside shifting, Wildhunt gives +2 to Survival checks.

Wildhunt scent detects a creature at 30 ft., 60 ft. upwind, or 15 ft. downwind. Double those ranges for strong odors and triple them for overpowering odors. A move action identifies direction. Within 5 ft., pinpoint the source.

While shifting, a Wildhunt Shifter with Track can follow scent using Survival. A typical fresh trail is DC 10 and adds +2 per hour, with adjustments for odor and group size. Ignore surface and poor-visibility modifiers.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Small Humanoid with the Aquatic and Halfling subtypes. +2 Dexterity, −2 Strength. Land speed 20 ft. and swim speed 20 ft. LA +0.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of normal carrying capacity. The shoal halfling uses Small weapons.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus. The +2 racial bonus on Listen checks is retained.
The variant loses the halfling racial +1 on attack rolls with thrown weapons and slings and the racial +2 on Climb, Jump, and Move Silently. The Small size attack bonus still applies.
Common and Halfling are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc. Favored class Rogue.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Reptilian subtype. +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity. Base land speed 30 ft. The racial traits grant no essentia pool. Gaining a pool from a class or feat adds the Incarnum subtype.

Natural Weapon: One arm-spine attack per round under the base racial rule. It deals 1d6 piercing. An off-hand spine attack takes the ordinary off-hand penalties and adds only half a positive Strength modifier to damage.
An arm cannot attack with both its spines and a weapon it wields in the same round. Attacking with spines on an arm carrying a shield removes that shield’s AC bonus until the start of your next turn.
Binding a soulmeld to the arms chakra makes spine attacks count as lawful for overcoming damage reduction.

+2 racial bonus to Intimidate and Climb. Common is automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic, Elf (Elven), Celestial, Abyssal, and Infernal. Favored class Incarnate. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.
Skarn are solidly built and humanlike, with rows of spines on their forearms, calves, and upper back. The spines can lie flush against the body and do not retract.
Choose the optional Skarn Monk substitutions at Monk 1, 5, and 10 independently. Each uses a d8 Hit Die and adds Intimidate as a class skill at that level.

Monk 1 replaces the unarmed strike class feature with Spine Strike. Treat arm spines as unarmed strikes for Monk class features such as flurry of blows and ki strike. Medium Monk damage with spines rises to 1d8 at Monk 4 and 1d10 at Monk 8.

Monk 5 grants one essentia and Defensive Insight, replacing the standard level-based Monk AC bonus. Gain +1 insight AC per invested point. It applies to touch AC and while flat-footed, immobilized, or helpless, and works with armor, shield, or heavy load. The normal Wisdom-to-AC rules still apply separately.

Monk 10 replaces ki strike (lawful) with one daily soulmeld from the Soulborn list if Constitution is at least 11, plus the ability to bind a soulmeld to the arms chakra. Meldshaper level is half Monk level. Save DC is 10 + invested essentia + Wisdom modifier.

AC 15 · HP 10 (1d8+2) · Speed 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form

AC 13 · HP 6 (1d4+2) · Speed 30 ft.; swim 30 ft. in amorphous form

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid. −2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom. Land speed 30 ft. LA +2. The entry lists no racial Hit Dice.

Alternate Form (Su). Enter amorphous form as a standard action. It gives a 30-ft. swim speed and passage through openings as small as 2 inches in diameter. Return to normal form with a full-round action that does not provoke.

In amorphous form all worn and carried equipment melds and magic items stop functioning. Material and natural armor cease to apply. Dexterity, any effective deflection bonus, and armor from force effects can apply.

In amorphous form the Slyth cannot attack, be flanked, or be stunned, and is immune to critical hits. Other supernatural abilities stop. Spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components cannot be cast.
The form lasts up to 10 minutes per class level. After returning to normal, wait as long as the actual time spent in amorphous form before changing again.
Water Breathing (Ex) allows indefinite breathing underwater. Immunities (Ex) cover polymorphing and poison. Sonic resistance 5.
+4 racial on Disguise, Escape Artist, and Survival. Weapon Familiarity treats flutter blades as martial weapons.
Common and Undercommon are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Elven, Gnome, and Terran or by region. Favored class Druid.

lines: Can move through the space of Medium or larger creatures and try to hide behind one. Once per day, reroll a failed save, use the new result, and gain 1 Luck.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Dragonblood subtype. +2 Charisma, −2 Constitution. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision preserves color and detail in dim light at twice human range.

A Spellscale counts as a dragon for racial effects. The subtype also affects eligibility for dragon-specific abilities, feats, and items, and makes the Spellscale subject to harmful dragon-targeted effects. The creature type remains Humanoid.
Common and Draconic are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Halfling. Favored class Sorcerer. No racial Hit Dice or level adjustment are added.

Blood Quickening takes one hour and grants the benefits of one chosen dragon deity for 24 hours. Choose at most one meditation per day. A check bonus is racial and equals half character level, rounded down. Borrowed feats cannot meet prerequisites and still use the normal feat rules.

Aasterinian grants a Disguise bonus and three uses of Improved Counterspell. Astilabor grants an Appraise bonus and Eschew Materials all day. Chronepsis grants a Listen bonus and Silent Spell for the day.
Bahamut adds 2d6 damage to one evil creature targeted by or in the area of the spell, up to three times. Tiamat works the same way against a good creature.
Falazure treats inflict spells as on your spell list for spell completion and spell trigger items. Tamara does the same for cure spells. These meditations allow item use and grant no spells known.

Garyx grants two uses of Widen Spell. Hlal provides a Perform (storytelling) bonus and three uses of Heighten Spell. Io gives a Spellcraft bonus and three uses of Empower Spell. Lendys gives a Concentration bonus and Still Spell for the day.

The optional Rite of Spellscale Assumption converts a willing nondraconic Humanoid. Over seven consecutive days the officiating Spellscale must be able to cast polymorph and have 10 ranks in Knowledge (arcana). Materials cost 2,000 gp. The rite replaces racial traits and removes former racial Hit Dice and level adjustment. Existing languages and favored classes are retained, with Draconic and Sorcerer added.

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid native to Acheron. The species entry gives the Extraplanar subtype away from Acheron. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and no racial ability score adjustments.
Natural armor +1, acid resistance 5, and DR 2/piercing or slashing. Either piercing or slashing bypasses the DR. The official errata corrects the first printing’s DR label.
Metallic-looking skin grants no special susceptibility to rusting effects.

Natural Spikes work as armor spikes, with Martial Weapon Proficiency granted as a racial bonus feat. Medium spikes deal 1d6 piercing, critical ×2. They can make a regular light melee attack or one off-hand attack under the normal two-weapon rules.

Use the spikes on a successful opposed grapple check made to deal damage. They replace ordinary unarmed grapple damage. Alternatively, make the light spike attack against AC while grappling at the usual −4. The spikes deal no automatic damage on unrelated grapple checks or to a creature merely holding the Spiker.

Worn armor has its maximum Dexterity bonus reduced by 1 and its armor check penalty worsened by 2. A chain shirt has maximum Dexterity bonus +3 and armor check penalty −4 for a Spiker. Shields and arcane spell failure are unaffected by these changes.
Common is automatic and Infernal is a bonus language. Favored class Fighter. LA +0. The playable profile adds no racial Hit Dice.

lines: Humanlike descendants of nature spirits. Their source setting places them among communities near bamboo groves, rivers, or the sea, outside Rokugan.
Medium. Base land speed 30 ft. The shared traits give no ability score adjustments.
Low-light vision gives twice human viewing distance in dim light, with color and detail still visible.
Humanoid with the spirit subtype. Effects that target either spirits or humanoids can affect Spirit Folk.
Automatic languages Common and Spirit Tongue. Bonus languages Aquan, Giant, Goblin, Hengeyokai, and Nezumi. Favored class Any.
Bamboo lineage. Racial +2 Wilderness Lore and +4 Hide in woods or forests. Trackless Step leaves no trail in natural surroundings.
Racial +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects with earth, rock, stone, or wood in the name, earth shugenja spells, and wu jen spells tied to earth or wood.
Speak with animals once per day for one minute, as a 1st-level caster. This version can speak with any animal.

Stonechild quarry marker, Stonechild monster class 3 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 3. · Medium Outsider (Earth, Extraplanar)

player.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Outsider with the Earth subtype. The printed profile lists Extraplanar. Apply that subtype when away from the native plane. Base land speed 30 ft. Darkvision sees in black and white out to 60 ft.
Full ancestry gives +8 Strength, +8 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, and +4 natural armor.

Full ancestry has 2d8 racial Hit Dice, BAB +2, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +3 each. It grants one feat plus Blind-Fight as a bonus feat. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 6 before any class levels.

Racial skill points are 5 × (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Appraise, Climb, Craft (stoneworking), Intimidate, Knowledge (history), Knowledge (the planes), Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
Proficient with simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields other than tower shields.
Full ancestry can use Magic Stone (Sp) three times per day at caster level 3.

Each use of Magic Stone (Sp) enchants up to three touched pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. The printed spell lists 1d6+1 damage on a hit, or 2d6+2 against undead. Use a normal ranged attack with a +1 enhancement bonus, at a 20-ft. increment if thrown or 50 ft. if slung.
Common and Terran are automatic. Bonus languages are Celestial, Dwarven, and Ignan. Favored class Fighter.

The optional six-level Stonechild monster class starts before the full ancestry is available. Its starting adjustments are +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma. It starts Medium with 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., acid and poison immunity, and the listed proficiencies.

At monster-class level 1, gain 1d8 racial Hit Die, BAB +1, base saves +2, one feat, and (8 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 skill points. At level 2 add +2 Strength and +2 Constitution and reach +1 natural armor.

At level 3 add another +2 Strength and +2 Constitution. Natural armor rises to +2 and Magic Stone becomes available 1/day at caster level 3. At level 4 gain the second 1d8 racial Hit Die, BAB +2 total, base saves +3, (8 + Intelligence modifier) skill points and bonus Blind-Fight.

At level 5 add +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, reach +3 natural armor, and use Magic Stone 2/day. At level 6 add +2 Strength, reach +4 natural armor, and use Magic Stone 3/day. Its caster level stays 3.

The monster class incorporates the four points of level adjustment and ends with the same two racial Hit Dice and full traits. Complete it before multiclassing. Table 4–5 lists CR 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, and 3 for its six levels.

lines: Medium Construct with the Living Construct subtype and a Constitution score. Base land speed 30 ft. +2 Constitution, −2 Wisdom, and −2 Charisma. Class determines Hit Dice, BAB, saves, and skill points. The playable entry lists no level adjustment.

Use ordinary vision and normal saves against mind-affecting spells and abilities. Living Constructs are subject to critical hits, nonlethal damage, stunning, ability damage and drain, death effects, and necromancy.
Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, effects causing sickened, and energy drain.

The official errata allows natural recovery of nonlethal damage and bars natural healing of lethal damage. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural healing of HP or ability damage work at half effect. Repair light damage works at full effect.
Effects that target living creatures or constructs can affect a Warforged. Raise dead and resurrection can restore one to life.

The p. 46 Craft repair procedure takes 8 hours and restores 1 HP per point the check exceeds 15. The procedure requires ranks, as clarified in the errata. Use Craft (armorsmithing, blacksmithing, gemcutting, or sculpting), including for self-repair. Taking 10 is allowed. Taking 20 is barred.

Heat metal, chill metal, and repel metal or stone affect Warforged as if they wore metal armor. Repel wood also applies. Rusting grasp deals 2d6 damage, Reflex half at DC 14 + caster ability modifier. A rust monster’s touch deals 2d6, Reflex DC 17 half.

At 0 HP, a Warforged is disabled and gets one move or standard action per round without losing HP for strenuous actions. At −1 through −9 HP it is inert, unconscious and helpless, and loses HP only if damaged again.
Warforged function without food, sleep, or air. A Warforged can benefit from consumables. Spell preparation and infusions retain their class rest requirements.

Composite Plating gives a +2 armor bonus to AC. It occupies the armor and magic robe slot and can be enchanted as armor. The plating prevents wearing other armor or magic robes and does not stack with other armor bonuses. It imposes 5% arcane spell failure unless a class feature waives failure in light armor.
Light Fortification gives a 25% chance to negate the extra effects of a critical hit or sneak attack and roll damage normally.
One natural slam deals 1d4 base damage. Common is automatic, with no racial bonus languages. Favored class Fighter.

Adamantine Body is an optional 1st-level feat. It sets the plating armor bonus to +8, grants DR 2/adamantine, reduces base speed to 20 ft., and counts as heavy armor. Maximum Dexterity bonus +1, armor check penalty −5, and arcane spell failure 35%.

lines: Roughly marble sized, Ioun Stones are named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of Ioun Stones exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color. When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time. Each Ioun Stone orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it. As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it. The type of stone determines its rarity and effects. Absorption (Very Rare). While this pale lavender ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic. Agility (Very Rare). Your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this deep-red sphere orbits your head. Awareness (Rare). While this dark-blue rhomboid orbits your head, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. Fortitude (Very Rare). Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this pink rhomboid orbits your head. Greater Absorption (Legendary). While this marbled lavender and green ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 8 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic. Insight (Very Rare). Your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this incandescent blue sphere orbits your head. Intellect (Very Rare). Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled scarlet and blue sphere orbits your head. Leadership (Very Rare). Your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled pink and green sphere orbits your head. Mastery (Legendary). Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head. Protection (Rare). You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while this dusty-rose prism orbits your head. Regeneration (Legendary). You regain 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour this pearly white spindle orbits your head if you have at least 1 Hit Point. Reserve (Rare). This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d4 levels of stored spells chosen by the GM. Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the stone. If the stone can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses. While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the stone is no longer stored in it, freeing up space. Strength (Very Rare). Your Strength increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this pale blue rhomboid orbits your head. Sustenance (Rare). You don't need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.
